5.279.s: viṣayānukramaṇikā
5.279.d: विषयानुक्रमणिका
5.279.m: Table of Contents

5.279.s: 1 maṃgalācaraṇam, sūtaśaunakasaṃvādārambhaḥ, tatra śaunakapraśnaṃ śrutvā tasyottaraṃ dātuṃ sūtena liṃgotpattivarṇanaprasaṃgena strīviyoginaḥ śivasya ṛṣyāśrame gamanavarṇanam, tatrarṣibhirdigaṃbaraṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasmai śāpapradānam, tena śāpena śivasya tatrava liṃga-patanam, brahmaviṣṇvādibhiḥ śivastavanakaraṇam , tena tuṣṭena śaṃkareṇa liṃgapūjana- vidhikathanam, tato devairhāṭakeśvarakṣetre gatvā tatraiva tasya śivaliṃgasya sthāpanam, liṃgapūjanamāhātmyavarṇanam 9..... .. 1
5.279.d: 1 मंगलाचरणम्, सूतशौनकसंवादारम्भः, तत्र शौनकप्रश्नं श्रुत्वा तस्योत्तरं दातुं सूतेन लिंगोत्पत्तिवर्णनप्रसंगेन स्त्रीवियोगिनः शिवस्य ऋष्याश्रमे गमनवर्णनम्, तत्रर्षिभिर्दिगंबरं शिवं दृष्ट्वा तस्मै शापप्रदानम्, तेन शापेन शिवस्य तत्रव लिंग-पतनम्, ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिभिः शिवस्तवनकरणम् , तेन तुष्टेन शंकरेण लिंगपूजन- विधिकथनम्, ततो देवैर्हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे गत्वा तत्रैव तस्य शिवलिंगस्य स्थापनम्, लिंगपूजनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 9..... .. 1
5.279.m: 1. Invocation of auspiciousness; commencement of the dialogue between Sūta and Śaunaka; hearing Śaunaka's question there, in order to give an answer to it, the description of Śiva, separated from his wife, going to the hermitage of the seers in the context of describing the origin of the liṅga; the seers seeing the sky-clad Śiva there and giving a curse to him; through that curse, the falling of Śiva's liṅga right there; the offering of praise to Śiva by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and others; the explanation of the rules for worshiping the liṅga by Śaṃkara, who was pleased by that; then the gods going to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara and establishing that very Śivaliṅga there; description of the māhātmya of liṅga worship 9..... 1

5.279.s: 2 liṃgotpāṭanena pātālato gaṃgāyā āgamanam, triśakoścaṇḍālatvaṃ kathaṃ prāptamiti praśne tatkathopākhyāne saśarīreṇasvargagamanāya triśaṃkunā vasiṣṭhasya prārthanākaraṇam, vasiṣṭhenedamaśakyamiti kathite'nyaṃ guruṃ praṣṭuṃ manasi durāgraheṇa nirdhāraṇam- 3
5.279.d: 2 लिंगोत्पाटनेन पातालतो गंगाया आगमनम्, त्रिशकोश्चण्डालत्वं कथं प्राप्तमिति प्रश्ने तत्कथोपाख्याने सशरीरेणस्वर्गगमनाय त्रिशंकुना वसिष्ठस्य प्रार्थनाकरणम्, वसिष्ठेनेदमशक्यमिति कथितेऽन्यं गुरुं प्रष्टुं मनसि दुराग्रहेण निर्धारणम्- 3
5.279.m: 2 The arrival of the Gaṅgā from Pātāla through the uprooting of the liṅga; to the question of how Triśaṅku came to be a caṇḍāla, in the narration of that story, Triśaṅku's request to Vasiṣṭha to go to heaven in his physical body; Vasiṣṭha saying that this is impossible, and [Triśaṅku's] obstinate resolve in mind to consult another guru. — 3

5.279.s: 3 vasiṣṭhavākyamanādṛtya durāgraheṇa svecchayā vartitumudyuktaṃ triśaṃkuṃ prati vasiṣṭhaputraiḥ 'caṇḍālo bhava iti śāpadānam, tena śāpena sadyaścaṇḍālatvaṃ prāpya paścāttāpena duḥkhitasya triśaṃkorājñayā tasya mantribhistriśaṃkujyeṣṭhaputraṃ hariścaṃdraṃ rājyebhiṣe- canam, tasya triśaṃkośca mahāraṇye padbhyāṃ gamanam... ... 4
5.279.d: 3 वसिष्ठवाक्यमनादृत्य दुराग्रहेण स्वेच्छया वर्तितुमुद्युक्तं त्रिशंकुं प्रति वसिष्ठपुत्रैः ऽचण्डालो भव इति शापदानम्, तेन शापेन सद्यश्चण्डालत्वं प्राप्य पश्चात्तापेन दुःखितस्य त्रिशंकोराज्ञया तस्य मन्त्रिभिस्त्रिशंकुज्येष्ठपुत्रं हरिश्चंद्रं राज्येभिषे- चनम्, तस्य त्रिशंकोश्च महारण्ये पद्भ्यां गमनम्... ... 4
5.279.m: 3 To Triśaṅku, who disregarded Vasiṣṭha's word and was bent on acting by his own will out of obstinacy, the cursing by Vasiṣṭha's sons saying 'Become a caṇḍāla!'; instantly becoming a caṇḍāla because of that curse, and grieving with remorse, by Triśaṅku's command the consecration of Triśaṅku's eldest son Hariścandra to the kingship by his ministers; and that Triśaṅku's journey on foot into the great forest. ... 4

5.279.s: 4 araṇye gacchataścaṇḍālasya triśaṅkorviśvāmitrāśrame gamanam, tato viśvāmitreṇa sarva- vṛttāntaṃ śrutvā spardhayā 'tvāmanenaiva dehena svarga neṣyāmi 'ḥ iti pratijñāṃ kṛtvā tena caṇḍālena sākaṃ tasya pāpanirasanāyānekatīrthakṣetreṣu bhramaṇam, bhramatostayormā- rkaṇḍayena samaṃ saṃvādaḥ, mārkaṇḍeyavacanāddhāṭakeśvare gamanam, hāṭakeśvaraliṃgapū janena triśaṃkoścaṇḍālatvanivṛttiḥ, tataḥ svargaprāptikaraṃ yajñaṃ kartuṃ tayorbrahmānujñā- grahaṇam...... ..... ... 5
5.279.d: 4 अरण्ये गच्छतश्चण्डालस्य त्रिशङ्कोर्विश्वामित्राश्रमे गमनम्, ततो विश्वामित्रेण सर्व- वृत्तान्तं श्रुत्वा स्पर्धया ऽत्वामनेनैव देहेन स्वर्ग नेष्यामि ऽः इति प्रतिज्ञां कृत्वा तेन चण्डालेन साकं तस्य पापनिरसनायानेकतीर्थक्षेत्रेषु भ्रमणम्, भ्रमतोस्तयोर्मा- र्कण्डयेन समं संवादः, मार्कण्डेयवचनाद्धाटकेश्वरे गमनम्, हाटकेश्वरलिंगपू जनेन त्रिशंकोश्चण्डालत्वनिवृत्तिः, ततः स्वर्गप्राप्तिकरं यज्ञं कर्तुं तयोर्ब्रह्मानुज्ञा- ग्रहणम्...... ..... ... 5
5.279.m: 4 The journey of the caṇḍāla Triśaṅku walking in the forest to the hermitage of Viśvāmitra; then Viśvāmitra, having heard the whole story, making a rival vow: 'I shall lead you to heaven in this very body!'; his wandering with that caṇḍāla across many sacred fords and sacred fields to remove his sin; the conversation between the two wandering [men] and Mārkaṇḍeya; their going to Hāṭakeśvara on Mārkaṇḍeya's word; the cessation of Triśaṅku's state as a caṇḍāla through worship of the Hāṭakeśvara liṅga; then their obtaining Brahmā's permission to perform a sacrifice that grants heaven. ... 5

5.279.s: 5 brahmaṇā tathā karaṇe'nujñāyāmadattāyāmapi viśvāmitreṇa triśaṃkoḥ saśarīreṇa svarga- prāptaye svatapaḥprabhāvāddvādaśavārṣikaṃ satraṃ brāhmaṇadvārā samāpya tato'nte'vabhṛtha- snānādikaṃ kṛtvā yajñasamāptikaraṇam. .. 6
5.279.d: 5 ब्रह्मणा तथा करणेऽनुज्ञायामदत्तायामपि विश्वामित्रेण त्रिशंकोः सशरीरेण स्वर्ग- प्राप्तये स्वतपःप्रभावाद्द्वादशवार्षिकं सत्रं ब्राह्मणद्वारा समाप्य ततोऽन्तेऽवभृथ- स्नानादिकं कृत्वा यज्ञसमाप्तिकरणम्. .. 6
5.279.m: 5 Even though Brahmā did not give permission to do so, Viśvāmitra, in order for Triśaṅku to attain heaven in his physical body, by the power of his own austerity, had a twelve-year sacrificial session completed through brahmins, and then at its end performed the ritual post-bath ablutions and brought the sacrifice to completion. .. 6

5.279.s: 6 svargaprāptyabhāvādviśvāmitraṃ prati praśnaṃ kurvatastriśaṃkorviṣṇuṃ stutvā tato varaṃ gṛhītvā viśvāmitradattaṃ nūtanasvargaṃ racayitvā saśarīreṇa svargaṃ prati gamanam.... .. 7
5.279.d: 6 स्वर्गप्राप्त्यभावाद्विश्वामित्रं प्रति प्रश्नं कुर्वतस्त्रिशंकोर्विष्णुं स्तुत्वा ततो वरं गृहीत्वा विश्वामित्रदत्तं नूतनस्वर्गं रचयित्वा सशरीरेण स्वर्गं प्रति गमनम्.... .. 7
5.279.m: 6 Because of the non-attainment of heaven, for Triśaṅku who questioned Viśvāmitra, [Viśvāmitra's] praising Viṣṇu and receiving a boon from him, fashioning a new heaven created by Viśvāmitra, and [Triśaṅku's] going to heaven in his physical body. ... 7

5.279.s: 7 viśvāmitrakṛtasṛṣṭyā brahmasṛṣṭyā sākaṃ parasparavivādaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ brahmābhyāśe gamanam, tato brahmādīnāṃ jagatsthityarthaṃ viśvāmitrasamīpe gamanam, viśvāmitra-vacanādananyagatikatvāttriśaṃkoḥ svarge gamanam, viśvāmitrasya nūtanasṛṣṭeḥ sveccha-yā nivatarnam, triśaṃkūpākhyānopasaṃhāraśca...... 7
5.279.d: 7 विश्वामित्रकृतसृष्ट्या ब्रह्मसृष्ट्या साकं परस्परविवादं दृष्ट्वा देवानां ब्रह्माभ्याशे गमनम्, ततो ब्रह्मादीनां जगत्स्थित्यर्थं विश्वामित्रसमीपे गमनम्, विश्वामित्र-वचनादनन्यगतिकत्वात्त्रिशंकोः स्वर्गे गमनम्, विश्वामित्रस्य नूतनसृष्टेः स्वेच्छ-या निवतर्नम्, त्रिशंकूपाख्यानोपसंहारश्च...... 7
5.279.m: 7 Seeing the mutual conflict of the creation made by Viśvāmitra with Brahmā's creation, the gods' going near Brahmā; then Brahmā and the others' going near Viśvāmitra for the preservation of the world; because of Viśvāmitra's word and having no other recourse, Triśaṅku's entry into heaven; Viśvāmitra's voluntary revocation of his new creation; and the conclusion of the story of Triśaṅku. ... 7

5.279.s: 8 hāṭakeśvaraprabhāvaṃ śrutvā sarvajanānāṃ tatra gamanam, viśvāmitrasyāpi kurukṣetraṃ tyaktvā tatraiva vāsaḥ, yajñādīnakṛtvāpi mokṣaprāptidamidaṃ kṣetramiti matvā devājñayā hāṭa-keśvarasya pātāle sthāpanam, tena nāgānāmapi tadbilena sarvatra gamanam, hāṭake-śvaramāhātmyavarṇane hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutayā ramānāmnyā putraprāptyartha viṣṇumuddiśya tapaścaraṇam, viṣṇukṛpayā tato vṛtrāsurotpattiḥ, indrādibhirvṛtravadhārthaṃ kṛtayā viṣṇaprārthanayā tadvacanādvajrotpādanārthaṃ dadhīcyagre gamanam, dadhīcyasthinirmitava-jreṇa vṛtrasya parājayaḥ, tajjanyabrahmahatyādoṣanirāsārthaṃ śakrasya hāṭakeśvare gamanam, hāṭakeśvarapūjanena doṣanivṛttiḥ, svasthāne gamanam, hāṭakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam 8
5.279.d: 8 हाटकेश्वरप्रभावं श्रुत्वा सर्वजनानां तत्र गमनम्, विश्वामित्रस्यापि कुरुक्षेत्रं त्यक्त्वा तत्रैव वासः, यज्ञादीनकृत्वापि मोक्षप्राप्तिदमिदं क्षेत्रमिति मत्वा देवाज्ञया हाट-केश्वरस्य पाताले स्थापनम्, तेन नागानामपि तद्बिलेन सर्वत्र गमनम्, हाटके-श्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णने हिरण्यकशिपोः सुतया रमानाम्न्या पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थ विष्णुमुद्दिश्य तपश्चरणम्, विष्णुकृपया ततो वृत्रासुरोत्पत्तिः, इन्द्रादिभिर्वृत्रवधार्थं कृतया विष्णप्रार्थनया तद्वचनाद्वज्रोत्पादनार्थं दधीच्यग्रे गमनम्, दधीच्यस्थिनिर्मितव-ज्रेण वृत्रस्य पराजयः, तज्जन्यब्रह्महत्यादोषनिरासार्थं शक्रस्य हाटकेश्वरे गमनम्, हाटकेश्वरपूजनेन दोषनिवृत्तिः, स्वस्थाने गमनम्, हाटकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 8
5.279.m: 8 Hearing of the power of Hāṭakeśvara, all people going there; Viśvāmitra too abandoning Kurukṣetra and dwelling there alone; considering this sacred field to bestow liberation even without performing sacrifices and the like, the installation of Hāṭakeśvara in Pātāla by order of the gods; thereby the serpents too going everywhere through that chasm; in the description of the māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara, the performing of austerities dedicated to Viṣṇu by Hiraṇyakaśipu's daughter named Ramā to obtain a son; by the grace of Viṣṇu, the origin of the demon Vṛtra from that; by the prayer to Viṣṇu made by Indra and the gods to kill Vṛtra, going before Dadhīci on his word to produce the vajra; the defeat of Vṛtra with the vajra made from Dadhīci's bones; Śakra's going to Hāṭakeśvara to dispel the sin of killing a brahmin born of that; by the worship of Hāṭakeśvara the cessation of the fault; going to his own abode; the description of the māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara. 8

5.279.s: 9 śakreṇa nāgabilapūrtaye saṃvartānilasya preṣaṇam, śakrājñayā saṃvartānilasya nāgabile gamanam , liṃgodbhavaśāpena bhītasya saṃvartānilasya śakrapuraṃ pratyāgamanam, tato bṛha-spaterājñayā śakrasya himālayaputrānbilapūrtikaraṇārtha preṣituṃ himālayasannidhau gama-nam, śakrakāryaṃ kartuṃ himālayenājñāpitānāmapyasvīkṛtājñānāṃ mainākanaṃdivardhana-raktaśṛṃgākhyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ putrāṇāmananumodanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tebhyaḥ śakreṇa śāpapradānam, śāpabhītyā raktaśṛṃgākhyaparvatasya nāgabilapūrtikaraṇārthaṃ tatra gamanam, tato devendreṇa raktaśṛṃgākhyaparvatasya sukhajanakānāmanekatīrthānāṃ saṃsthāpanam, śakrakṛtaraktaśṛṃga-śikharotsāhavarṇanam... ..-. ........ 11 1
5.279.d: 9 शक्रेण नागबिलपूर्तये संवर्तानिलस्य प्रेषणम्, शक्राज्ञया संवर्तानिलस्य नागबिले गमनम् , लिंगोद्भवशापेन भीतस्य संवर्तानिलस्य शक्रपुरं प्रत्यागमनम्, ततो बृह-स्पतेराज्ञया शक्रस्य हिमालयपुत्रान्बिलपूर्तिकरणार्थ प्रेषितुं हिमालयसन्निधौ गम-नम्, शक्रकार्यं कर्तुं हिमालयेनाज्ञापितानामप्यस्वीकृताज्ञानां मैनाकनंदिवर्धन-रक्तशृंगाख्यानां त्रयाणां पुत्राणामननुमोदनं दृष्ट्वा तेभ्यः शक्रेण शापप्रदानम्, शापभीत्या रक्तशृंगाख्यपर्वतस्य नागबिलपूर्तिकरणार्थं तत्र गमनम्, ततो देवेन्द्रेण रक्तशृंगाख्यपर्वतस्य सुखजनकानामनेकतीर्थानां संस्थापनम्, शक्रकृतरक्तशृंग-शिखरोत्साहवर्णनम्... ..-. ........ 11 1
5.279.m: 9 The sending of the Saṃvarta wind by Śakra to fill the serpent chasm; on Śakra's command, the Saṃvarta wind going to the serpent chasm; terrified by the curse of the manifestation of the liṅga, the Saṃvarta wind's return to Śakra's city; then by the order of Bṛhaspati, Śakra's going into the presence of Himālaya to send the sons of Himālaya to fill the chasm; seeing the refusal of the three sons named Maināka, Nandivardhana, and Raktaśṛṅga, who did not accept the order even when ordered by Himālaya to perform Śakra's task, the laying of a curse upon them by Śakra; out of fear of the curse, the going there of the mountain named Raktaśṛṅga to fill the serpent chasm; then the establishment by Devendra of many sacred fords that produce happiness on the mountain named Raktaśṛṅga; the description of the festive celebration for the summit of Raktaśṛṅga made by Śakra. ... 11 1

5.279.s: 10 śaṃkhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇane camatkāranṛpasya mṛgayākaraṇam, tatra bubhukṣitasya bālasyastanaṃ dadatyā mṛgyāścamatkāreṇa vadhakaraṇam, mṛgīdattaśāpena camatkāranṛpateḥ kuṣṭharogaprāptiḥ, tatkuṣṭhasya śāpasya ca nibarhaṇārthaṃ bhramataścamatkāranṛpaterhāṭakeśvarakṣetre śaṃkhatīrthe gamanam, śaṃkhartārthasnānena camatkāranṛpateḥ kuṣṭhanirāsavarṇanam, śaṃkha-tīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam... . 12
5.279.d: 10 शंखतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णने चमत्कारनृपस्य मृगयाकरणम्, तत्र बुभुक्षितस्य बालस्यस्तनं ददत्या मृग्याश्चमत्कारेण वधकरणम्, मृगीदत्तशापेन चमत्कारनृपतेः कुष्ठरोगप्राप्तिः, तत्कुष्ठस्य शापस्य च निबर्हणार्थं भ्रमतश्चमत्कारनृपतेर्हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे शंखतीर्थे गमनम्, शंखर्तार्थस्नानेन चमत्कारनृपतेः कुष्ठनिरासवर्णनम्, शंख-तीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... . 12
5.279.m: 10 In the description of the māhātmya of Śaṅkhatīrtha, King Camatkāra's hunting; Camatkāra's killing there of a doe who was suckling a hungry fawn; King Camatkāra's contracting of leprosy through the curse given by the doe; King Camatkāra's going to Śaṅkhatīrtha in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara while wandering to remove that leprosy and curse; the description of the dispelling of King Camatkāra's leprosy through ritual ablution in Śaṅkhatīrtha; the description of the māhātmya of Śaṅkhatīrtha. ... 12

5.279.s: 11 camatkāranṛpaṛṣisaṃvāde śaṃkhatīrthotpattivṛttānte śaṃkhakṛtena likhitāśramavṛkṣodbhūtapha-lagrahaṇena cauryamidamiti matvā likhitena śaṃkhahastacchedanakaraṇam , tataḥ śaṃkhasya hāṭakeśvare tapaścaraṇam, tattapastuṣṭena śivena śaṃkhāya varapradānam, pūrvavattatpuṇyena hastaprāptikathanam, tatra tena svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, śaṃkhatīrthotpattivarṇanapūrvakaṃ śaṃkhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam, camatkārabhūpatinā brāhmaṇebhyo nagaraṃ nirmāpayitvā dānakaraṇama.......... 12
5.279.d: 11 चमत्कारनृपऋषिसंवादे शंखतीर्थोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्ते शंखकृतेन लिखिताश्रमवृक्षोद्भूतफ-लग्रहणेन चौर्यमिदमिति मत्वा लिखितेन शंखहस्तच्छेदनकरणम् , ततः शंखस्य हाटकेश्वरे तपश्चरणम्, तत्तपस्तुष्टेन शिवेन शंखाय वरप्रदानम्, पूर्ववत्तत्पुण्येन हस्तप्राप्तिकथनम्, तत्र तेन स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, शंखतीर्थोत्पत्तिवर्णनपूर्वकं शंखतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, चमत्कारभूपतिना ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नगरं निर्मापयित्वा दानकरणम.......... 12
5.279.m: 11 In the conversation between King Camatkāra and the sage, in the account of the origin of Śaṅkhatīrtha: Śaṅkha taking the fruit that grew on a tree in Likhita's hermitage, and Likhita, considering this to be theft, cutting off Śaṅkha's hands; then Śaṅkha's performing austerities at Hāṭakeśvara; Śiva, pleased by that austerity, granting a boon to Śaṅkha; the account of obtaining hands as before through that merit; his establishing there a liṅga under his own name; the description of the māhātmya of Śaṅkhatīrtha preceded by the account of the origin of Śaṅkhatīrtha; King Camatkāra having a city built and gifting it to brahmins. ... 12

5.279.s: 12 camatkāreṇa bhūpena brāhmaṇājñayā nagarasthityarthaṃ putropadeśakaraṇam, brahmadattāśīrvāda- grahaṇam-........ 14
5.279.d: 12 चमत्कारेण भूपेन ब्राह्मणाज्ञया नगरस्थित्यर्थं पुत्रोपदेशकरणम्, ब्रह्मदत्ताशीर्वाद- ग्रहणम्-........ 14
5.279.m: 12 King Camatkāra instructing his sons for the maintenance of the city by command of the brahmins; the receiving of the blessing given by Brahmā. ... 14

5.279.s: 13 svarājyaṃ putreṣu nikṣipya tapaḥkaraṇārthaṃ camatkāranṛpaterhāṭakeśvare gamanam, tatra śiva-mārādhya śivaprasādena acaleśvaretināmnā liṃgasthāpanam; acaleśvaramāhātmya-varṇanam......... .. .... 14
5.279.d: 13 स्वराज्यं पुत्रेषु निक्षिप्य तपःकरणार्थं चमत्कारनृपतेर्हाटकेश्वरे गमनम्, तत्र शिव-माराध्य शिवप्रसादेन अचलेश्वरेतिनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्; अचलेश्वरमाहात्म्य-वर्णनम्......... .. .... 14
5.279.m: 13 King Camatkāra entrusting his kingdom to his sons and going to Hāṭakeśvara to perform austerities; worshiping Śiva there and establishing a liṅga named Acaleśvara by Śiva's grace; the description of the māhātmya of Acaleśvara. ... 14

5.279.s: 14 camatkārapure kasyacidgorakṣakasya goyūthādekasyā goraraṇye tṛṇalobhena gamanam, tasyāḥ śodhanārthaṃ gorakṣakasyāpyaraṇye gamanam, tataḥ kālāntareṇa dvayoḥ pañcatvaprāptivarṇa- nam, tato gorakṣakasya daśārṇādhipateḥ kule janmavarṇanam, tathā gostanmaṃtrekule jananam, tatastābhyāṃ pūrvajanmavṛttāntasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā camatkārapurapradakṣiṇākaraṇena vaimānikapathā mokṣaprāpaṇam, camatkārapurapradakṣiṇāmāhātmyavarṇanam 15 15 raktaśṛṃgaparvataprabhāvavarṇanapūrvakaṃ camatkārapurapradakṣiṇāmāhātmyātiśayavarṇanam. 16
5.279.d: 14 चमत्कारपुरे कस्यचिद्गोरक्षकस्य गोयूथादेकस्या गोररण्ये तृणलोभेन गमनम्, तस्याः शोधनार्थं गोरक्षकस्याप्यरण्ये गमनम्, ततः कालान्तरेण द्वयोः पञ्चत्वप्राप्तिवर्ण- नम्, ततो गोरक्षकस्य दशार्णाधिपतेः कुले जन्मवर्णनम्, तथा गोस्तन्मंत्रेकुले जननम्, ततस्ताभ्यां पूर्वजन्मवृत्तान्तस्मरणं कृत्वा चमत्कारपुरप्रदक्षिणाकरणेन वैमानिकपथा मोक्षप्रापणम्, चमत्कारपुरप्रदक्षिणामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 15 15 रक्तशृंगपर्वतप्रभाववर्णनपूर्वकं चमत्कारपुरप्रदक्षिणामाहात्म्यातिशयवर्णनम्. 16
5.279.m: 14. Description of a cow straying into the forest out of longing for grass from a herd belonging to a certain cowherd in Camatkārapura; the cowherd's departure into the forest to seek her; then, after a passage of time, the two meeting their deaths; then the description of the cowherd's birth into the family of the ruler of Daśārṇa, and the cow's birth into that king's minister's family; then their recollecting the events of their previous life, performing circumambulation of Camatkārapura, and attaining liberation by the path of aerial chariots; description of the māhātmya of circumambulating Camatkārapura. 15. / 15. Preceded by a description of the power of Mount Raktaśṛṅga, description of the surpassing greatness of the circumambulation of Camatkārapura. 16.

5.279.s: 16 raktaśṛṃgasānnidhye sthitvā raktaśṛṃgasya sevanaphalaśraiṣṭhyavarṇanam 16 2
5.279.d: 16 रक्तशृंगसान्निध्ये स्थित्वा रक्तशृंगस्य सेवनफलश्रैष्ठ्यवर्णनम् 16 2
5.279.m: 16. Description of the superior fruits of serving Raktaśṛṅga by staying in the presence of Raktaśṛṅga. 16 2

5.279.s: 17 camatkārapurasya caturdikṣu sthitānāṃ tīrthānāṃ varṇanam , tatrādau gayāśiromāhātmya-varṇanaprasaṃge vidūrathasya mṛgayāyāmaraṇye gamanam, tatra mṛgānanudhāvato vidūrathasya vanādvanaṃ prayāṇena śrāntasyāśvasya bhūmyāṃ patanam, tato vidūrathasya tatraivāśvamu-tsṛjya padbhyāṃ mṛgānucaṃkramaṇam ...........................16
5.279.d: 17 चमत्कारपुरस्य चतुर्दिक्षु स्थितानां तीर्थानां वर्णनम् , तत्रादौ गयाशिरोमाहात्म्य-वर्णनप्रसंगे विदूरथस्य मृगयायामरण्ये गमनम्, तत्र मृगाननुधावतो विदूरथस्य वनाद्वनं प्रयाणेन श्रान्तस्याश्वस्य भूम्यां पतनम्, ततो विदूरथस्य तत्रैवाश्वमु-त्सृज्य पद्भ्यां मृगानुचंक्रमणम् ...........................16
5.279.m: 17. Description of the sacred fords situated in the four directions of Camatkārapura; therein, first, in the context of describing the Gayāśiras-māhātmya, King Vidūratha's departure to the forest on a hunt; there, as Vidūratha pursues the deer, the collapse of his exhausted horse to the ground after journeying from forest to forest; then Vidūratha abandoning the horse right there and pursuing the deer on foot. 16

5.279.s: 18 tato dūragamanottaraṃ pathi māṃsādādipiśācatrayadarśanam, māṃsādādivacanādṛṣyā-śramapadaṃ prāptasya vidūrathasya nṛpasya munibhiḥ saha saṃvādapūrvakaṃ sāyantanakarmādi-vidhānavarṇanam... ... ......... 17 1
5.279.d: 18 ततो दूरगमनोत्तरं पथि मांसादादिपिशाचत्रयदर्शनम्, मांसादादिवचनादृष्या-श्रमपदं प्राप्तस्य विदूरथस्य नृपस्य मुनिभिः सह संवादपूर्वकं सायन्तनकर्मादि-विधानवर्णनम्... ... ......... 17 1
5.279.m: 18. Then, after traveling far, [his] sighting of three piśācas, including Māṃsāda, on the path; on the words of Māṃsāda and the others, King Vidūratha reaching the site of the hermitage of seers, and preceded by a dialogue with the sages, the description of the performance of the evening rites and other ceremonies. 17 1

5.279.s: 19 pare'hani vidūrathasya svanagare gamanam, gayāśirasi pitṛtīrthakūpikāyāṃ vidūrathena māṃsādādibhyaḥ śrāddhadānam, tato māṃsādādibhirvidūrathasya svapre svasvamuktikatha- nam, pitṛkūpikātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam ........ 19 2
5.279.d: 19 परेऽहनि विदूरथस्य स्वनगरे गमनम्, गयाशिरसि पितृतीर्थकूपिकायां विदूरथेन मांसादादिभ्यः श्राद्धदानम्, ततो मांसादादिभिर्विदूरथस्य स्वप्रे स्वस्वमुक्तिकथ- नम्, पितृकूपिकातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ........ 19 2
5.279.m: 19. On the next day, Vidūratha's return to his city; Vidūratha's offering of funeral rites (śrāddha) for Māṃsāda and the others at the Pitṛtīrtha well at Gayāśiras; then the narration of their own liberation by Māṃsāda and the others in Vidūratha's dream; description of the māhātmya of the Pitṛkūpikā sacred ford. 19 2

5.279.s: 20 pitṛkūpikātīrthe rāmalakṣmaṇasītānāṃ gamanam ,tatra śrāddhakaraṇena rāmādīnāṃ pratyakṣapi-tṛdarśanam, tato manasi rāmaṃ sītāṃ ca hantuṃ viśvāsaghātaṃ kartuṃ ca pravartamānasya lakṣmaṇasya viśvāsaghātadoṣanirāsārthaṃ bālamaṇḍanatīrthe gamanam , tattīrthasnānena tasya doṣanivṛttiḥ, tato rāmakṛtaṃ yāmyadiśi prayāṇam, bālamaṇḍanatīrthamāhātmya-varṇanam......... . 20 2
5.279.d: 20 पितृकूपिकातीर्थे रामलक्ष्मणसीतानां गमनम् ,तत्र श्राद्धकरणेन रामादीनां प्रत्यक्षपि-तृदर्शनम्, ततो मनसि रामं सीतां च हन्तुं विश्वासघातं कर्तुं च प्रवर्तमानस्य लक्ष्मणस्य विश्वासघातदोषनिरासार्थं बालमण्डनतीर्थे गमनम् , तत्तीर्थस्नानेन तस्य दोषनिवृत्तिः, ततो रामकृतं याम्यदिशि प्रयाणम्, बालमण्डनतीर्थमाहात्म्य-वर्णनम्......... . 20 2
5.279.m: 20. The journey of Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, and Sītā to the Pitṛkūpikā sacred ford; by performing the funeral rites there, the direct appearance of their ancestors to Rāma and the others; then Lakṣmaṇa, whose mind became inclined to slay Rāma and Sītā and commit treason, going to the Bālamaṇḍana sacred ford in order to dispel the fault of treason; the removal of his fault by bathing in that sacred ford; then the journey south undertaken by Rāma; description of the māhātmya of the Bālamaṇḍana sacred ford. 20 2

5.279.s: 21 bālasakhyatīrthotpattivarṇane mṛkaṇḍato mārkaṇḍasutotpattivarṇanapūrvakaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ prāpya tapastaptvā hāṭakeśvare liṃgasthāpanam, bālasakhyatīrthamāhātmya-varṇanam. .... .... 22 1
5.279.d: 21 बालसख्यतीर्थोत्पत्तिवर्णने मृकण्डतो मार्कण्डसुतोत्पत्तिवर्णनपूर्वकं मार्कण्डेयेन दीर्घायुष्ट्वं प्राप्य तपस्तप्त्वा हाटकेश्वरे लिंगस्थापनम्, बालसख्यतीर्थमाहात्म्य-वर्णनम्. .... .... 22 1
5.279.m: 21. In describing the origin of the Bālasakhya sacred ford, preceded by the description of the birth of the son Mārkaṇḍeya from Mṛkaṇḍu, Mārkaṇḍeya attaining a long life, performing austerities, and establishing a liṅga at Hāṭakeśvara; description of the māhātmya of the Bālasakhya sacred ford. 22 1

5.279.s: 22 bālamaṇḍanatīrthamāhātmye kaśyapādditerekonapañcāśanmarutāmutpattivarṇane śakreṇa diti-jaṭharaṃ praviśya śastreṇa putracchedanādivarṇanam, tena mātṛdroheṇa taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ śakreṇa bālamaṇḍanatīrthe snānakaraṇam, śakrasya tīrthasnānena doṣanivṛttiḥ, bālamaṇḍanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam... .... 24 1
5.279.d: 22 बालमण्डनतीर्थमाहात्म्ये कश्यपाद्दितेरेकोनपञ्चाशन्मरुतामुत्पत्तिवर्णने शक्रेण दिति-जठरं प्रविश्य शस्त्रेण पुत्रच्छेदनादिवर्णनम्, तेन मातृद्रोहेण तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं शक्रेण बालमण्डनतीर्थे स्नानकरणम्, शक्रस्य तीर्थस्नानेन दोषनिवृत्तिः, बालमण्डनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... .... 24 1
5.279.m: 22. In the māhātmya of the Bālamaṇḍana sacred ford, in the account of the birth of the forty-nine Maruts from Diti by Kaśyapa, Indra's entering Diti's womb and cutting the embryo with a weapon, and other deeds; to dispel the fault of that transgression against his mother, Indra's bathing at the Bālamaṇḍana sacred ford; the removal of Indra's fault by bathing in the sacred ford; description of the māhātmya of the Bālamaṇḍana sacred ford. 24 1

5.279.s: 23 mṛgatīrthavarṇane kasyacidvṛkṣasyacchāyāyāṃ saṃsthitānmṛgāndṛṣṭvā luvdhakānāṃ tatrāgamanam, lubdhakadarśanena bhītānāṃ mṛgānāṃ tataḥ palāyanam, lubdhakānāṃ mṛgānudhāvanam, mṛgānāṃ sarovarapraveśanena sadya eva mānuṣatva prāptiḥ, tatsaraḥprabhāvaṃ mṛgamukhā-cchrutvā lubdhakairapi tasminsarasi snānakaraṇam, tena lubdhakānāmapi saundarya-prāptiḥ, sarveṣāṃ mokṣaprāptivarṇanam, mṛgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam . 25 1
5.279.d: 23 मृगतीर्थवर्णने कस्यचिद्वृक्षस्यच्छायायां संस्थितान्मृगान्दृष्ट्वा लुव्धकानां तत्रागमनम्, लुब्धकदर्शनेन भीतानां मृगानां ततः पलायनम्, लुब्धकानां मृगानुधावनम्, मृगानां सरोवरप्रवेशनेन सद्य एव मानुषत्व प्राप्तिः, तत्सरःप्रभावं मृगमुखा-च्छ्रुत्वा लुब्धकैरपि तस्मिन्सरसि स्नानकरणम्, तेन लुब्धकानामपि सौन्दर्य-प्राप्तिः, सर्वेषां मोक्षप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, मृगतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् . 25 1
5.279.m: 23. In describing the Mṛgatīrtha, hunters arriving there after seeing deer standing in the shade of a tree; the flight of the deer from there, terrified at the sight of the hunters; the hunters pursuing the deer; the deer immediately attaining human form upon entering a lake; hearing the power of that lake from the mouth of a deer, the hunters also bathing in that lake; thereby the hunters too attaining beauty; description of all of them attaining liberation; description of the māhātmya of the Mṛgatīrtha. 25 1

5.279.s: 24 balinigrahasamaye vāmanena padadvayena lokānvyāpya tṛtīyapadena. brahmāṇḍordhvabhāge bhinne sati tato gaṅgājalasya nirgamanam, viṣṇupadatīrthotpattipūrvakamāhātmya- varṇanam... .... 25 2 25 viṣṇupadīgaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇane madyaprāśanaṃ kurvataḥ kasyacidbrāhmaṇasya tatra snānena madya- prāśanadoṣanivṛttivarṇanam, viṣṇupadīgaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇanam .. 26 2
5.279.d: 24 बलिनिग्रहसमये वामनेन पदद्वयेन लोकान्व्याप्य तृतीयपदेन. ब्रह्माण्डोर्ध्वभागे भिन्ने सति ततो गङ्गाजलस्य निर्गमनम्, विष्णुपदतीर्थोत्पत्तिपूर्वकमाहात्म्य- वर्णनम्... .... 25 2 25 विष्णुपदीगंगामाहात्म्यवर्णने मद्यप्राशनं कुर्वतः कस्यचिद्ब्राह्मणस्य तत्र स्नानेन मद्य- प्राशनदोषनिवृत्तिवर्णनम्, विष्णुपदीगंगामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् .. 26 2
5.279.m: 24. At the time of subduing Bali, Vāmana covering the worlds with two steps, and when the upper part of the cosmic egg was pierced with the third step, the flowing forth of the water of the Gaṅgā; the origin and māhātmya of the Viṣṇupada sacred ford. 25 2 / 25. In the description of the māhātmya of the Viṣṇupadī Gaṅgā, the description of the removal of the sin of drinking liquor for a certain brahmin by bathing there; description of the māhātmya of the Viṣṇupadī Gaṅgā. 26 2

5.279.s: 26 kasyacidgokarṇabrāhmaṇasya yamānuśāsanādāgatairyamadūtaiḥ saha yamaloke gamanam, tatra gokarṇapṛcchayā yamena dvāviṃśatinarakavarṇanam, kena pātakena kasya narakasya prāpti-riti varṇanam, gokarṇasya yamānujñayā camatkārapure gamanam, tatra tīrthasnānena muktivarṇanam, gokarṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam... ... 27 2
5.279.d: 26 कस्यचिद्गोकर्णब्राह्मणस्य यमानुशासनादागतैर्यमदूतैः सह यमलोके गमनम्, तत्र गोकर्णपृच्छया यमेन द्वाविंशतिनरकवर्णनम्, केन पातकेन कस्य नरकस्य प्राप्ति-रिति वर्णनम्, गोकर्णस्य यमानुज्ञया चमत्कारपुरे गमनम्, तत्र तीर्थस्नानेन मुक्तिवर्णनम्, गोकर्णतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... ... 27 2
5.279.m: 26. A certain brahmin Gokarṇa going to the world of Yama along with Yama's messengers who arrived by Yama's order; there, at Gokarṇa's questioning, Yama's description of the twenty-two hells; description of which hell is attained through which sin; by Yama's permission, Gokarṇa's arrival in Camatkārapura; description of his liberation through bathing in the sacred ford there; description of the māhātmya of the Gokarṇatīrtha. 27 2

5.279.s: 27 aṇvādicaturyugāntakālaparigaṇanam, caturyugasvarūpamāhātmyapramāṇanidarśanam, cāturvarṇyakarmanirūpaṇam, rajakādicaṇḍālānāmutpattivarṇanam, viśeṣataḥ kalikāla- māhātmyavarṇanam 29 2
5.279.d: 27 अण्वादिचतुर्युगान्तकालपरिगणनम्, चतुर्युगस्वरूपमाहात्म्यप्रमाणनिदर्शनम्, चातुर्वर्ण्यकर्मनिरूपणम्, रजकादिचण्डालानामुत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, विशेषतः कलिकाल- माहात्म्यवर्णनम् 29 2
5.279.m: 27. Reckoning of time from the subtle atom up to the end of the four yugas; presentation of the nature, greatness, and measure of the four yugas; exposition of the duties of the four classes; description of the origin of washermen, caṇḍālas, and others; description, in particular, of the greatness of the Kali age. 29 2

5.279.s: 28 bṛhaspatīndrasaṃvāde sarvatīrthasamāśrayavarṇanam.. 31 2
5.279.d: 28 बृहस्पतीन्द्रसंवादे सर्वतीर्थसमाश्रयवर्णनम्.. 31 2
5.279.m: 28. In the dialogue between Bṛhaspati and Indra, description of the refuge of all sacred fords. 31 2

5.279.s: 29 siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇane sūtasya piturājñayā vatsamaharṣiśuśrūṣākaraṇam, tatra vatsa- maharṣiṇā svasya prāgjanmacaritrakathanam, devarātasya muneragre snātuṃ vivastrāṃ kāñcitstriyaṃ vilokya jale retaḥskhalanam, tadretaso mṛgyā prāśanam, daśamāsānte mṛgītaḥ kanyājananam, devarātena vatsarṣaye kanyādānam, bahukāle gate sarpadaṃśanena strīmaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bahuśokavyākulitacetaso vatsasya vane prayāṇam, tasya bahudhā ṛṣibhiḥ sāntvane kṛte'pi krudhā sarpanāśanāraṃbhakaraṇam, tasminsarpahananaṃ kurvati sati tatraikasya sarpasya mānuṣarūpaṃ dhṛtvā saṃvādavarṇanam, tena mānuṣarūpa- -dhāriṇā sarpeṇa vatsāya pūrvaśāpakāraṇe kathyamāne prāgjanmani mayā hāṭakeśvara- kṣetrayātrāgatānāṃ janasamūhānāṃ madhye sarpaprakṣepe kṛte satyṛṣiṇā dattena śāpena sarpajanmaprāptiḥ iti kathanam tena mānuṣarūpiṇā sarpeṇa vatsāyopadeśakaraṇam, tatpra saṃgena hiṃsā'hiṃsādharmanirūpaṇam, tato vatsarṣiṇā sarpavadhapaścāttāpena maheśvara- pūjāṃ vidhātuṃ svamanasi nirdhāraṇam, vatsasya siddheśvarapūjanena siddhiprāpti-varṇanam........... 32 1
5.279.d: 29 सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णने सूतस्य पितुराज्ञया वत्समहर्षिशुश्रूषाकरणम्, तत्र वत्स- महर्षिणा स्वस्य प्राग्जन्मचरित्रकथनम्, देवरातस्य मुनेरग्रे स्नातुं विवस्त्रां काञ्चित्स्त्रियं विलोक्य जले रेतःस्खलनम्, तद्रेतसो मृग्या प्राशनम्, दशमासान्ते मृगीतः कन्याजननम्, देवरातेन वत्सर्षये कन्यादानम्, बहुकाले गते सर्पदंशनेन स्त्रीमरणं दृष्ट्वा बहुशोकव्याकुलितचेतसो वत्सस्य वने प्रयाणम्, तस्य बहुधा ऋषिभिः सान्त्वने कृतेऽपि क्रुधा सर्पनाशनारंभकरणम्, तस्मिन्सर्पहननं कुर्वति सति तत्रैकस्य सर्पस्य मानुषरूपं धृत्वा संवादवर्णनम्, तेन मानुषरूप- -धारिणा सर्पेण वत्साय पूर्वशापकारणे कथ्यमाने प्राग्जन्मनि मया हाटकेश्वर- क्षेत्रयात्रागतानां जनसमूहानां मध्ये सर्पप्रक्षेपे कृते सत्यृषिणा दत्तेन शापेन सर्पजन्मप्राप्तिः इति कथनम् तेन मानुषरूपिणा सर्पेण वत्सायोपदेशकरणम्, तत्प्र संगेन हिंसाऽहिंसाधर्मनिरूपणम्, ततो वत्सर्षिणा सर्पवधपश्चात्तापेन महेश्वर- पूजां विधातुं स्वमनसि निर्धारणम्, वत्सस्य सिद्धेश्वरपूजनेन सिद्धिप्राप्ति-वर्णनम्........... 32 1
5.279.m: 29. In the description of the māhātmya of Siddheśvara: Sūta's attendance upon the great seer Vatsa by his father's command; there, the great seer Vatsa's narration of the story of his previous birth; the discharge of semen into the water upon the sage Devarāta seeing a naked woman bathe before him; the swallowing of that semen by a female deer; the birth of a girl from the doe at the end of ten months; Devarāta giving the girl to the seer Vatsa; when a long time had passed, Vatsa seeing his wife's death by a snakebite, his mind agitated by great grief, and his departure to the forest; even though consoled in many ways by the seers, his undertaking to destroy the snakes in anger; while he was slaying the snakes, the account of the dialogue of one snake there having assumed human form; when the cause of the previous curse was told to Vatsa by that snake who had assumed human form—the statement: "In a former birth, when a snake was thrown by me into the midst of the multitudes of people who had come on pilgrimage to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, the attainment of birth as a snake [occurred] because of a curse given by a seer"; the giving of instruction to Vatsa by that snake in human form; on that occasion, the exposition of the duty of non-violence and violence; then the resolve in his own mind by the seer Vatsa to perform the worship of Maheśvara out of remorse for the slaughter of snakes; the description of Vatsa's attainment of perfections through the worship of Siddheśvara. 32 1

5.279.s: 30 siddheśvarotpattivarṇane siddhādhipanāmakahaṃsena bṛhaspatyājñayā putraprāptyartha liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjane kṛte tasya putraprāptiḥ, siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam.... 37 2
5.279.d: 30 सिद्धेश्वरोत्पत्तिवर्णने सिद्धाधिपनामकहंसेन बृहस्पत्याज्ञया पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थ लिंगं संस्थाप्य पूजने कृते तस्य पुत्रप्राप्तिः, सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... 37 2
5.279.m: 30. In the description of the origin of Siddheśvara: the hamsa named Siddhādhipa, by command of Bṛhaspati, establishing a liṅga and performing worship for the sake of obtaining a son, and his obtaining a son; the description of the māhātmya of Siddheśvara. 37 2

5.279.s: 31 nāgahradamāhātmyavarṇanaprasaṃgena navanāgānāṃ brahmājñayā hāṭakeśvarakṣetre gamanam, tatra svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, indrasenarājñaḥ sarpadaṃśanena mṛtyuprāptivarṇanam, tataḥ svaputrasya svapna āgatyendrasenena svapretatvaprāptikathanam, pitrājñayā putrasya nāgatīrthe gamanam, tatra pitṛśrāddhakaraṇena liṃgapūjanena ca piturmokṣavarṇanam, nāgatīrtha- māhātmyavarṇanam... . 38 1
5.279.d: 31 नागह्रदमाहात्म्यवर्णनप्रसंगेन नवनागानां ब्रह्माज्ञया हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे गमनम्, तत्र स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, इन्द्रसेनराज्ञः सर्पदंशनेन मृत्युप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, ततः स्वपुत्रस्य स्वप्न आगत्येन्द्रसेनेन स्वप्रेतत्वप्राप्तिकथनम्, पित्राज्ञया पुत्रस्य नागतीर्थे गमनम्, तत्र पितृश्राद्धकरणेन लिंगपूजनेन च पितुर्मोक्षवर्णनम्, नागतीर्थ- माहात्म्यवर्णनम्... . 38 1
5.279.m: 31. In the context of describing the māhātmya of Nāgahrada: the going of the nine serpents to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara by command of Brahmā; the establishment of a liṅga there in their own name; the description of King Indrasena's attainment of death by snakebite; then Indrasena coming in a dream to his son and recounting his having become a ghost; the son's going to Nāgatīrtha by his father's command; there, the description of his father's liberation through the performance of the ancestral rites for the father and the worship of the liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of Nāgatīrtha. 38 1

5.279.s: 32 saptarṣitīrthavarṇane saptarṣipūjanaprakārakathanam, saptarṣitīrthotpattivarṇane dvādaśavārṣikyā-manāvṛṣṭyāṃ bubhukṣitānāṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ sarvatra bhramaṇam, teṣāṃ vṛṣādarbhe rājño deśe gamanam, tatra mṛtakumārakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadbhakṣaṇārthaṃ saptarṣibhirudyogakaraṇam, tāva- dvṛṣādarbherbhūpasya tatrāgatya taiḥ saha saṃvādakaraṇam, tato mṛtakumāramabhakṣayitvaivarṣīṇāṃ camatkārapure gamanam, tatra taistapaḥkaraṇam , ligasthāpanaṃ ca..... 40 2
5.279.d: 32 सप्तर्षितीर्थवर्णने सप्तर्षिपूजनप्रकारकथनम्, सप्तर्षितीर्थोत्पत्तिवर्णने द्वादशवार्षिक्या-मनावृष्ट्यां बुभुक्षितानां सप्तर्षीणां सर्वत्र भ्रमणम्, तेषां वृषादर्भे राज्ञो देशे गमनम्, तत्र मृतकुमारकं दृष्ट्वा तद्भक्षणार्थं सप्तर्षिभिरुद्योगकरणम्, ताव- द्वृषादर्भेर्भूपस्य तत्रागत्य तैः सह संवादकरणम्, ततो मृतकुमारमभक्षयित्वैवर्षीणां चमत्कारपुरे गमनम्, तत्र तैस्तपःकरणम् , लिगस्थापनं च..... 40 2
5.279.m: 32. In the description of Saptarṣitīrtha: the recounting of the manner of worshipping the seven seers; in the description of the origin of Saptarṣitīrtha, the wandering everywhere of the seven seers who were starving during a twelve-year drought; their going to the country of King Vṛṣādarbhi; seeing a dead boy there, the attempt by the seven seers to eat him; King Vṛṣādarbhi arriving there meanwhile and conversing with them; then the seers going to Camatkārapura without eating the dead boy; their performing austerity there and establishing a liṅga. 40 2

5.279.s: 33 agastyāśramavarṇane vindhyamervormithaḥ kalahe saṃpadyamāne sūryamārganirodhātsūryasyāgastyā- śrame gamanam, sūryavacanādviṃdhyam̐ nimnamukhīkṛtya dakṣiṇadiśi hāṭakeśvare'gastyasya gamanam, tatra lopāmudrayā patnyā saha gatvā liṃgasthāpanam, agastyāśramamāhā- tamyavarṇanam.. .. 42 2
5.279.d: 33 अगस्त्याश्रमवर्णने विन्ध्यमेर्वोर्मिथः कलहे संपद्यमाने सूर्यमार्गनिरोधात्सूर्यस्यागस्त्या- श्रमे गमनम्, सूर्यवचनाद्विंध्यम्̐ निम्नमुखीकृत्य दक्षिणदिशि हाटकेश्वरेऽगस्त्यस्य गमनम्, तत्र लोपामुद्रया पत्न्या सह गत्वा लिंगस्थापनम्, अगस्त्याश्रममाहा- तम्यवर्णनम्.. .. 42 2
5.279.m: 33. In the description of Agastya's hermitage: when a mutual dispute arose between the Vindhya and Meru [mountains], the Sun going to Agastya's hermitage because of the obstruction of the Sun's path; making the Vindhya bow down at the Sun's word, Agastya going to Hāṭakeśvara in the southern direction; going there with his wife Lopāmudrā and establishing a liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of Agastya's hermitage. 42 2

5.279.s: 34 agastyakṛtasamudraprāśanakāraṇavarṇane prathamaṃ devadaityayoryuddhe brahmaviṣṇvindrādīnāṃ parā- jayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkareṇa śūlena daityaparājayakaraṇavarṇanam ..... 44 1
5.279.d: 34 अगस्त्यकृतसमुद्रप्राशनकारणवर्णने प्रथमं देवदैत्ययोर्युद्धे ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रादीनां परा- जयं दृष्ट्वा शंकरेण शूलेन दैत्यपराजयकरणवर्णनम् ..... 44 1
5.279.m: 34. In the description of the cause of the drinking of the ocean performed by Agastya: first, in the war between the gods and the Daityas, seeing the defeat of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Indra, and the others, the description of Śaṃkara's defeat of the Daityas with his trident. 44 1

5.279.s: 35 dharmavināśenaiva devaparājayaḥ syāditi niścayaṃ kṛtvā snānasaṃdhyāyajñayāgādijapakartṛṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ daityairvadhakaraṇam, jalāvāsināṃ daityānāṃ vadhārthaṃ brahmaṇa ājñayā jala- prāśanārthaṃ devairagastyasya prārthanākaraṇam, devakāryārthamagastyena samudraprāśanama, devai-rdaityavadhakaraṇam, agastyasthāpitapīṭhasya devaiḥ svakāryakaraṇāccitreśvarapīṭhetināma-karaṇam 44 2
5.279.d: 35 धर्मविनाशेनैव देवपराजयः स्यादिति निश्चयं कृत्वा स्नानसंध्यायज्ञयागादिजपकर्तृणां ब्राह्मणानां दैत्यैर्वधकरणम्, जलावासिनां दैत्यानां वधार्थं ब्रह्मण आज्ञया जल- प्राशनार्थं देवैरगस्त्यस्य प्रार्थनाकरणम्, देवकार्यार्थमगस्त्येन समुद्रप्राशनम, देवै-र्दैत्यवधकरणम्, अगस्त्यस्थापितपीठस्य देवैः स्वकार्यकरणाच्चित्रेश्वरपीठेतिनाम-करणम् 44 2
5.279.m: 35. Concluding that the defeat of the gods would occur only through the destruction of dharma, the Daityas' slaughter of the brahmins who perform ritual ablution, the twilight prayers, sacrifices, offerings, and japa; by command of Brahmā, the gods' petitioning of Agastya to drink the water in order to kill the Daityas living in the water; Agastya's drinking of the ocean for the sake of the gods' mission; the gods' slaughter of the Daityas; the naming of the seat established by Agastya as Citreśvarapīṭha because the gods' purpose was accomplished. 44 2

5.279.s: 40 brahmaṇā pṛthvyāṃ śilāsthāpanam, tatastatra brahmājñayā sarasvatyā pātālato hadaṃ nirmā-yāgamanam, tato maṃkaṇakamaharṣiṇā tatra tapastaptvā liṃgasthāpanam, citraśilā-maṃkaṇakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam. ... .... .... 49 1
5.279.d: 40 ब्रह्मणा पृथ्व्यां शिलास्थापनम्, ततस्तत्र ब्रह्माज्ञया सरस्वत्या पातालतो हदं निर्मा-यागमनम्, ततो मंकणकमहर्षिणा तत्र तपस्तप्त्वा लिंगस्थापनम्, चित्रशिला-मंकणकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. ... .... .... 49 1
5.279.m: 40. The placement of a rock on the earth by Brahmā; then Sarasvatī's arrival there by command of Brahmā after fashioning a pool from Pātāla; then the great seer Maṅkaṇaka performing austerity there and establishing a liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of the Citraśilā-Maṅkaṇakeśvara liṅga. 49 1

5.279.s: 41 bāṣkalidaityapīḍitairindrādibhirdevairviṣṇorājñayā hāṭakeśvare tapakaraṇam, tato bṛha-spativacanādaśūnyaśayanatithau bhagavatpūjanena santuṣṭasya bhagavata ājñayā bāṣka-linā samaṃ yuddhakaraṇam, bhagavatā bāṣkalidaityaparājayaṃ kṛtvā śakrasya svasthāne gamanam, bhagavatastatra vāsakaraṇaṃ liṃgasthāpanaṃ ca, jalaśāyyutpattivarṇanam ... 50 2
5.279.d: 41 बाष्कलिदैत्यपीडितैरिन्द्रादिभिर्देवैर्विष्णोराज्ञया हाटकेश्वरे तपकरणम्, ततो बृह-स्पतिवचनादशून्यशयनतिथौ भगवत्पूजनेन सन्तुष्टस्य भगवत आज्ञया बाष्क-लिना समं युद्धकरणम्, भगवता बाष्कलिदैत्यपराजयं कृत्वा शक्रस्य स्वस्थाने गमनम्, भगवतस्तत्र वासकरणं लिंगस्थापनं च, जलशाय्युत्पत्तिवर्णनम् ... 50 2
5.279.m: 41. Oppressed by the Daitya Bāṣkali, Indra and the other gods performing austerity in Hāṭakeśvara by command of Viṣṇu; then, by the word of Bṛhaspati, by worship of the Lord on the Aśūnyaśayana lunar day, by command of the Lord who was pleased, fighting with Bāṣkali; after the Lord had defeated the Daitya Bāṣkali, Śakra going to his own abode; the Lord residing there and establishing a liṅga; the description of the origin of Jalaśāyin. 50 2

5.279.s: 42 viśvāmitrakuṇḍotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam , tatra viśvāmitramenakāsamāgamavarṇane viśvā-mitreṇa menakāyai strīdharmakathanam...... . - - 51 2
5.279.d: 42 विश्वामित्रकुण्डोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् , तत्र विश्वामित्रमेनकासमागमवर्णने विश्वा-मित्रेण मेनकायै स्त्रीधर्मकथनम्...... . - - 51 2
5.279.m: 42. The description of the account of the origin of Viśvāmitrakuṇḍa; there, in the description of the meeting of Viśvāmitra and Menakā, Viśvāmitra's discourse on the duties of women to Menakā. 51 2

5.279.s: 43 viśvāmitrakathitapātivratyadharmāṃstiraskatya kuta āgamanaṃ kva gamanamityādipṛṣṭāyāṃ viśvāmitradarśanena menakāyāṃ lolupāyāṃ satyāṃ viśvāmitreṇa strīsaṃgamasya dhikkṛ tikaraṇam . 52 2
5.279.d: 43 विश्वामित्रकथितपातिव्रत्यधर्मांस्तिरस्कत्य कुत आगमनं क्व गमनमित्यादिपृष्टायां विश्वामित्रदर्शनेन मेनकायां लोलुपायां सत्यां विश्वामित्रेण स्त्रीसंगमस्य धिक्कृ तिकरणम् . 52 2
5.279.m: 43. When, disregarding the duty of wifely fidelity spoken by Viśvāmitra, she asked, "From where have you come? Where are you going?" and so forth, and Menakā became lustful upon seeing Viśvāmitra, Viśvāmitra's condemnation of sexual union with a woman. 52 2

5.279.s: 44 viśvāmitreṇa svasaṃgame tiraskārite bahuśo duḥkhasaṃtaptayā menakayā viśvāmitrāya viśvāmitreṇa menakāyai ca mitho jarāprāptirūpaśāpapradānam, tatastayoḥ kuṇḍasnānena śāpamuktiḥ, viśvāmitreṇa tatra liṃgasthāpanam, viśvāmitrakuṇḍaviśvāmitre-śvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam- .. 53 1
5.279.d: 44 विश्वामित्रेण स्वसंगमे तिरस्कारिते बहुशो दुःखसंतप्तया मेनकया विश्वामित्राय विश्वामित्रेण मेनकायै च मिथो जराप्राप्तिरूपशापप्रदानम्, ततस्तयोः कुण्डस्नानेन शापमुक्तिः, विश्वामित्रेण तत्र लिंगस्थापनम्, विश्वामित्रकुण्डविश्वामित्रे-श्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- .. 53 1
5.279.m: 44. When intercourse with him was rejected by Viśvāmitra, Menakā, greatly tormented by sorrow, giving a curse of acquiring old age to Viśvāmitra, and Viśvāmitra to Menakā mutually; then their release from the curse through bathing in the pool; Viśvāmitra's establishment of a liṅga there; the description of the māhātmya of Viśvāmitrakuṇḍa and the Viśvāmitreśvara liṅga. 53 1

5.279.s: 45 tripuṣkaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam . 53 2
5.279.d: 45 त्रिपुष्करतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् . 53 2
5.279.m: 45. The description of the māhātmya of Tripuṣkaratīrtha. 53 2

5.279.s: 46 sarasvatītīrthamāhātmyavarṇane balabhadranṛpato jātasya aṃbuvīcināmakasya mūkaputrasya mūkatvanāśanārthaṃ sarasvatītīrthe saputrakasya nṛpasya gamanam, tatra snānena liṃgapūjanena ca putrasya mūkatvanirasanam, aṃbuvīcikṛtaṃ sarasvatīstavanam, sarasvatī-tīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam.... 55 1
5.279.d: 46 सरस्वतीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णने बलभद्रनृपतो जातस्य अंबुवीचिनामकस्य मूकपुत्रस्य मूकत्वनाशनार्थं सरस्वतीतीर्थे सपुत्रकस्य नृपस्य गमनम्, तत्र स्नानेन लिंगपूजनेन च पुत्रस्य मूकत्वनिरसनम्, अंबुवीचिकृतं सरस्वतीस्तवनम्, सरस्वती-तीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... 55 1
5.279.m: 46 In the description of the māhātmya of the Sarasvatītīrtha: King Balabhadra's journey with his son to the Sarasvatītīrtha in order to remove the muteness of his mute son named Ambuvīci; the removal of the son's muteness there through ritual ablution and worship of the liṅga; the hymn of praise to Sarasvatī composed by Ambuvīci; and the description of the māhātmya of the Sarasvatītīrtha. 55 1

5.279.s: 47 mahākālamāhātmyavarṇane sapatnīkasya rudrasenasya rājño hāṭakeśvare gamanam, tatra devaṃ saṃpūjya bahuśo viprebhyo dānāni dattvā viprasaṃsadi rājñā viprebhyaḥ svapūrva janmavṛttāntakathanam, tatra vaṇigjātyudbhavasya tasyānnaprāptyabhāvādupoṣitasya sapannīkasya mahākālavane gamanam , tatra devaṃ dṛṣṭvā kamalairdevasya pūjākaraṇam, tena puṇyaprabhāvena rājakule jananam, mahākāleśvaratīrthaliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam 56 1
5.279.d: 47 महाकालमाहात्म्यवर्णने सपत्नीकस्य रुद्रसेनस्य राज्ञो हाटकेश्वरे गमनम्, तत्र देवं संपूज्य बहुशो विप्रेभ्यो दानानि दत्त्वा विप्रसंसदि राज्ञा विप्रेभ्यः स्वपूर्व जन्मवृत्तान्तकथनम्, तत्र वणिग्जात्युद्भवस्य तस्यान्नप्राप्त्यभावादुपोषितस्य सपन्नीकस्य महाकालवने गमनम् , तत्र देवं दृष्ट्वा कमलैर्देवस्य पूजाकरणम्, तेन पुण्यप्रभावेन राजकुले जननम्, महाकालेश्वरतीर्थलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 56 1
5.279.m: 47 In the description of the māhātmya of Mahākāla: King Rudrasena's departure for Hāṭakeśvara with his wife; having worshipped the god there and given gifts abundantly to the brahmins, the king's narration of his previous life to the brahmins in their assembly; having been born there in the merchant caste, and having fasted due to lack of food, his going with his wife to the Mahākāla forest; seeing the god there and worshipping the god with lotuses; by the power of that merit, his birth in a royal family; and the description of the māhātmya of the sacred ford and liṅga of Mahākāleśvara. 56 1

5.279.s: 48 umāmaheśvaraliṃgamāhātmye hariścandreṇa putraprāptyarthamumāmaheśvarārādhanam, tena tapasā saṃtuṣṭābhyāmumāmaheśvarābhyāṃ putrapradavarapradānam, taṃ varaṃ gṛhītvā hariścandrasya svabhavane gamanam, tato hāṭakeśvarakṣetra umāmaheśvaraprītaye liṃgasthāpanam, umā-maheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam... ... ...... 57 2
5.279.d: 48 उमामहेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्ये हरिश्चन्द्रेण पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थमुमामहेश्वराराधनम्, तेन तपसा संतुष्टाभ्यामुमामहेश्वराभ्यां पुत्रप्रदवरप्रदानम्, तं वरं गृहीत्वा हरिश्चन्द्रस्य स्वभवने गमनम्, ततो हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्र उमामहेश्वरप्रीतये लिंगस्थापनम्, उमा-महेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... ... ...... 57 2
5.279.m: 48 In the māhātmya of the Umāmaheśvara liṅga: Hariścandra's propitiation of Umā and Maheśvara in order to obtain a son; the granting of a boon bestowing a son by Umā and Maheśvara, who were pleased by that austerity; having received that boon, Hariścandra's return to his palace; then the installation of a liṅga in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara for the pleasure of Umā and Maheśvara; and the description of the māhātmya of the Umāmaheśvara liṅga. 57 2

5.279.s: 49 kalaśeśvaramāhātmyavarṇane kalaśanṛpasya gṛhe durvāsasa āgamanam, cāturmāsyavra-tasya pāraṇaṃ kartumāgatāya durvāsase nṛpeṇātithyasatkārapūrvakaṃ bhojanādisamarpaṇam, tatra bhojanapātre lavaṇādibhiḥ susaṃtkṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāghro bhava iti nṛpāya śāpapradānam, kalaśanṛpaterdurvāsasaḥ śāpena vyāghratvaprāptivarṇanam.. 58 2
5.279.d: 49 कलशेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णने कलशनृपस्य गृहे दुर्वासस आगमनम्, चातुर्मास्यव्र-तस्य पारणं कर्तुमागताय दुर्वाससे नृपेणातिथ्यसत्कारपूर्वकं भोजनादिसमर्पणम्, तत्र भोजनपात्रे लवणादिभिः सुसंत्कृतं मांसं दृष्ट्वा व्याघ्रो भव इति नृपाय शापप्रदानम्, कलशनृपतेर्दुर्वाससः शापेन व्याघ्रत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्.. 58 2
5.279.m: 49 In the description of the māhātmya of Kalaśeśvara: Durvāsas's arrival at the home of King Kalaśa; the king's offering of food and hospitality to Durvāsas, who had arrived to break the fast of the Cāturmāsya observance; seeing meat well seasoned with salt and other spices in the food-dish, his curse upon the king saying, 'Become a tiger!'; and the description of King Kalaśa's attaining tigerhood due to the curse of Durvāsas. 58 2

5.279.s: 50 nandinīvyāghrasaṃvāde nandinyā vyāghrasamīpe śapathakaraṇam. ..... 59 1
5.279.d: 50 नन्दिनीव्याघ्रसंवादे नन्दिन्या व्याघ्रसमीपे शपथकरणम्. ..... 59 1
5.279.m: 50 In the dialogue between Nandinī and the tiger: Nandinī taking an oath in the presence of the tiger. 59 1

5.279.s: 51 vyāghravacanānnandinyā svasthānaṃ gatvā vatsasya tṛptikaraṇama, sarvānpṛṣṭvā nandinyā vyāghrāgre gamanam, tena tasyāḥ satyatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā paścāttāpena muktiprāptyarthaṃ tasyai praśna karaṇam, śāpādvyāghratvaṃ prāptasya nṛpasya naṃdinīdarśitabāṇasthāpitaliṃgasya pūjanena vyāghratvaprāpakācchāpānmuktvā pūrvavadrājatvaprāptiḥ, tato harārādhanāṃ vidhāya svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, śivaloke gamanaṃ ca, kalaśeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.. 59
5.279.d: 51 व्याघ्रवचनान्नन्दिन्या स्वस्थानं गत्वा वत्सस्य तृप्तिकरणम, सर्वान्पृष्ट्वा नन्दिन्या व्याघ्राग्रे गमनम्, तेन तस्याः सत्यत्वं दृष्ट्वा पश्चात्तापेन मुक्तिप्राप्त्यर्थं तस्यै प्रश्न करणम्, शापाद्व्याघ्रत्वं प्राप्तस्य नृपस्य नंदिनीदर्शितबाणस्थापितलिंगस्य पूजनेन व्याघ्रत्वप्रापकाच्छापान्मुक्त्वा पूर्ववद्राजत्वप्राप्तिः, ततो हराराधनां विधाय स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, शिवलोके गमनं च, कलशेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.. 59
5.279.m: 51 In accordance with the tiger's word, Nandinī's going to her dwelling and satisfying her calf; having taken leave of all, Nandinī's arrival before the tiger; seeing her truthfulness, [the tiger's] question to her out of remorse in order to obtain liberation; the king who had attained tigerhood through a curse, having worshipped the liṅga installed by Bāṇa as shown by Nandinī, being released from the curse causing tigerhood and regaining his former kingship; then, having worshipped Hara, his installation of a liṅga in his own name, his departure for the world of Śiva, and the description of the māhātmya of the Kalaśeśvara liṅga. 59

5.279.s: 53 bhūṇagartāmāhātmya varṇane mitrasahasya rājño vasiṣṭhaśāpādrākṣasatvaprāptivṛttāntavarṇanam, rākṣasadharmeṇānuvartamānena tena rājñā viprādīnāmapi hananam, tena nṛpeṇa brahmahatyā-doṣanivṛttaye śāpamuktyuttaraṃ vasiṣṭhājñayā tīrthayātrākaraṇam, bhrūṇagartātīrthasnā-nena brahmahatyādoṣādunmucya pūrvavadrājyakaraṇam, rājyottaramante śivalokegamanaṃ ca, bhrūṇagartāmāhātmyavarṇanam .. .... 62
5.279.d: 53 भूणगर्तामाहात्म्य वर्णने मित्रसहस्य राज्ञो वसिष्ठशापाद्राक्षसत्वप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, राक्षसधर्मेणानुवर्तमानेन तेन राज्ञा विप्रादीनामपि हननम्, तेन नृपेण ब्रह्महत्या-दोषनिवृत्तये शापमुक्त्युत्तरं वसिष्ठाज्ञया तीर्थयात्राकरणम्, भ्रूणगर्तातीर्थस्ना-नेन ब्रह्महत्यादोषादुन्मुच्य पूर्ववद्राज्यकरणम्, राज्योत्तरमन्ते शिवलोकेगमनं च, भ्रूणगर्तामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् .. .... 62
5.279.m: 53 In the description of the māhātmya of Bhrūṇagartā: the account of King Mitrasaha's attaining the state of a rākṣasa through the curse of Vasiṣṭha; that king, behaving according to the nature of a rākṣasa, also killing brahmins and others; for the removal of the sin of killing a brahmin, after release from the curse, that king undertaking a pilgrimage to sacred fords by the command of Vasiṣṭha; being released from the sin of killing a brahmin through ritual ablution at the Bhrūṇagartātīrtha, and ruling his kingdom as before; after his reign, his departure for the world of Śiva in the end; and the description of the māhātmya of Bhrūṇagartā. 62

5.279.s: 54 nalakathāvarṇanapūrvakaṃ nalasthāpitacarmamuṇḍāmāhātmyavarṇanam.. .... .. 64 2

5.279.m: 55 Description of the māhātmya of Naleśvara, which was installed by Nala in his own name and removes the harm of disease and other misfortunes. 65 1

5.279.d: 56 सांबादित्यमाहात्म्ये गालवेनादित्यप्रसादेन वरं लब्ध्वा पुत्राभावात्सांबादित्यपूजनेन पुत्रप्राप्तिकरणम्, सांबादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... 65 2

5.279.d: 80 सुपर्णाख्यमाहात्म्यवर्णने वालखिल्यैराथर्वणिकैर्मंत्रैरभिमंत्रितममृतकलशं गृहीत्वा पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थं कश्यपेन स्वपत्न्यै दानम्, अमृतकलशप्राशनेन कश्यपाद्गरुडोत्पत्तिः, मित्रब्राह्मणकन्याया वरशोधार्थं गरुडस्य ब्राह्मणकन्याभ्यां सह गमनम्, पथि नारदस्य दर्शनम्, नारदेन समं विष्णुदर्शनार्थ तेषां सर्वेषां हाटकेश्वरे गमनम्, तत्र गत्वा नारदगरुडाभ्यां विष्णुसंदर्शनग्रहणम्...... 89 1
5.279.m: 80 In the description of the majesty of Suparṇa, Kaśyapa, having taken the pot of nectar consecrated by the Vālakhilyas with Atharvan mantras, gives it to his wife in order to obtain a son; through the consuming of the pot of nectar, the birth of Garuḍa from Kaśyapa; Garuḍa's journey with the daughters of a friendly brahmin in search of a bridegroom for them; the meeting with Nārada on the road; the arrival of all of them at Hāṭakeśvara with Nārada to behold Viṣṇu; having gone there, Nārada and Garuḍa receive darśana of Viṣṇu ..... 89 1

5.279.s: 81 viṣṇudarśanaṃ gṛhītvā garuḍena viṣṇuṃ prati viprakanyāvaraṇārthamāgrahakaraṇam , viṣṣvanujñayayā garuḍena viṣṇvagre sakanyakasya viprasyānayanam, viprakanyāyāḥ viṣṇoḥ strītvaṃ prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā krudhā lakṣmyā 'aśvamukhī bhava iti tasyai kanyāyai śāpapradānam, tathaiva vipreṇāpi gajavakrā bhava iti lakṣmyai śāpadānam , tato viṣṇunā vipra- kanyāyāḥ sāṃtvanakaraṇamucchāpadānaṃ ca, viṣṇvājñayā sasutasya viprasya svagṛhe gama- nam, viṣṇupuraḥsthitāṃ śāṇḍilīnāmnīṃ vṛddhastrīṃ dṛṣṭvā garuḍena hāsye kṛte satyantaḥ krudhā śāṃḍilyā manasā śāpadānena garuḍapakṣabhasmīkaraṇam 90 2
5.279.d: 81 विष्णुदर्शनं गृहीत्वा गरुडेन विष्णुं प्रति विप्रकन्यावरणार्थमाग्रहकरणम् , विष्ष्वनुज्ञयया गरुडेन विष्ण्वग्रे सकन्यकस्य विप्रस्यानयनम्, विप्रकन्यायाः विष्णोः स्त्रीत्वं प्राप्तं दृष्ट्वा क्रुधा लक्ष्म्या ऽअश्वमुखी भव इति तस्यै कन्यायै शापप्रदानम्, तथैव विप्रेणापि गजवक्रा भव इति लक्ष्म्यै शापदानम् , ततो विष्णुना विप्र- कन्यायाः सांत्वनकरणमुच्छापदानं च, विष्ण्वाज्ञया ससुतस्य विप्रस्य स्वगृहे गम- नम्, विष्णुपुरःस्थितां शाण्डिलीनाम्नीं वृद्धस्त्रीं दृष्ट्वा गरुडेन हास्ये कृते सत्यन्तः क्रुधा शांडिल्या मनसा शापदानेन गरुडपक्षभस्मीकरणम् 90 2
5.279.m: 81 Having received darśana of Viṣṇu, Garuḍa insists to Viṣṇu that he choose the brahmin's daughter; with Viṣṇu's permission, Garuḍa brings the brahmin along with his daughters before Viṣṇu; seeing that the brahmin's daughter was to become Viṣṇu's wife, Lakṣmī in anger utters a curse upon that maiden: “Become horse-faced!”; likewise, the brahmin also curses Lakṣmī: “Become elephant-faced!”; then Viṣṇu consoles the brahmin's daughter and gives a counter-curse [to nullify it]; by Viṣṇu's command, the brahmin goes to his own home with his daughters; upon Garuḍa laughing when he saw an old woman named Śāṇḍilī standing before Viṣṇu, Śāṇḍilī, being inwardly enraged, burns Garuḍa's wings to ashes by pronouncing a curse in her mind. 90 2

5.279.s: 82 nijapakṣadāhaṃ dṛṣṭvā garuḍena viṣṇunā ca śāṃḍilīstavanam, tataḥ śāṃḍilīvacanā- dgaruḍenahāṭakeśvaraṃ gatvā rudraśīrṣakālarudranīlarudrādīnnatvā śivārādhanakaraṇam, tena garuḍasya punaḥ suvarṇamayapakṣaprāptivarṇanam, suparṇeśvarākhyamāhātmyavarṇanam 91 1
5.279.d: 82 निजपक्षदाहं दृष्ट्वा गरुडेन विष्णुना च शांडिलीस्तवनम्, ततः शांडिलीवचना- द्गरुडेनहाटकेश्वरं गत्वा रुद्रशीर्षकालरुद्रनीलरुद्रादीन्नत्वा शिवाराधनकरणम्, तेन गरुडस्य पुनः सुवर्णमयपक्षप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, सुपर्णेश्वराख्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 91 1
5.279.m: 82 Seeing the burning of his wings, Garuḍa and Viṣṇu praise Śāṇḍilī; then, at the word of Śāṇḍilī, Garuḍa goes to Hāṭakeśvara and, having bowed to Rudraśīrṣa, Kālarudra, Nīlarudra, and others, worships Śiva; thereby, the description of Garuḍa obtaining golden wings once more; the description of the majesty named Suparṇeśvara. 91 1

5.279.s: 88 aṃbāvṛddhetyabhidhābhyāṃ kāśīrājabhāryāyāṃ patināśottaraṃ tatraiva purarakṣārthaṃ vāsaka-raṇam, tata ekasmātkuṇḍādgajavaktrāśvamukhyādidevatānāṃ samutpattiṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkṛtaja-natrāsanivāraṇārthaṃ tāsāṃ tadbhakṣaṇīyapadārthasya tābhyāmaṃbāvṛddhābhyāṃ vyavasthākaraṇam, tataḥ svanāmnā hāṭakeśvare liṃgasthāpanam, aṃbāvṛddhāmāhātmyavarṇanam...... 95 1
5.279.d: 88 अंबावृद्धेत्यभिधाभ्यां काशीराजभार्यायां पतिनाशोत्तरं तत्रैव पुररक्षार्थं वासक-रणम्, तत एकस्मात्कुण्डाद्गजवक्त्राश्वमुख्यादिदेवतानां समुत्पत्तिं दृष्ट्वा तत्कृतज-नत्रासनिवारणार्थं तासां तद्भक्षणीयपदार्थस्य ताभ्यामंबावृद्धाभ्यां व्यवस्थाकरणम्, ततः स्वनाम्ना हाटकेश्वरे लिंगस्थापनम्, अंबावृद्धामाहात्म्यवर्णनम्...... 95 1
5.279.m: 88 The two wives of the King of Kāśī named Ambā and Vṛddhā dwell right there after their husband's death in order to protect the city; then, seeing the emergence from a single pool of the deities Gajavaktrā, Aśvamukhī, and others, those two, Ambā and Vṛddhā, make arrangements for their food in order to avert the terror caused by them to the people; then, the establishment of a liṅga under their own names at Hāṭakeśvara; the description of the majesty of Ambāvṛddhā ..... 95 1

5.279.s: 89 aṃbāvṛddhājñayā sarvabālakakṣayakāriṇīnāṃ devatānāṃ vyavacchedārthaṃ camatkārarājaprārtha-nayā'mbāvṛddhādevyā svapādukāsthāpanakaraṇam, pādukādarśanena janānāṃ duḥkhani-vṛttibhavanam, pādukādarśanamakurvatāṃ śṛgālatvaprāptivarṇanam, dhyānaṃ kurvataḥ śaṃka-rasya tṛtīyanayanātkanyakotpattiḥ, śaṃkaravacanātpādukāpūjanena tasyāḥ sarvasiddhi- prāptikathanam , pādukāmāhātmyavarṇanam....... 96 1
5.279.d: 89 अंबावृद्धाज्ञया सर्वबालकक्षयकारिणीनां देवतानां व्यवच्छेदार्थं चमत्कारराजप्रार्थ-नयाऽम्बावृद्धादेव्या स्वपादुकास्थापनकरणम्, पादुकादर्शनेन जनानां दुःखनि-वृत्तिभवनम्, पादुकादर्शनमकुर्वतां शृगालत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, ध्यानं कुर्वतः शंक-रस्य तृतीयनयनात्कन्यकोत्पत्तिः, शंकरवचनात्पादुकापूजनेन तस्याः सर्वसिद्धि- प्राप्तिकथनम् , पादुकामाहात्म्यवर्णनम्....... 96 1
5.279.m: 89 Account of the installation of her sandals by the goddess Ambāvṛddhā at the request of King Camatkāra, in accordance with the command of Ambāvṛddhā, in order to ward off the deities who cause the destruction of all children; the cessation of the suffering of people through darśana of the sandals; account of turning into jackals for those who do not have darśana of the sandals; the birth of a maiden from the third eye of Śaṃkara while meditating; account of her attainment of all perfections through the worship of the sandals on the word of Śaṃkara; account of the māhātmya of the sandals...... 96 1

5.279.s: 90 vahnitīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇane jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramutsṛjya kaniṣṭhena śaṃtanunā rājyakaraṇā-dayamadharma iti matvā śakreṇānāvṛṣṭikaraṇavarṇanam, tena kāraṇena vane bhramatā viśvā-mitreṇa caṇḍālagṛhe gatvā tatra labdhena śvamāṃsena vahnau pañcamahāyajñakaraṇam, tena kāraṇena ruṣṭenāgninā kṛtaṃ sarvataḥ svātmano gopanam , agnimanveṣṭukāmānāṃ devānāṃ gajādibhiḥ svanāmni kathite sati tadupari ruṣṭena vahninā gajādīnāṃ śāpapra-dānam, tato hradānnirgatamagniṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā svātmagopanakāraṇe pṛṣṭe vahninā śakra-vṛṣṭyakaraṇādviśvāmitrakṛtaśvajāghanīhavanānmayā svātmagopanaṃ kṛtam iti kathite śakreṇa svājñayā vṛṣṭikaraṇam, tato brahmaṇāgnaye varapradānam, tasya hradasyāgnitīrtheti nāmakaraṇam, tatra agnau ghṛtasya vasordhārāyā māhātmyam, agnitīrthamāhātmya-varṇanam ...................... 97 1
5.279.d: 90 वह्नितीर्थोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णने ज्येष्ठं भ्रातरमुत्सृज्य कनिष्ठेन शंतनुना राज्यकरणा-दयमधर्म इति मत्वा शक्रेणानावृष्टिकरणवर्णनम्, तेन कारणेन वने भ्रमता विश्वा-मित्रेण चण्डालगृहे गत्वा तत्र लब्धेन श्वमांसेन वह्नौ पञ्चमहायज्ञकरणम्, तेन कारणेन रुष्टेनाग्निना कृतं सर्वतः स्वात्मनो गोपनम् , अग्निमन्वेष्टुकामानां देवानां गजादिभिः स्वनाम्नि कथिते सति तदुपरि रुष्टेन वह्निना गजादीनां शापप्र-दानम्, ततो ह्रदान्निर्गतमग्निं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणा स्वात्मगोपनकारणे पृष्टे वह्निना शक्र-वृष्ट्यकरणाद्विश्वामित्रकृतश्वजाघनीहवनान्मया स्वात्मगोपनं कृतम् इति कथिते शक्रेण स्वाज्ञया वृष्टिकरणम्, ततो ब्रह्मणाग्नये वरप्रदानम्, तस्य ह्रदस्याग्नितीर्थेति नामकरणम्, तत्र अग्नौ घृतस्य वसोर्धाराया माहात्म्यम्, अग्नितीर्थमाहात्म्य-वर्णनम् ...................... 97 1
5.279.m: 90 In the account of the origin and māhātmya of Vahnitīrtha: account of the withholding of rain by Śakra, who deemed it unrighteous because Śaṃtanu, the younger brother, reigned while abandoning his eldest brother; for that reason, while wandering in the forest, Viśvāmitra went to a caṇḍāla's house and, with the dog-flesh obtained there, performed the five great sacrifices into the fire; on that account, the concealing of himself on every side by the angered fire; when his name was spoken by the elephants and others to the gods wishing to search for the fire, the pronouncing of a curse upon the elephants and others by the angered fire; then, seeing the fire emerging from the pool, when asked by Brahmā the reason for concealing himself, upon the fire stating, "Because Śakra did not make rain, and because of the sacrifice of dog-hindquarters made by Viśvāmitra, I concealed myself," the making of rain by Śakra at his command; then the granting of a boon to the fire by Brahmā; naming that pool Agnitīrtha; the māhātmya of the stream of clarified butter (vasordhārā) in the fire there; account of the Agnitīrthamāhātmya...................... 97 1

5.279.s: 95 ajāpālanṛpanirmitakāmapradādevyutpattivarṇane vasiṣṭhavacanādajāpālasya hāṭakeśvara-kṣetre gamanam, tatra devīmārādhya taṃ prati prasannayā devyā varapradānam, varagrahaṇenā-jāpālarājye sthitānpuṇyavato janāndṛṣṭvā narakasya pāpināmabhāvācchūnyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā yamasya brahmaloke gamanam, tatra sthitena śivena tacchrutvā śivasya vyāghrarūpeṇa rājasamīpe gamanam-, vyāghrakṛtājābhakṣaṇena ruṣṭena rājñā preritānāṃ caṃḍīdattā-strāṇāṃ vyāghrarūpiṇā śaṃkareṇa bhakṣaṇam , paścādastrābhāvādvyāghreṇa samaṃ rājño dvaṃdvayuddhavarṇanam, tato vyāghrarūpaṃ tyaktvā tasmai śivena pratyakṣadarśanadānam, ajā-pālena śivavarṇanam, śivavacanādrājñaḥ pātāle gamanam, svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanaṃ ca , tatrājāpāleśvarītināmnā caṇḍīsthāpanam , ajāpāleśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanam- 101 2
5.279.d: 95 अजापालनृपनिर्मितकामप्रदादेव्युत्पत्तिवर्णने वसिष्ठवचनादजापालस्य हाटकेश्वर-क्षेत्रे गमनम्, तत्र देवीमाराध्य तं प्रति प्रसन्नया देव्या वरप्रदानम्, वरग्रहणेना-जापालराज्ये स्थितान्पुण्यवतो जनान्दृष्ट्वा नरकस्य पापिनामभावाच्छून्यतां दृष्ट्वा यमस्य ब्रह्मलोके गमनम्, तत्र स्थितेन शिवेन तच्छ्रुत्वा शिवस्य व्याघ्ररूपेण राजसमीपे गमनम्-, व्याघ्रकृताजाभक्षणेन रुष्टेन राज्ञा प्रेरितानां चंडीदत्ता-स्त्राणां व्याघ्ररूपिणा शंकरेण भक्षणम् , पश्चादस्त्राभावाद्व्याघ्रेण समं राज्ञो द्वंद्वयुद्धवर्णनम्, ततो व्याघ्ररूपं त्यक्त्वा तस्मै शिवेन प्रत्यक्षदर्शनदानम्, अजा-पालेन शिववर्णनम्, शिववचनाद्राज्ञः पाताले गमनम्, स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनं च , तत्राजापालेश्वरीतिनाम्ना चण्डीस्थापनम् , अजापालेश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- 101 2
5.279.m: 95 In the account of the origin of the goddess Kāmapradā created by King Ajāpāla: on the word of Vasiṣṭha, Ajāpāla's departure to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara; having worshipped the goddess there, the granting of a boon by the goddess pleased with him; having seen the meritorious people dwelling in Ajāpāla's kingdom due to receiving the boon, and seeing the emptiness of hell due to the absence of sinners, Yama's departure to Brahmaloka; Śiva, who was there, hearing that and going near the king in the form of a tiger; Śaṃkara in the form of a tiger devouring the weapons given by Caṇḍī that were discharged by the king, who was enraged by the tiger devouring his goats; then, in the absence of weapons, the account of the duel between the king and the tiger; then, having abandoned the tiger form, the giving of a direct darśana to him by Śiva; the praising of Śiva by Ajāpāla; on the word of Śiva, the king's departure to Pātāla, and the installation of a liṅga under his own name; the installation of Caṇḍī there under the name Ajāpāleśvarī; account of the Ajāpāleśvarīmāhātmya— 101 2

5.279.d: 96 राज्ञा दशरथेन ज्योतिर्विन्मुखाद्रोहिणीशकटभेदादिभविष्यं श्रुत्वा तन्निवारणाय शनै-श्चरसमीपे युद्धार्थं गमनम्, तस्य तच्छौर्य दृष्ट्वा संतुष्टेन शनैश्चरेण नाहं रोहि-णीभेदं करिष्यामीति प्रतिज्ञां कृत्वाऽभयदानकरणम्, शनैश्चरदशरथसंवादफलश्रु-तिवर्णनम्.. ... 103 2
5.279.m: 96 King Daśaratha, hearing from an astrologer's mouth of the future regarding the piercing of the cart of Rohiṇī and other events, going to Śanaiścara for battle in order to avert it; Śanaiścara, pleased upon seeing his valor, giving him freedom from fear after making the vow, "I shall not pierce Rohiṇī"; account of the benefit of listening to the dialogue between Śanaiścara and Daśaratha..... 103 2

5.279.s: 97 śanaiścareṇa rohiṇīśakaṭamahaṃ na bhetsyāmi iti tijñāpūrvakamāśīḥpradānottaramindreṇa daśarathasya śauryavarṇanapūrvakapraśaṃsākaraṇam, tato'putrasya naiva sadgatiriti daśarathena śakramukhājjñātvā putraprāptyarthaṃ tapaḥkaraṇārthaṃ samudyogakaraṇam... 104 2
5.279.d: 97 शनैश्चरेण रोहिणीशकटमहं न भेत्स्यामि इति तिज्ञापूर्वकमाशीःप्रदानोत्तरमिन्द्रेण दशरथस्य शौर्यवर्णनपूर्वकप्रशंसाकरणम्, ततोऽपुत्रस्य नैव सद्गतिरिति दशरथेन शक्रमुखाज्ज्ञात्वा पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थं तपःकरणार्थं समुद्योगकरणम्... 104 2
5.279.m: 97 After the granting of blessings preceded by the vow, "I will not pierce the cart of Rohiṇī," by Śanaiścara, the praising of Daśaratha preceded by a description of his valor by Indra; then Daśaratha, learning from Śakra's mouth that there is no good state for one without a son, making an effort to perform austerity to obtain a son... 104 2

5.279.s: 98 daśarathasya hāṭakeśvarakṣetre gatvā tapakaraṇam , tattapastuṣṭena viṣṇunā catuḥputratvenā-hamavatariṣyāmīti daśarathāya varapradānam, daśarathakṛtatapaḥsthalasya tatpūjitena viṣṇunā rājasvāmīti svanāmasvīkaraṇapūrvakaṃ tatkṛtavāpyā rājavāpīti nāmakaraṇam, rājasvāmirājavāpīmāhātmyavarṇanam.... ..... .. 105 2
5.279.d: 98 दशरथस्य हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे गत्वा तपकरणम् , तत्तपस्तुष्टेन विष्णुना चतुःपुत्रत्वेना-हमवतरिष्यामीति दशरथाय वरप्रदानम्, दशरथकृततपःस्थलस्य तत्पूजितेन विष्णुना राजस्वामीति स्वनामस्वीकरणपूर्वकं तत्कृतवाप्या राजवापीति नामकरणम्, राजस्वामिराजवापीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... ..... .. 105 2

5.279.s: 100 lakṣmaṇena rāmājñābhaṃgakaraṇādrāmājñayā nagarato gamanakaraṇam, sarayūsnānena lakṣma-ṇasya doṣanivṛttivarṇanam, tato lakṣmaṇasya yogasādhanena prāṇaniṣkramaṇam, viyadgataṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa śokakaraṇam, maṃtribhī rāmasya sāntvanam , lakṣmaṇa-śavasyāgniṃ dātuṃ pravṛttaṃ rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃnyaste nāgnisaṃskāraḥ iti nabhovāṇyā niṣedhakaraṇam, tato lakṣmaṇasyaurdhvadehikakarmakaraṇānantaraṃ rāmasya puṣpakavimānena kiṣkindhāgamanam, tatra sugrīvakṛtasatkārādivarṇanam......... 107 1
5.279.d: 100 लक्ष्मणेन रामाज्ञाभंगकरणाद्रामाज्ञया नगरतो गमनकरणम्, सरयूस्नानेन लक्ष्म-णस्य दोषनिवृत्तिवर्णनम्, ततो लक्ष्मणस्य योगसाधनेन प्राणनिष्क्रमणम्, वियद्गतं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा रामेण शोककरणम्, मंत्रिभी रामस्य सान्त्वनम् , लक्ष्मण-शवस्याग्निं दातुं प्रवृत्तं रामं दृष्ट्वा संन्यस्ते नाग्निसंस्कारः इति नभोवाण्या निषेधकरणम्, ततो लक्ष्मणस्यौर्ध्वदेहिककर्मकरणानन्तरं रामस्य पुष्पकविमानेन किष्किन्धागमनम्, तत्र सुग्रीवकृतसत्कारादिवर्णनम्......... 107 1
5.279.m: 100 Because Lakṣmaṇa violated Rāma's command, his departure from the city at Rāma's command; account of the removal of Lakṣmaṇa's fault by bathing in the Sarayū; then the departure of Lakṣmaṇa's vital breaths by the practice of yoga; Rāma's lamentation upon seeing Lakṣmaṇa gone to the sky; consolation of Rāma by his ministers; seeing Rāma setting out to give fire to Lakṣmaṇa's corpse, the prohibition by a voice from the sky saying, "There is no fire rite for an ascetic"; then, after the performance of the funeral rites for Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma's departure to Kiṣkindhā by the Puṣpaka aerial chariot; account of the reception and honors given by Sugrīva there......... 107 1

Rāma's arrival at the Ānarta lake with the rākṣasas; there, in the dialogue between Rāma and the brahmin, the description of the lake's māhātmya in the account of the past life of a blind brahmin going to heaven seated in an aerial chariot surrounded by apsarases; [and] the description of the māhātmya of the well at Ānartatīrtha... 110 1

5.279.s: 104 atha śrīrāmacandrasya svalokaṃ prati gamanānantaraṃ hāṭakeśvarakṣetre śivapūjārthaṃ samā-gatairākṣasaistatra militānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇena trāsitānbrāhmaṇāndṛṣṭvā śrīrāmapu-treṇa kuśena rākṣasānāṃ parājayakaraṇam, rākṣasaistatrānartataḍāge bahuśo liṃgasthā-panakaraṇam, kuśena vibhīṣaṇāya saṃdeśaṃ preṣayitvā taddvārā rākṣasānāṃ jaṃbūdvīpāgamane nirodhakaraṇam, 'kuśeśvaralaveśvarapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam -... .. .... 112 1
5.279.d: 104 अथ श्रीरामचन्द्रस्य स्वलोकं प्रति गमनानन्तरं हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे शिवपूजार्थं समा-गतैराक्षसैस्तत्र मिलितानां ब्राह्मणानां भक्षणेन त्रासितान्ब्राह्मणान्दृष्ट्वा श्रीरामपु-त्रेण कुशेन राक्षसानां पराजयकरणम्, राक्षसैस्तत्रानर्ततडागे बहुशो लिंगस्था-पनकरणम्, कुशेन विभीषणाय संदेशं प्रेषयित्वा तद्द्वारा राक्षसानां जंबूद्वीपागमने निरोधकरणम्, ऽकुशेश्वरलवेश्वरप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम् -... .. .... 112 1
5.279.m: 104. Then, after Śrī Rāmacandra's departure to his own world, the defeat of the rākṣasas by Śrī Rāma's son Kuśa upon seeing the brahmins terrified by being devoured by the rākṣasas who had gathered there to worship Śiva in Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra; the repeated installation of liṅgas by the rākṣasas there at the Ānarta lake; Kuśa's sending a message to Vibhīṣaṇa, through which he restrained the rākṣasas from coming to Jambudvīpa; [and] the description of the consecration of Kuśeśvara and Laveśvara... 112 1

5.279.s: 105 tulāgate marīcimālini vibhīṣaṇaśāpena vyaṃtaratvaṃ prāptai rākṣasairhāṭakeśvarakṣetre rākṣasasthāpitānāṃ caturmukhaliṃgānāṃ bhūmyāṃ pūraṇam , tatra kṣetre prāsādarahitepradeśe bṛhadaśvarājasya .gamanam, tatra prāsādanirmāṇe rājñā prayatnakaraṇam, tato bhūmikhananasamaye caturvaktraliṃgadarśanam, liṃgairāvṛtāṃ bhūmiṃ dṛṣṭvā rājño mṛtyuprāpti-varṇanam, rākṣasairliṃgācchādanavṛttāntavarṇanam 115 1
5.279.d: 105 तुलागते मरीचिमालिनि विभीषणशापेन व्यंतरत्वं प्राप्तै राक्षसैर्हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे राक्षसस्थापितानां चतुर्मुखलिंगानां भूम्यां पूरणम् , तत्र क्षेत्रे प्रासादरहितेप्रदेशे बृहदश्वराजस्य .गमनम्, तत्र प्रासादनिर्माणे राज्ञा प्रयत्नकरणम्, ततो भूमिखननसमये चतुर्वक्त्रलिंगदर्शनम्, लिंगैरावृतां भूमिं दृष्ट्वा राज्ञो मृत्युप्राप्ति-वर्णनम्, राक्षसैर्लिंगाच्छादनवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् 115 1
5.279.m: 105. When the sun entered Libra, the burying in the ground of the four-faced liṅgas installed by the rākṣasas in Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra by the rākṣasas who had attained the status of vyaṃtaras due to Vibhīṣaṇa's curse; the departure of King Bṛhadaśva to that sacred field to a place devoid of temples; the king's attempt to build a temple there; then, at the time of digging the earth, the sight of the four-faced liṅgas; the description of the king meeting his death upon seeing the ground covered with liṅgas; [and] the account of the concealing of the liṅgas by the rākṣasas... 115 1

5.279.s: 107 aṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthotpattimāhātmye vatsānvayasaṃbhūtacitraśarmanāmanṛpeṇa pātālasthaṃ hāṭake-śvaramagrasthala ānetumudyuktena śivārādhanākaraṇam , śivakṛpayā liṃgasthānam, tato'ṣṭaṣaṣṭigotrodbhavairbrāhmaṇairnṛpājñayā śivamārādhya tatkṛpayā aṣṭaṣaṣṭītināmnāṃ liṃgānāṃ navaprāsādaṃ racayitvā sthāpanākaraṇam, brāhmaṇaiścitraśarmaṇā ca kṛtasya liṃgasthāpanasya vṛttāntavarṇanam....... 116 1
5.279.d: 107 अष्टषष्टितीर्थोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्ये वत्सान्वयसंभूतचित्रशर्मनामनृपेण पातालस्थं हाटके-श्वरमग्रस्थल आनेतुमुद्युक्तेन शिवाराधनाकरणम् , शिवकृपया लिंगस्थानम्, ततोऽष्टषष्टिगोत्रोद्भवैर्ब्राह्मणैर्नृपाज्ञया शिवमाराध्य तत्कृपया अष्टषष्टीतिनाम्नां लिंगानां नवप्रासादं रचयित्वा स्थापनाकरणम्, ब्राह्मणैश्चित्रशर्मणा च कृतस्य लिंगस्थापनस्य वृत्तान्तवर्णनम्....... 116 1
5.279.m: 107. In the māhātmya of the origin of the sixty-eight tīrthas: the worship of Śiva by King Citraśarman, born in the Vatsa lineage, who was intent on bringing Hāṭakeśvara residing in Pātāla to the surface; the manifestation of the liṅga through the grace of Śiva; then, the brahmins born of the sixty-eight gotras, having worshipped Śiva at the king's command, through His grace constructing a new temple and installing the liṅgas bearing the names of the sixty-eight [tīrthas]; [and] the account of the installation of the liṅgas performed by the brahmins and Citraśarman... 116 1

5.279.s: 108 aṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthavarṇane śivapārvatīsaṃvāde nāradaśakrādibhiścamatkārakṣetre snānādi kṛtvā śivaliṃgaṃ saṃpūvajya tīrthaliṃgastutikaraṇam, vārāṇasyādyaṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthavarṇanama. .. 117 2
5.279.d: 108 अष्टषष्टितीर्थवर्णने शिवपार्वतीसंवादे नारदशक्रादिभिश्चमत्कारक्षेत्रे स्नानादि कृत्वा शिवलिंगं संपूवज्य तीर्थलिंगस्तुतिकरणम्, वाराणस्याद्यष्टषष्टितीर्थवर्णनम. .. 117 2
5.279.m: 108. In the description of the sixty-eight tīrthas, in the dialogue between Śiva and Pārvatī: Nārada, Indra, and others performing ablutions and other rites in Camatkārakṣetra, worshipping the Śivaliṅga, and praising the tīrthas and the liṅga; [and] the description of the sixty-eight tīrthas beginning with Vārāṇasī... 117 2

5.279.s: 109 aṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthānāṃ pratitīrtheṣu bhinnabhinnaliṃgānāṃ nāmanirdeśapūrvakaprabhāvavarṇanam . 118 2
