5.279.s: 111 kasmiṃścitsamaya ānartabhūpasya palyā damayantyā hāṭakeśvarakṣetre gamanam, tatra tīrthe haribodhavāsare snātvā bhagavantaṃ dhyāyamānāṃ damayantīṃ dṛṣṭvā'nyābhirbrāhmaṇastrībhi- rdamayantīvarṇanakaraṇam, damayantyā dhyānottaraṃ brāhmaṇastrībhyaḥ svakīyasarvālaṅkāra- dānakaraṇam, catasṛbhistāpasībhirvināanyābhiḥ sarvābhirbrāhmaṇastrībhirbhūṣaṇagrahaṇe- nāhlādakaraṇam, tathaiva pratidine rājapalyā tābhyo bhūṣaṇapradānakaraṇam, pañcamī dine catasṛbhirviprapatnībhirbhūṣaṇānāmagrahaṇe tatsamīpe bhūṣaṇāni gṛhītvā dama-yantyā gamanam, tābhirbhūṣaṇagrahaṇatiraskārakaraṇam, yābhirdamayantīdattānāṃ bhūṣa-ṇānāṃ tiraskṛtirakāri tāsāṃ patibhirākāśamārgeṇa svāśrame svapuṇyaprabhāveṇā-gamanakaraṇam, yābhirlobhāddamayantīdattānāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tāsāṃ patīnāṃ tatstrīgṛhītaduṣparigrahavaśātpāpenākāśagatikṣayeṇa tatraiva patanam, taiścaturbhirākāśa-mārgeṇāgatairṛṣibhistatkāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā damayantyai śilā bhava iti śāpapradānam,tatastasyā damayantyāstatra śilābhāvaṃ prāpya patanam, tadvṛttāntaṃ śrutvā dvijaprasāda-nāya damayantīpaterānartadeśarājasya tatrāgamanam, śilābhūtāṃ patnīṃ dṛṣṭvā rājñāśokakaraṇam .. ...... 119 2
5.279.d: 111 कस्मिंश्चित्समय आनर्तभूपस्य पल्या दमयन्त्या हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे गमनम्, तत्र तीर्थे हरिबोधवासरे स्नात्वा भगवन्तं ध्यायमानां दमयन्तीं दृष्ट्वाऽन्याभिर्ब्राह्मणस्त्रीभि- र्दमयन्तीवर्णनकरणम्, दमयन्त्या ध्यानोत्तरं ब्राह्मणस्त्रीभ्यः स्वकीयसर्वालङ्कार- दानकरणम्, चतसृभिस्तापसीभिर्विनाअन्याभिः सर्वाभिर्ब्राह्मणस्त्रीभिर्भूषणग्रहणे- नाह्लादकरणम्, तथैव प्रतिदिने राजपल्या ताभ्यो भूषणप्रदानकरणम्, पञ्चमी दिने चतसृभिर्विप्रपत्नीभिर्भूषणानामग्रहणे तत्समीपे भूषणानि गृहीत्वा दम-यन्त्या गमनम्, ताभिर्भूषणग्रहणतिरस्कारकरणम्, याभिर्दमयन्तीदत्तानां भूष-णानां तिरस्कृतिरकारि तासां पतिभिराकाशमार्गेण स्वाश्रमे स्वपुण्यप्रभावेणा-गमनकरणम्, याभिर्लोभाद्दमयन्तीदत्तानां भूषणानां ग्रहणं कृतं तासां पतीनां तत्स्त्रीगृहीतदुष्परिग्रहवशात्पापेनाकाशगतिक्षयेण तत्रैव पतनम्, तैश्चतुर्भिराकाश-मार्गेणागतैरृषिभिस्तत्कारणं दृष्ट्वा दमयन्त्यै शिला भव इति शापप्रदानम्,ततस्तस्या दमयन्त्यास्तत्र शिलाभावं प्राप्य पतनम्, तद्वृत्तान्तं श्रुत्वा द्विजप्रसाद-नाय दमयन्तीपतेरानर्तदेशराजस्य तत्रागमनम्, शिलाभूतां पत्नीं दृष्ट्वा राज्ञाशोककरणम् .. ...... 119 2
5.279.m: 111. At a certain time, Queen Damayantī, wife of the king of Ānarta, going to Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra; having bathed in that sacred ford on the day of Haribodha (Prabodhini Ekādaśī), other brahmin women praising Damayantī upon seeing her meditating on the Lord; after meditating, Damayantī gifting all her ornaments to the brahmin women; all the brahmin women, except for four female ascetics, rejoicing upon receiving the ornaments; the queen likewise giving ornaments to them every day; on the fifth day, when the four wives of the brahmins did not accept the ornaments, Damayantī taking ornaments and going to them; their refusal to accept the ornaments; the husbands of those women who had refused the ornaments given by Damayantī travelling through the sky to their own hermitage by the power of their merit; the husbands of those women who greedily took the ornaments given by Damayantī, losing their power of aerial movement through the sin of that improper acceptance of gifts by their wives and falling down right there; those four seers who had arrived through the sky, seeing the cause thereof, cursing Damayantī: 'Become a stone!'; then that Damayantī turning into a stone and falling there; having heard that news, the king of the Ānarta country, Damayantī's husband, arriving there to propitiate the brahmins; [and] the king's lamentation upon seeing his wife turned into a stone... 119 2

5.279.s: 112 rājñe śāpaṃ dātuṃ gṛhītajalānāṃ viprāṇāmanyadvijaprārthanayā śāṃtiṃ gatvā bhūmyāmevo-dakaprakṣepaṇāttasyā bhūmerūṣaratvaprāptivarṇanam, ūṣarasthānasyotpattipūrvakamāhātmya varṇanam...... 121 2
5.279.d: 112 राज्ञे शापं दातुं गृहीतजलानां विप्राणामन्यद्विजप्रार्थनया शांतिं गत्वा भूम्यामेवो-दकप्रक्षेपणात्तस्या भूमेरूषरत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, ऊषरस्थानस्योत्पत्तिपूर्वकमाहात्म्य वर्णनम्...... 121 2
5.279.m: 112. The brahmins, who had taken up water to curse the king, becoming appeased at the request of another brahmin and pouring the water onto the ground itself, resulting in that ground becoming barren soil; [and] the description of the māhātmya of that barren place together with its origin... 121 2

5.279.s: 113 tata ānartādhipateḥ pratimāsaṃ hāṭakeśvare gamanam , brāhmaṇānsantoṣya śāntikarmā-dikaṃ vidhāya svapuraṃ pratyāgamanaṃ ca, vahnivacanānmāsimāsi bhaviṣyaddhomakārye kenāpi brāhmaṇādhamena grahādyuddeśena kṛtasya dravyadidānasyāgrahaṇādgrahāṇāmadhikā pīḍeti jñātvā sarvaiḥ prārthanāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tatra tīrthe snānakaraṇenaikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vinā sarveṣāṃ śuddhivarṇanam, aśuddhena kuṣṭhitena brāhmaṇena sarvabrāhmaṇānāṃ prārthanākaraṇam, tatra tīrthe agneḥ sthāpanākaraṇam , trijātakaviśuddhaye'gnikuṇḍa- māhātmyavarṇanam ............ 122 1
5.279.d: 113 तत आनर्ताधिपतेः प्रतिमासं हाटकेश्वरे गमनम् , ब्राह्मणान्सन्तोष्य शान्तिकर्मा-दिकं विधाय स्वपुरं प्रत्यागमनं च, वह्निवचनान्मासिमासि भविष्यद्धोमकार्ये केनापि ब्राह्मणाधमेन ग्रहाद्युद्देशेन कृतस्य द्रव्यदिदानस्याग्रहणाद्ग्रहाणामधिका पीडेति ज्ञात्वा सर्वैः प्रार्थनायां कृतायां तत्र तीर्थे स्नानकरणेनैकं ब्राह्मणं विना सर्वेषां शुद्धिवर्णनम्, अशुद्धेन कुष्ठितेन ब्राह्मणेन सर्वब्राह्मणानां प्रार्थनाकरणम्, तत्र तीर्थे अग्नेः स्थापनाकरणम् , त्रिजातकविशुद्धयेऽग्निकुण्ड- माहात्म्यवर्णनम् ............ 122 1
5.279.m: 113. Then the ruler of Ānarta going to Hāṭakeśvara every month, propitiating the brahmins, performing propitiatory rites and returning to his city; by the word of Agni, in the future monthly homa rites, knowing that the distress caused by the planets was excessive because a wretched brahmin refused the gift of wealth and other items intended for the planets, upon all making a prayer, the description of the purification of everyone except one brahmin by bathing in that sacred ford; the impure, leprous brahmin praying to all the brahmins; the establishment of fire at that sacred ford; [and] the description of the māhātmya of the fire-pit for the purification of Trijātaka... 122 1

5.279.s: 114 kuṣṭhitvaṃ prāptena dvijenāraṇyaṃ gatvā tapaḥkaraṇam, tena tapasā tuṣṭena śivena varapradā-nam, camatkārapure vasato devarātaviprasya krathanāmakaputrasya nāgatīrthe gamanam, tatra tena krathena rudramālasaṃjñakaṃ nāgendratanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā laguḍena hananam, putrahananaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatpitṛmātṛbhiranyaiśca śokakaraṇam, tato ruṣṭaiḥ pannagaistatpurasyajanānāṃ bhakṣaṇe samārabdha ādau sakuṭumbadevarātasutakrathabhakṣaṇakaraṇam, tato bhayabhītairgrāmasthaiḥ sarvairjanairvanaṃ pratiprayāṇam , nirjanaṃ puraṃ dṛṣṭvā putraduḥkhanirasanam, sarveṣāṃ sarpatra-stānāṃ janānāṃ trijātabrāhmaṇasamīpegamanam, tadduḥkhaṃ śrutvā trijātena śiva-prārthanāṃ kṛttvā sarpabhītiṃnirāsāya śivato varagrahaṇam, tatrasthānāṃ sarpāṇāṃ nirvi- ṣatvakaraṇāya śivena tebhyaḥ sarpanirviṣatvakāraka 'na garaṃ na garam iti mahāmantra-dānam, tanmahāmantrajapena sarpāṇāṃ nagaratvakaraṇena nagareti tasya purasya nāmābhi-dhānakaraṇam tatrasthānāṃ viprāṇāṃ nāgareti nāmakaraṇam , nirviṣāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ tataḥ palāyanam, narotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam ... ..... 124 1
5.279.d: 114 कुष्ठित्वं प्राप्तेन द्विजेनारण्यं गत्वा तपःकरणम्, तेन तपसा तुष्टेन शिवेन वरप्रदा-नम्, चमत्कारपुरे वसतो देवरातविप्रस्य क्रथनामकपुत्रस्य नागतीर्थे गमनम्, तत्र तेन क्रथेन रुद्रमालसंज्ञकं नागेन्द्रतनयं दृष्ट्वा लगुडेन हननम्, पुत्रहननं दृष्ट्वा तत्पितृमातृभिरन्यैश्च शोककरणम्, ततो रुष्टैः पन्नगैस्तत्पुरस्यजनानां भक्षणे समारब्ध आदौ सकुटुम्बदेवरातसुतक्रथभक्षणकरणम्, ततो भयभीतैर्ग्रामस्थैः सर्वैर्जनैर्वनं प्रतिप्रयाणम् , निर्जनं पुरं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रदुःखनिरसनम्, सर्वेषां सर्पत्र-स्तानां जनानां त्रिजातब्राह्मणसमीपेगमनम्, तद्दुःखं श्रुत्वा त्रिजातेन शिव-प्रार्थनां कृत्त्वा सर्पभीतिंनिरासाय शिवतो वरग्रहणम्, तत्रस्थानां सर्पाणां निर्वि- षत्वकरणाय शिवेन तेभ्यः सर्पनिर्विषत्वकारक ऽन गरं न गरम् इति महामन्त्र-दानम्, तन्महामन्त्रजपेन सर्पाणां नगरत्वकरणेन नगरेति तस्य पुरस्य नामाभि-धानकरणम् तत्रस्थानां विप्राणां नागरेति नामकरणम् , निर्विषाणां सर्पाणां ततः पलायनम्, नरोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् ... ..... 124 1
5.279.m: 114 Description of the twice-born who, having contracted leprosy, went to the forest and performed austerity; of Śiva, pleased by that austerity, granting a boon; of Kratha, the son of the brahmin Devarāta residing in Camatkārapura, going to the Nāgatīrtha; of Kratha seeing Rudramāla, the son of the serpent king, and striking him with a club; of his parents and others grieving upon seeing the son struck down; of the enraged serpents then beginning to devour the people of that city, first devouring Kratha, the son of Devarāta, along with his family; of all the villagers, terrified, fleeing to the forest; of the sorrow over the son vanishing upon seeing the deserted city; of all the people afflicted by the serpents approaching the brahmin Trijāta; of Trijāta, hearing their distress, praying to Śiva and receiving a boon from Śiva to dispel the fear of serpents; of Śiva giving them the great mantra "na garaṃ na garam" [no poison, no poison] to make the serpents there non-poisonous; of naming that city "Nagara" because the serpents were rendered non-poisonous (nagara) by chanting that great mantra, and naming the brahmins there "Nāgara"; of the fleeing of the serpents rendered free of poison; and description of the origin of mankind. 124 1

5.279.s: 115 trijātabrāhmaṇasya janmakarmādivarṇane gotrādīnāṃ varṇanama, trijātena brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svasādyantavṛttāntakathanam , bhartṛyajñakṛtayajñavidhānamunigotravyavasthāvarṇanam . 126 1
5.279.d: 115 त्रिजातब्राह्मणस्य जन्मकर्मादिवर्णने गोत्रादीनां वर्णनम, त्रिजातेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यः स्वसाद्यन्तवृत्तान्तकथनम् , भर्तृयज्ञकृतयज्ञविधानमुनिगोत्रव्यवस्थावर्णनम् . 126 1
5.279.m: 115 In the account of the birth, deeds, and other matters of the brahmin Trijāta, description of the lineages and so forth; of Trijāta recounting his entire story from beginning to end to the brahmins; and description of the arrangement of sage lineages for the sacrificial rite performed by Bhartṛyajña. 126 1

5.279.s: 116 kuṭuṃbabhakṣaṇenaśāpitayā revatīsarpiṇyā bhaṭṭikākhyāyāḥ krathadvijabhaginyā daṃśakara-ṇam, bhaṭṭikāśāpa smṛtvā revatīsarpiṇyā mānuṣatve jananam, revatīkṛtaṃ devyārā-dhanam, devīvacanātsvanāmnātīrthasthāpanam, devyā tasyā aṃbā durgetyādibahunā-makaraṇam, aṃbārevatītīrthotpattipūrvakamāhātmyavarṇanam... ... 127 1
5.279.d: 116 कुटुंबभक्षणेनशापितया रेवतीसर्पिण्या भट्टिकाख्यायाः क्रथद्विजभगिन्या दंशकर-णम्, भट्टिकाशाप स्मृत्वा रेवतीसर्पिण्या मानुषत्वे जननम्, रेवतीकृतं देव्यारा-धनम्, देवीवचनात्स्वनाम्नातीर्थस्थापनम्, देव्या तस्या अंबा दुर्गेत्यादिबहुना-मकरणम्, अंबारेवतीतीर्थोत्पत्तिपूर्वकमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... ... 127 1
5.279.m: 116 The biting of the brahmin Kratha's sister, named Bhaṭṭikā, by the serpent Revatī, who had been cursed for devouring the family; of the serpent Revatī taking human birth upon remembering Bhaṭṭikā's curse; of Revatī's worship of the goddess; of her establishing a sacred ford under her own name at the word of the goddess; of the goddess bestowing many names such as Ambā and Durgā upon her; and description of the origin and māhātmya of the sacred ford Ambārevatī. 127 1

5.279.s: 117 bhaṭṭikopākhyāne takṣakeṇa bhāryātvāya bhaṭṭikāyāḥ pātāle nayanam, tadā bhaṭṭikayā martyo bhaveti takṣakāya śāpadānam, tatya praṇatipūrvakaprārthanayocchāpadānaṃ ca, tato bhaṭṭikāyā dāruparvate prayāṇam, bhaṭṭikayā tatra nijaśuddhatāpratyayapradānā- yāgniṃ prajjvālya tasminprajvalite'gnau praveśakaraṇenāgneḥ śītalatve khātpuṣpavarṣaṇam, devadūtaiḥ bhaṭṭikāyāḥ stavanakaraṇam, devadūtavacanānmṛtyumaprāpya bhaṭṭikāyāḥ svagṛhe gamanam, tayā svanāmnā tatraiva tīrthasthāpanam, bhaṭṭikātīrthotpattimāhātmyakathanam 128 2
5.279.d: 117 भट्टिकोपाख्याने तक्षकेण भार्यात्वाय भट्टिकायाः पाताले नयनम्, तदा भट्टिकया मर्त्यो भवेति तक्षकाय शापदानम्, तत्य प्रणतिपूर्वकप्रार्थनयोच्छापदानं च, ततो भट्टिकाया दारुपर्वते प्रयाणम्, भट्टिकया तत्र निजशुद्धताप्रत्ययप्रदाना- याग्निं प्रज्ज्वाल्य तस्मिन्प्रज्वलितेऽग्नौ प्रवेशकरणेनाग्नेः शीतलत्वे खात्पुष्पवर्षणम्, देवदूतैः भट्टिकायाः स्तवनकरणम्, देवदूतवचनान्मृत्युमप्राप्य भट्टिकायाः स्वगृहे गमनम्, तया स्वनाम्ना तत्रैव तीर्थस्थापनम्, भट्टिकातीर्थोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यकथनम् 128 2
5.279.m: 117 In the tale of Bhaṭṭikā, the abduction of Bhaṭṭikā to Pātāla by Takṣaka to make her his wife; Bhaṭṭikā then cursing Takṣaka: "Become a mortal!"; the mitigating of the curse upon his bow and supplication; Bhaṭṭikā's subsequent departure for Mount Dāru; Bhaṭṭikā kindling a fire there to provide proof of her purity, and a shower of flowers falling from the sky when the fire cooled as she entered the blazing fire; the messengers of the gods praising Bhaṭṭikā; Bhaṭṭikā, not having met death, returning to her home at the word of the messengers of the gods; her establishing a sacred ford right there under her own name; and narration of the origin and māhātmya of the Bhaṭṭikātīrtha. 128 2

5.279.s: 118 bhaṭṭikāśāpāttakṣakasya manuṣyatvaprāptau raivatanṛparūpeṇa bhūmau janmavṛttāntavarṇanam, raivataprabhaṃjanayo rājñoryuddhavarṇanam, putraṃ rājye nikṣipya kṣemaṃkaryā bhāryayā saha raivatasya rājño vane prayāṇam, tatastayorhāṭakeśvarakṣeje gamanaṃ śivaliṃgasthāpanaṃ ca, kṣemaṃka-rīraivateśvarotpattimāhatmyavarṇanam . 130 1
5.279.d: 118 भट्टिकाशापात्तक्षकस्य मनुष्यत्वप्राप्तौ रैवतनृपरूपेण भूमौ जन्मवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, रैवतप्रभंजनयो राज्ञोर्युद्धवर्णनम्, पुत्रं राज्ये निक्षिप्य क्षेमंकर्या भार्यया सह रैवतस्य राज्ञो वने प्रयाणम्, ततस्तयोर्हाटकेश्वरक्षेजे गमनं शिवलिंगस्थापनं च, क्षेमंक-रीरैवतेश्वरोत्पत्तिमाहत्म्यवर्णनम् . 130 1
5.279.m: 118 Description of Takṣaka attaining human form due to Bhaṭṭikā's curse, and of his birth on earth as King Raivata; description of the battle between King Raivata and King Prabhañjana; King Raivata's departure for the forest with his wife Kṣemaṅkarī after placing his son on the throne; then the arrival of the two at the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara and the installation of a Śiva-liṅga; and description of the origin and māhātmya of Kṣemaṅkarī-Raivateśvara. 130 1

5.279.s: 119 dīrghabāhurājāya mahiṣo bhaveti durvāsasā śāpadānam, tato mahiṣatvaṃ prāpya śukrā-jñayā hāṭakeśvare śivārādhanam, tadā śivena strīṃ vinā te maraṇaṃ na syādi-tyuktvā'nyebhyo'vadhyatvarūpavarapradānam, mahiṣatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam, mahiṣapuraḥ-sarairdaityaiḥ saha devānāṃ yuddhavarṇanam, daityairdevasenāparābhavakaraṇam, sarvadevairbṛhaspatinā sahaikībhūya maṃtrakaraṇam......... .... 131 1
5.279.d: 119 दीर्घबाहुराजाय महिषो भवेति दुर्वाससा शापदानम्, ततो महिषत्वं प्राप्य शुक्रा-ज्ञया हाटकेश्वरे शिवाराधनम्, तदा शिवेन स्त्रीं विना ते मरणं न स्यादि-त्युक्त्वाऽन्येभ्योऽवध्यत्वरूपवरप्रदानम्, महिषतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, महिषपुरः-सरैर्दैत्यैः सह देवानां युद्धवर्णनम्, दैत्यैर्देवसेनापराभवकरणम्, सर्वदेवैर्बृहस्पतिना सहैकीभूय मंत्रकरणम्......... .... 131 1
5.279.m: 119 Durvāsas cursing King Dīrghabāhu: "Become a buffalo!"; then, having become a buffalo, his worshipping Śiva at Hāṭakeśvara by the command of Śukra; Śiva then granting him the boon of invulnerability to others, saying: "There shall be no death for you except by a woman"; description of the māhātmya of Mahiṣatīrtha; description of the battle of the gods with the daityas led by Mahiṣa; the daityas overpowering the army of the gods; all the gods assembling together with Bṛhaspati to deliberate on a strategy. 131 1

5.279.s: 120 mahiṣāsurādidaityavadhārthāya kātyāyanyutpattivarṇanam........ 132 2
5.279.d: 120 महिषासुरादिदैत्यवधार्थाय कात्यायन्युत्पत्तिवर्णनम्........ 132 2
5.279.m: 120 Description of the origin of Kātyāyanī for the purpose of slaying Mahiṣāsura and other daityas. 132 2

5.279.s: 121 svatejovṛddhyarthaṃ kātyāyanyā siṃhamāruhya vindhyaṃ gatvā tapaḥkaraṇam , tejorūpāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmavaśagasya mahiṣāsurasya sainyena saha tatrāgatya bhāryātvāya tasyāḥ prārthanākaraṇam, devyā mahiṣavacane tiraskṛte sati kruddhasya mahiṣāsurasya devyā saha mahāyuddhavarṇanam, tataḥ kātyāyanyā mahiṣadaityasya keśāndhṛtvā yāvadgātravināśaṃ kartuṃ prayatna ārabhyata tāvaddānavena devyāḥ stavanam, tato devyā dayayā mahiṣā-surāya jīvadānam, itthaṃ mahiṣaparājayapūrvakaṃ kātyāyanyā mahiṣāsuramākramyāva-sthitikaraṇam, kātyāyanīmāhātmyavarṇanam. .. ... ....... 133 1
5.279.d: 121 स्वतेजोवृद्ध्यर्थं कात्यायन्या सिंहमारुह्य विन्ध्यं गत्वा तपःकरणम् , तेजोरूपां तां दृष्ट्वा कामवशगस्य महिषासुरस्य सैन्येन सह तत्रागत्य भार्यात्वाय तस्याः प्रार्थनाकरणम्, देव्या महिषवचने तिरस्कृते सति क्रुद्धस्य महिषासुरस्य देव्या सह महायुद्धवर्णनम्, ततः कात्यायन्या महिषदैत्यस्य केशान्धृत्वा यावद्गात्रविनाशं कर्तुं प्रयत्न आरभ्यत तावद्दानवेन देव्याः स्तवनम्, ततो देव्या दयया महिषा-सुराय जीवदानम्, इत्थं महिषपराजयपूर्वकं कात्यायन्या महिषासुरमाक्रम्याव-स्थितिकरणम्, कात्यायनीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. .. ... ....... 133 1
5.279.m: 121 Kātyāyanī mounting a lion, going to the Vindhya range, and performing austerity to increase her own fiery splendour; Mahiṣāsura, overcome with passion on seeing her of radiant form, coming there with his army and proposing marriage to her; upon the goddess rejecting Mahiṣa's words, description of the great battle between the enraged Mahiṣāsura and the goddess; then, as Kātyāyanī seized the hair of the daitya Mahiṣa and began the effort to destroy his body, the dānava praising the goddess; the goddess then granting life to Mahiṣāsura out of compassion; thus, after defeating Mahiṣa, Kātyāyanī standing with her foot pressed down upon Mahiṣāsura; and description of the māhātmya of Kātyāyanī. 133 1

5.279.s: 122 hiraṇyākṣapīḍitairdaivaiḥ stutyā satoṣiteneśvareṇa māhiṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya ke dārayāmi iti praśnakāraṇāttatsthalasya kedāreti nāmakaraṇam, kedāramāhātmyavarṇanam. 134 2
5.279.d: 122 हिरण्याक्षपीडितैर्दैवैः स्तुत्या सतोषितेनेश्वरेण माहिषं रूपमास्थाय के दारयामि इति प्रश्नकारणात्तत्स्थलस्य केदारेति नामकरणम्, केदारमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. 134 2
5.279.m: 122 Narration of naming that place "Kedāra" because Īśvara, pleased by the praise of the gods afflicted by Hiraṇyākṣa, assumed the form of a buffalo and asked: "Whom do I tear asunder?" (ke dārayāmi); and description of the māhātmya of Kedāra. 134 2

5.279.s: 123 śuklatīrthamāhātmyavarṇane śuddhakanāmakarajakenājñānādbrāhmaṇānāṃ suvastrāṇāṃ nīlīmadhye prakṣepakaraṇam, tacchrutvā rajakakanyayā svasakhyai dāśakanyāyai pitṛkṛtyanivedana-karaṇam , tajjñātvā dāśakanyayā kṛṣṇavastrāṇāṃ śuklatvāpādakaṃ jalāśayaṃ smṛtvā rajakakanyāyai tannivedanakaraṇam, tato rajakakanyayā'pi svasakhīkathitopāyasya svapitre śuddhakāya nivedanam, tatra vastrakṣālanena teṣāṃ vastrāṇāṃ pūrvāpekṣayāpyati-śuklatvaprāptiḥ, rajakena brāhmaṇebhyo vastrādivṛttāntanivedanakaraṇam, tatastasya jalā- śayasya śuklatīrtheti prasiddhibhavanam, śuklatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam. . 136 1
5.279.d: 123 शुक्लतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णने शुद्धकनामकरजकेनाज्ञानाद्ब्राह्मणानां सुवस्त्राणां नीलीमध्ये प्रक्षेपकरणम्, तच्छ्रुत्वा रजककन्यया स्वसख्यै दाशकन्यायै पितृकृत्यनिवेदन-करणम् , तज्ज्ञात्वा दाशकन्यया कृष्णवस्त्राणां शुक्लत्वापादकं जलाशयं स्मृत्वा रजककन्यायै तन्निवेदनकरणम्, ततो रजककन्ययाऽपि स्वसखीकथितोपायस्य स्वपित्रे शुद्धकाय निवेदनम्, तत्र वस्त्रक्षालनेन तेषां वस्त्राणां पूर्वापेक्षयाप्यति-शुक्लत्वप्राप्तिः, रजकेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यो वस्त्रादिवृत्तान्तनिवेदनकरणम्, ततस्तस्य जला- शयस्य शुक्लतीर्थेति प्रसिद्धिभवनम्, शुक्लतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. . 136 1
5.279.m: 123 In the description of the māhātmya of Śuklatīrtha, a washerman named Śuddhaka out of ignorance throwing the fine garments of brahmins into indigo dye; upon hearing of that, the washerman's daughter relating her father's deed to her friend, a fisherman's daughter; the fisherman's daughter, upon learning this, remembering a body of water that turns black garments white and relating it to the washerman's daughter; then the washerman's daughter also informing her father Śuddhaka of the solution told by her friend; by washing the clothes there, those garments becoming even whiter than before; the washerman relating the matter of the clothes and other things to the brahmins; then that body of water becoming celebrated as Śuklatīrtha; and description of the māhātmya of Śuklatīrtha. 136 1

5.279.d: 125 कर्णोत्पलतीर्थवर्णने सत्यसंधराज्ञः कर्णोत्पलेतिनाम्न्याः कन्याया उत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, कर्णोत्पलेयं कस्मै देयेति प्रष्टुं सकन्यकस्य सत्यसंधस्य ब्रह्मलोके गमनम्, ब्रह्मवचनात्तत्र ब्रह्मलोके स्थातुं प्रवृत्तं स्वपितरं दृष्ट्वा कन्यया प्रार्थनाकरणम्, कन्यावचनाद्राज्ञः स्वदेशे गमनम्, देशे वैपरीत्यं दृष्ट्वा'ऽश्चर्यकरणम्, तत्रस्थैः सह मिथो भाषणे स्वस्ववृत्तान्तकथनम्, सकन्यकस्य सत्यसंधस्य तत्रैव गर्ता- समीपे तपःकरणवर्णनम्.............. 139 1
5.279.m: 125 In the description of Karṇotpalatīrtha: description of the birth of the daughter named Karṇotpalā of King Satyasaṃdha; Satyasaṃdha's journey to Brahmaloka together with his daughter to ask to whom this Karṇotpalā should be given; seeing her father resolved to stay in that Brahmaloka in accordance with Brahmā's words, the girl makes an entreaty; by the girl's words, the king's return to his own country; his wonder at seeing the change in the country; speaking with one another with the residents there, telling each other's accounts; description of the practice of austerity by Satyasaṃdha together with his daughter right there near the pit... 139 1

karṇotpalātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam ............ 142 1
5.279.d:
127 सत्यसंधकन्यया कर्णोत्पलया पतिप्राप्त्यर्थं देवीमुद्दिश्य तपःकरणम्, तत्तपःप्रस-न्नाया देव्या आज्ञया तया कर्णोत्पलया गर्तातीर्थे स्नाने कृते सति तस्या यौवन- प्राप्तिवर्णनम्, तस्याः सौन्दर्यं दृष्ट्वा कामदेवेन तल्लिप्सया प्रार्थनायां कृतायां सत्यसंधेन स्वकन्याया अभिप्रायं ज्ञात्वा तस्मै कामाय स्वकन्याया वैवाहिकेन विधिना दानकरणम्, कर्णोत्पलादेव्यग्रे कर्णोत्पलया स्वनाम्ना तीर्थस्थापनम् ,
कर्णोत्पलातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ............ 142 1
5.279.m: 127 Satyasaṃdha's daughter Karṇotpalā performing austerity directed to the goddess in order to obtain a husband; upon the bath taken in Gartātīrtha by that Karṇotpalā at the command of the goddess pleased by that austerity, description of her attainment of youth; Kāmadeva, seeing her beauty, making a request out of desire for her, and Satyasaṃdha, understanding his daughter's intention, giving his daughter to that Kāma according to the matrimonial rite; Karṇotpalā's establishment of a tīrtha in her own name before the goddess Karṇotpalā; description of the māhātmya of Karṇotpalātīrtha... 142 1

5.279.s: 129 nijājñābhaṃgakruddhasya śākalyagurornirbandhātkruddhena yājñavalkyena tasmādguroḥ paṭhitā vidyāṃ tasmai gurave nivedya tadvidyāsaṃpādanārtha sūryopāstikaraṇam, tataḥ sūryeṇa yājñavalkyāya laghimāvidyāpradānam, tayā laghubhūtvā sūryāśvakarṇaṃ samāśritya sūryamukhanirgatānāṃ vedānāṃ yājñavalkyena paṭhanakaraṇam, sarvavidyāsaṃpādanottaraṃ yājñavalkyena vedārthadarśakopaniṣannirmāṇakaraṇam, svanāmnā hāṭakeśvare tīrthasthā-panam, yājñavalkyāśramatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam......... 144 1
5.279.d: 129 निजाज्ञाभंगक्रुद्धस्य शाकल्यगुरोर्निर्बन्धात्क्रुद्धेन याज्ञवल्क्येन तस्माद्गुरोः पठिता विद्यां तस्मै गुरवे निवेद्य तद्विद्यासंपादनार्थ सूर्योपास्तिकरणम्, ततः सूर्येण याज्ञवल्क्याय लघिमाविद्याप्रदानम्, तया लघुभूत्वा सूर्याश्वकर्णं समाश्रित्य सूर्यमुखनिर्गतानां वेदानां याज्ञवल्क्येन पठनकरणम्, सर्वविद्यासंपादनोत्तरं याज्ञवल्क्येन वेदार्थदर्शकोपनिषन्निर्माणकरणम्, स्वनाम्ना हाटकेश्वरे तीर्थस्था-पनम्, याज्ञवल्क्याश्रमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्......... 144 1
5.279.m: 129 The guru Śākalya being angered by the disobedience of his command, Yājñavalkya, provoked by his insistence, returns to that guru the knowledge studied under that guru, and worships Sūrya in order to acquire that knowledge; then Sūrya gives the knowledge of lightness to Yājñavalkya; having become light through it and clinging to the ear of Sūrya's horse, Yājñavalkya studies the Vedas issuing from Sūrya's mouth; after mastering all knowledge, Yājñavalkya composes the Upaniṣad revealing the meaning of the Vedas; he establishes a tīrtha in his own name at Hāṭakeśvara; description of the māhātmya of Yājñavalkyāśramatīrtha... 144 1

5.279.s: 130 yājñavalkyasya maitreyīpatnyupari viśeṣā prītiṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīmātmopari tasya prītiṃ saṃpādayituṃ kātyāyanīnāmaka dvitīyapatnyā śāṇḍilīsamīpe gamanam, śāṇḍi-lyā kātyāyanyai svasthitivṛttāntakathanam, śāṇḍilīvacanātkātyāyanyā varṣapa-ryantaṃ gaurīpūjanakaraṇam, paṃcapiṃḍāgauryutpattivarṇanam.. .... 145 2
5.279.d: 130 याज्ञवल्क्यस्य मैत्रेयीपत्न्युपरि विशेषा प्रीतिं दृष्ट्वा तादृशीमात्मोपरि तस्य प्रीतिं संपादयितुं कात्यायनीनामक द्वितीयपत्न्या शाण्डिलीसमीपे गमनम्, शाण्डि-ल्या कात्यायन्यै स्वस्थितिवृत्तान्तकथनम्, शाण्डिलीवचनात्कात्यायन्या वर्षप-र्यन्तं गौरीपूजनकरणम्, पंचपिंडागौर्युत्पत्तिवर्णनम्.. .... 145 2
5.279.m: 130 Seeing Yājñavalkya's special affection for his wife Maitreyī, his second wife named Kātyāyanī goes to Śāṇḍilī in order to secure such affection for herself; Śāṇḍilī tells Kātyāyanī the story of her own situation; at Śāṇḍilī's word, Kātyāyanī performs the worship of Gaurī for the duration of a year; description of the origin of Pañcapiṇḍāgaurī... 145 2

5.279.s: 134 hārītapatnyāḥ snānārtha jalāśaye gamanam, tatraiva rativāsanayā kāmadevasyāgamanam, tatsarvaṃ jñātvā hārītena kāmaṃ svapatnīṃ ca prati śāpapradānam, tatraiva hārītapatnyāḥ patiśāpena śilātvaprāptivarṇanam, kuṣṭhitvaṃ gatasya kāmasya vipravacanātkhaṇḍaśi-lārādhanena kuṣṭhanivṛttivarṇanam, khaṇḍaśilā saubhāgyakūpikotpatti māhātmyavarṇanam 150 1
5.279.d: 134 हारीतपत्न्याः स्नानार्थ जलाशये गमनम्, तत्रैव रतिवासनया कामदेवस्यागमनम्, तत्सर्वं ज्ञात्वा हारीतेन कामं स्वपत्नीं च प्रति शापप्रदानम्, तत्रैव हारीतपत्न्याः पतिशापेन शिलात्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, कुष्ठित्वं गतस्य कामस्य विप्रवचनात्खण्डशि-लाराधनेन कुष्ठनिवृत्तिवर्णनम्, खण्डशिला सौभाग्यकूपिकोत्पत्ति माहात्म्यवर्णनम् 150 1
5.279.m: 134 The wife of Hārīta going to a body of water for a bath; Kāmadeva arriving right there with carnal desire; knowing all that, Hārīta issues a curse against Kāma and against his own wife; description of Hārīta's wife turning into stone right there due to her husband's curse; Kāma, who had contracted leprosy, being cured of leprosy through the worship of Khaṇḍaśilā at the word of a brahmin; description of the origin and māhātmya of Khaṇḍaśilā and the Saubhāgyakūpikā. 150 1

5.279.s:
135 dīrghikotpattivarṇane vīraśarmabrāhmaṇena svakanyāyā durdoṣanivāraṇārthaṃ cāndrāyaṇā-divratakaraṇam , kanyayāpi vratakaraṇam , śakravacanāttayā kuṣṭhibrāhmaṇasya pāṇigra-hakaraṇam, pativākyamanusṛtya tasyā aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu gamanam, mārge śūlasthi-
tena māṇḍavyena tābhyāṃ śāpapradānam, tayā sūryanirodhakaraṇam ,vayaṃ te patiṃ jīvā-payiṣyāmaḥ iti devavacanātsūryodayakaraṇam , kuṣṭhibrāhmaṇasya maraṇam, devaistasya saṃjīvyotthāpanam, devaistasyai dīrghāyai patibratāyai varapradānam . ... 152 1
5.279.d:
135 दीर्घिकोत्पत्तिवर्णने वीरशर्मब्राह्मणेन स्वकन्याया दुर्दोषनिवारणार्थं चान्द्रायणा-दिव्रतकरणम् , कन्ययापि व्रतकरणम् , शक्रवचनात्तया कुष्ठिब्राह्मणस्य पाणिग्र-हकरणम्, पतिवाक्यमनुसृत्य तस्या अष्टषष्टिषु तीर्थेषु गमनम्, मार्गे शूलस्थि-
तेन माण्डव्येन ताभ्यां शापप्रदानम्, तया सूर्यनिरोधकरणम् ,वयं ते पतिं जीवा-पयिष्यामः इति देववचनात्सूर्योदयकरणम् , कुष्ठिब्राह्मणस्य मरणम्, देवैस्तस्य संजीव्योत्थापनम्, देवैस्तस्यै दीर्घायै पतिब्रतायै वरप्रदानम् . ... 152 1
5.279.m: 135 In the description of the origin of Dīrghikā: the brahmin Vīraśarman observes vows such as the cāndrāyaṇa for the removal of his daughter's terrible defect; the daughter also observes vows; at Indra's word, she takes the hand of a leper brahmin in marriage; following her husband's word, she goes to the sixty-eight tīrthas; Māṇḍavya, impaled on a stake along the road, issues a curse to both of them; she stops the sun; at the gods' word, 'We shall bring your husband back to life,' she causes the sun to rise; the leper brahmin dies; the gods revive and raise him; the gods bestow a boon upon Dīrghā, the devoted wife... 152 1

5.279.m: 139 Description of the grief over the death of the five-year-old son of a twice-born named Upādhyāya born in the lineage of Kaśyapa; then in anger the brahmin gives a curse to Yama; the cursed Yama goes before Brahmā; Yama, at Brahmā's word, goes to Hāṭakeśvara for the removal of the curse; then Yama, having assumed the form of a twice-born, comes to the brahmin's house and gives that son back to the brahmin; Dharmarāja installs a Śivaliṅga; description of the narration of the māhātmya of Dharmarājeśvara... 155 1

5.279.d: 141 मिष्टान्नदायकलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णने वसुसेननामकस्य भूपस्याऽन्नं विना बहुदानकरणेन स्वर्गं गत्वा बुभुक्षितत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, तेन पीडितेन वसुसेनेनेन्द्रं प्रति पृष्टे सति तस्मिन्नेव समये तत्र नारदस्यागमनं दृष्ट्वा तस्मै सर्ववृत्तान्तकथनम्, वसुसेनस्य प्रार्थनया नारदेन पितृश्राद्धादौ नित्यमन्नदानादिकं कुर्विति वसुसेनपुत्राय सत्यसे-नाय पितुराज्ञासन्देशनिवेदनकरणम्, नारदद्वारा स्वपितुः संदेशं श्रुत्वा सत्यसेनेन स्वपित्रेऽन्नप्रदानम्, अवर्षणादन्नाभावेन सत्यसेनेन शिवाराधनाकरणम् , तदाराधनासन्तुष्टेन शिवेन यथेष्टमिष्टान्नादिदानम्, ततः सत्यसेनेन मिष्टान्नदेश्वरनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, मिष्टान्नदेश्वरमाहात्म्यकथनम्.... .... 156 2
5.279.m: 141 In the description of the māhātmya of the liṅga that bestows sweet food: description of King Vasusena giving abundant gifts without giving food, going to heaven, and experiencing hunger; when Indra is questioned by the afflicted Vasusena, seeing Nārada's arrival there at that very moment, he tells him the whole story; at Vasusena's plea, Nārada delivers the message of his father's command to Vasusena's son Satyasena: 'Constantly perform gifts of food and the like in rites for the ancestors and so on'; Satyasena, hearing his father's message through Nārada, offers food to his father; due to lack of rain and absence of food, Satyasena performs the worship of Śiva; Śiva, pleased by that worship, gives sweet food and the like as desired; then Satyasena installs a liṅga named Miṣṭānnadeśvara; narration of the māhātmya of Miṣṭānnadeśvara... 156 2

5.279.s: 144 raṃbhodbhūtāṃ svakanyāṃ dṛṣṭvā jābālinā tasyāḥ poṣaṇakaraṇam, yauvanaṃ prāptāyāḥ kaumā-ravatyā jāvālikanyāyā agre citrasenagandharvasya gamanam, tāṃ jābālikanyāṃ gṛhītvā gandharvasya devamandire gamanam, tato duhitaramanveṣayamāṇena jābālinā devamandire svakanyāṃ palāyamānaṃ taṃ gandharvaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā laguḍena svakanyāyāstāḍanam, gandharvāya ca śāpapradānam ,gandharveṇa śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ tapastaptvā śāpānnivṛttya liṃga-sthāpanam, phalavatīnāmakayā jābālikanyayā'pi śāpanibarhaṇārthaṃ tapakaraṇam, tattapaḥprāptadivyabhāvayā tayā kanyayā saha jābālimaharṣeḥ praśnottararūpeṇa saṃvāde jāyamāne tayā kanyayā svapiturjābālerniruttarīkaraṇam, jābālīśvaracitrāṃgade-śvaraphalavatīyoginītrayamāhātmyavaṇarnam... .... .. 160 1
5.279.d: 144 रंभोद्भूतां स्वकन्यां दृष्ट्वा जाबालिना तस्याः पोषणकरणम्, यौवनं प्राप्तायाः कौमा-रवत्या जावालिकन्याया अग्रे चित्रसेनगन्धर्वस्य गमनम्, तां जाबालिकन्यां गृहीत्वा गन्धर्वस्य देवमन्दिरे गमनम्, ततो दुहितरमन्वेषयमाणेन जाबालिना देवमन्दिरे स्वकन्यां पलायमानं तं गन्धर्वं च दृष्ट्वा लगुडेन स्वकन्यायास्ताडनम्, गन्धर्वाय च शापप्रदानम् ,गन्धर्वेण शापनिवृत्त्यर्थं तपस्तप्त्वा शापान्निवृत्त्य लिंग-स्थापनम्, फलवतीनामकया जाबालिकन्ययाऽपि शापनिबर्हणार्थं तपकरणम्, तत्तपःप्राप्तदिव्यभावया तया कन्यया सह जाबालिमहर्षेः प्रश्नोत्तररूपेण संवादे जायमाने तया कन्यया स्वपितुर्जाबालेर्निरुत्तरीकरणम्, जाबालीश्वरचित्रांगदे-श्वरफलवतीयोगिनीत्रयमाहात्म्यवणर्नम्... .... .. 160 1
5.279.m: 144. Jābāli nourishing his daughter born of Rambhā upon seeing her; the Gandharva Citrasena approaching Jābāli's maiden daughter upon her reaching youth; the Gandharva taking that daughter of Jābāli and entering a divine temple; then Jābāli, searching for his daughter, seeing his own daughter and that fleeing Gandharva in the divine temple, beating his daughter with a stick, and pronouncing a curse upon the Gandharva; the Gandharva performing austerity to avert the curse, becoming freed from the curse, and installing a liṅga; Jābāli's daughter named Phalavatī also performing austerity to remove the curse; the great sage Jābāli holding a dialogue in the form of question and answer with that maiden who had attained a divine state through that austerity, and that maiden rendering her father Jābāli speechless; description of the māhātmya of the triad of Jābālīśvara, Citrāṅgadeśvara, and the yoginī Phalavatī. 160 1

5.279.s: 145 amareśvaramāhātmyavarṇane daityakṛtaṃ devaparājayaṃ śrutvā ādityeśvarārādhanākaraṇam, īśvarakṛpayā devadaityayuddhe devakṛtadaityaparājayavarṇanam, amaratvaprāptikaratvāttasya liṃgasyāmareśvareti nāmakaraṇam, amareśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.. 163 2

5.279.s: 149 kelīśvaryutpattivarṇane hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sakāśādandhakāsurasya janma, tasya rājyaprāpti-varṇanam, tataḥ sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ tapastāvāndhakena brahmaṇo varagrahaṇakaraṇam, tena brahmadattavareṇonmattenāndhakena sendrāndevāñjitvā śaṃbhumapi jitvā śaṃbhunirmitāgni-kuṇḍajākelīśvaryā devyā samaṃ yuddhakaraṇam........... 166 2
5.279.d: 149 केलीश्वर्युत्पत्तिवर्णने हिरण्यकशिपोः सकाशादन्धकासुरस्य जन्म, तस्य राज्यप्राप्ति-वर्णनम्, ततः सहस्रवर्षपर्यन्तं तपस्तावान्धकेन ब्रह्मणो वरग्रहणकरणम्, तेन ब्रह्मदत्तवरेणोन्मत्तेनान्धकेन सेन्द्रान्देवाञ्जित्वा शंभुमपि जित्वा शंभुनिर्मिताग्नि-कुण्डजाकेलीश्वर्या देव्या समं युद्धकरणम्........... 166 2
5.279.m: 149. In the description of the origin of Kelīśvarī, the birth of the asura Andhaka from Hiraṇyakaśipu; description of his obtaining kingship; then Andhaka performing austerity for a thousand years and obtaining a boon from Brahmā; Andhaka, maddened by that boon granted by Brahmā, conquering the gods headed by Indra, even defeating Śambhu, and battling with the goddess Kelīśvarī born from the fire-pit fashioned by Śambhu. 166 2

5.279.s: 150 svadaityasainyaparājayaṃ dṛṣṭvā'ndhakena prārthitena śukreṇa śaṃbhuneva vahnāvātharvaṇikamantrairā-vāhane kṛte sati kelīśvaryā utpattivarṇanam, tato'ndhakena tasyā devyāḥ sakāśato varaṃ labdhvā kelīśvarīstavanakaraṇam, kelīśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanam.... 169 1
5.279.d: 150 स्वदैत्यसैन्यपराजयं दृष्ट्वाऽन्धकेन प्रार्थितेन शुक्रेण शंभुनेव वह्नावाथर्वणिकमन्त्रैरा-वाहने कृते सति केलीश्वर्या उत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, ततोऽन्धकेन तस्या देव्याः सकाशतो वरं लब्ध्वा केलीश्वरीस्तवनकरणम्, केलीश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... 169 1
5.279.m: 150. Śukra, implored by Andhaka upon seeing the defeat of his own daitya army, performing an invocation in the fire with Ātharvaṇa mantras just as Śambhu did, and the description of the origin of Kelīśvarī; then Andhaka obtaining a boon from that goddess and uttering a hymn of praise to Kelīśvarī; description of the māhātmya of Kelīśvarī. 169 1

5.279.s: 151 andhakaśivayoryuddhe vartamāne śivenāndhakasya parājayakaraṇam, andhakakṛtayā stutyā prasannena bhagavatāṃ'dhakasya bhṛṃgiriṭīti nāmnā svakīyaśaivagaṇatvapradānavarṇanam, atha rājyādbhraṣṭasya surathasya vasiṣṭhavacanāddhāṭakeśvare gatvā bhairavaṃ sthāpayitvā tasya pūjanena rājyaprāptivarṇanam, bhairavakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanam .... ... 169 2
5.279.d: 151 अन्धकशिवयोर्युद्धे वर्तमाने शिवेनान्धकस्य पराजयकरणम्, अन्धककृतया स्तुत्या प्रसन्नेन भगवतांऽधकस्य भृंगिरिटीति नाम्ना स्वकीयशैवगणत्वप्रदानवर्णनम्, अथ राज्याद्भ्रष्टस्य सुरथस्य वसिष्ठवचनाद्धाटकेश्वरे गत्वा भैरवं स्थापयित्वा तस्य पूजनेन राज्यप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, भैरवक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् .... ... 169 2
5.279.m: 151. While the battle between Andhaka and Śiva is underway, Śiva defeating Andhaka; the Lord, pleased by the hymn composed by Andhaka, granting him the status of his own Śaiva gaṇa under the name Bhṛṅgiriṭin; then Suratha, fallen from his kingdom, going to Hāṭakeśvara on the advice of Vasiṣṭha, installing Bhairava, and obtaining his kingdom by worshiping him; description of the māhātmya of the Bhairavakṣetra. 169 2

5.279.s: 152 cakrapāṇimāhātmyavarṇane'rjunasya yudhiṣṭhirānujñayā brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthamaraṇye gamanam, tato gomocanaṃ kṛtvā tīrthayātrāṃ kartumudyuktasya phālgunasya hāṭakeśvare gamanaṃ cakrapāṇisthāpanaṃ ca, cakrapāṇimāhātmyavarṇanam... .. 171 1
5.279.d: 152 चक्रपाणिमाहात्म्यवर्णनेऽर्जुनस्य युधिष्ठिरानुज्ञया ब्राह्मणानां गवां संरक्षणार्थमरण्ये गमनम्, ततो गोमोचनं कृत्वा तीर्थयात्रां कर्तुमुद्युक्तस्य फाल्गुनस्य हाटकेश्वरे गमनं चक्रपाणिस्थापनं च, चक्रपाणिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... .. 171 1
5.279.m: 152. In the description of the māhātmya of Cakrapāṇi, Arjuna going to the forest with the permission of Yudhiṣṭhira to protect the cows of the brahmins; then Phālguna, having released the cows, preparing to embark on a pilgrimage to sacred fords, going to Hāṭakeśvara, and installing Cakrapāṇi; description of the māhātmya of Cakrapāṇi. 171 1

5.279.s: 153 rūpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇane tilottamotpattivarṇanam, brahmājñayā tilottamāyāḥ kailāse gamanam, śivaṃ natvā pradakṣiṇāṃ kurvatyā tilottamāyāṃ śivamanasaḥ kṣubdhatāṃ samālokya pārvatyā 'kurūpā bhava iti tilottamā prati śāpadānam, tilottamā-prārthanayā tilottamāṃ gṛhītvā pārvatyā hāṭakeśvare rūpatīrthe gamanam, tena pūrvava-tsthitāṃ tilottamāṃ prati pārvatyā varapradānam, apsaraḥkuṇḍotpattimāhātmya-varṇanam... ... ... 172 1
5.279.d: 153 रूपतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णने तिलोत्तमोत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, ब्रह्माज्ञया तिलोत्तमायाः कैलासे गमनम्, शिवं नत्वा प्रदक्षिणां कुर्वत्या तिलोत्तमायां शिवमनसः क्षुब्धतां समालोक्य पार्वत्या ऽकुरूपा भव इति तिलोत्तमा प्रति शापदानम्, तिलोत्तमा-प्रार्थनया तिलोत्तमां गृहीत्वा पार्वत्या हाटकेश्वरे रूपतीर्थे गमनम्, तेन पूर्वव-त्स्थितां तिलोत्तमां प्रति पार्वत्या वरप्रदानम्, अप्सरःकुण्डोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्य-वर्णनम्... ... ... 172 1
5.279.m: 153. In the description of the māhātmya of Rūpatīrtha, description of the origin of Tilottamā; Tilottamā going to Kailāsa at the command of Brahmā; Pārvatī, observing the agitation of Śiva's mind while Tilottamā bowed to Śiva and circumambulated him, pronouncing a curse upon Tilottamā saying 'Become misshapen!'; at Tilottamā's prayer, Pārvatī taking Tilottamā and going to Rūpatīrtha in Hāṭakeśvara; Pārvatī granting a boon to Tilottamā who had returned to her former state by that [ford]; description of the origin and māhātmya of the Apsaraḥkuṇḍa. 172 1

5.279.s: 154 citreśvarīpīṭhamāhātmyavarṇanam ....... 173 1
5.279.d: 154 चित्रेश्वरीपीठमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ....... 173 1
5.279.m: 154. Description of the māhātmya of the Citreśvarī seat. 173 1

5.279.s: 155 hāṭakeśvarakṣetre dvādaśādityāṣṭavasvekādaśarudrāṇāṃ pūjanamāhātmyavarṇanam, puṣpādi-tyamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra maṇibhadrakṣatriyavṛttāntavarṇanam, vṛddhamaṇibhadrāya kanyāṃ pradātuṃ tasyāḥ kanyāyāḥ pitrā kṣatriyeṇa nijabhāryāyai bodhopadeśakaraṇam.. 174 1
5.279.d: 155 हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रे द्वादशादित्याष्टवस्वेकादशरुद्राणां पूजनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, पुष्पादि-त्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र मणिभद्रक्षत्रियवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, वृद्धमणिभद्राय कन्यां प्रदातुं तस्याः कन्यायाः पित्रा क्षत्रियेण निजभार्यायै बोधोपदेशकरणम्.. 174 1
5.279.m: 155. In the Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, description of the māhātmya of worshiping the twelve Ādityas, eight Vasus, and eleven Rudras; description of the māhātmya of Puṣpāditya; therein, description of the account of the kṣatriya Maṇibhadra; the kṣatriya, the father of that maiden, giving instruction and counsel to his own wife in order to bestow the maiden upon the aged Maṇibhadra. 174 1

5.279.s: 156 maṇibhadravivāhottaraṃ maṇibhadrena puṣpanāmakabrāhmaṇasya viḍaṃbanakaraṇam, tasmai brāhma- ṇāya nagaravāsibhiḥ sāntvanapūrvakaṃ bhojanāyābhyarthanākaraṇam .. ... 175 1
5.279.d: 156 मणिभद्रविवाहोत्तरं मणिभद्रेन पुष्पनामकब्राह्मणस्य विडंबनकरणम्, तस्मै ब्राह्म- णाय नगरवासिभिः सान्त्वनपूर्वकं भोजनायाभ्यर्थनाकरणम् .. ... 175 1
5.279.m: 156. After the marriage of Maṇibhadra, Maṇibhadra mocking the brahmin named Puṣpa; the city-dwellers offering consolation and extending an invitation to meal for that brahmin. 175 1

5.279.s: 157 tato bhojanamakṛtvaiva sūryamārādhayituṃ puṣpakasya camatkārapure gamanam, tataḥ sama-ntrakaḥ sāṃgaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā svamāṃsena sviṣṭakṛdādikamavekṣya sūryasya tatsamīpaṃ pratyā-gamanam, sūryeṇa puṣpākhyāya maṇibhadrarūpakaraṇa-svarūpakaraṇaprabhāvaśāliguṭikādvaya-pradānam, puṣpabrāhmaṇena svanāmnā puṣpādityasthāpanam, puṣpādityamāhātmyavarṇanam 176 1
5.279.d: 157 ततो भोजनमकृत्वैव सूर्यमाराधयितुं पुष्पकस्य चमत्कारपुरे गमनम्, ततः सम-न्त्रकः सांगं होमं कृत्वा स्वमांसेन स्विष्टकृदादिकमवेक्ष्य सूर्यस्य तत्समीपं प्रत्या-गमनम्, सूर्येण पुष्पाख्याय मणिभद्ररूपकरण-स्वरूपकरणप्रभावशालिगुटिकाद्वय-प्रदानम्, पुष्पब्राह्मणेन स्वनाम्ना पुष्पादित्यस्थापनम्, पुष्पादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 176 1
5.279.m: 157. Then Puṣpaka going to Camatkārapura to worship the Sun without even taking food; then, having performed an oblation with mantras and all its limbs, offering his own flesh for the sviṣṭakṛt and other rites, the Sun coming into his presence; the Sun granting to the one named Puṣpa two magical pills possessing the power to assume the form of Maṇibhadra and to assume his own form; the brahmin Puṣpa installing Puṣpāditya under his own name; description of the māhātmya of Puṣpāditya. 176 1

5.279.s:
158 sūryadattaguṭikāprabhāvātpuṣpakeṇa maṇibhadrasadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā maṇibhadragṛhe gamanam, tasya satyamaṇibhadrasya gṛhaṃ gatvā dvārasthaṃ ṣaṇḍhaṃ vastrādinā santoṣya tasya patnīṃ vastrālaṃkārādinā santoṣya tayā saha sukhena bhuktvā saṃbhogakaraṇam, tatastasya kṛtrimamaṇibhadrasya vacanātsatyamaṇibhadrasya dvārasthaṣaṇḍhena dhikkārakaraṇam, kṛtri-mākṛtrimamaṇibhadrayo rājamadire vivādavarṇanam, tato rājavacanādakṛtrimamaṇi-
bhadrasya tatpatnyā svapatitvenāsvīkāre rājājñayā tasyākṛtrimamaṇibhadrasya rāja-dūtadvārā śākhāvalaṃbena nidhanavarṇanam..... ... 177 1
5.279.d:
158 सूर्यदत्तगुटिकाप्रभावात्पुष्पकेण मणिभद्रसदृशं रूपं धृत्वा मणिभद्रगृहे गमनम्, तस्य सत्यमणिभद्रस्य गृहं गत्वा द्वारस्थं षण्ढं वस्त्रादिना सन्तोष्य तस्य पत्नीं वस्त्रालंकारादिना सन्तोष्य तया सह सुखेन भुक्त्वा संभोगकरणम्, ततस्तस्य कृत्रिममणिभद्रस्य वचनात्सत्यमणिभद्रस्य द्वारस्थषण्ढेन धिक्कारकरणम्, कृत्रि-माकृत्रिममणिभद्रयो राजमदिरे विवादवर्णनम्, ततो राजवचनादकृत्रिममणि-
भद्रस्य तत्पत्न्या स्वपतित्वेनास्वीकारे राजाज्ञया तस्याकृत्रिममणिभद्रस्य राज-दूतद्वारा शाखावलंबेन निधनवर्णनम्..... ... 177 1
5.279.m: 158. Description of Puṣpaka going to Maṇibhadra's house having assumed a form resembling Maṇibhadra through the power of the pill given by Sūrya; going to that true Maṇibhadra's house, satisfying the eunuch stationed at the door with clothes and other things, satisfying his wife with clothes, ornaments, and other gifts, eating comfortably with her, and enjoying carnal pleasures; then, by the word of that counterfeit Maṇibhadra, the true Maṇibhadra being reproved by the eunuch at the door; description of the dispute between the counterfeit and true Maṇibhadras in the royal palace; then, upon the king's order, because she did not acknowledge the true Maṇibhadra as her husband, description of the execution of that true Maṇibhadra by the king's emissaries by hanging from a tree branch by order of the king. 177.1

5.279.s: 159 tata āptavargānsamāhūya tena kṛtrimeṇa puṣparūpamaṇibhadreṇa bhojanavastrādidānavarṇanam, puṣpavibhavavarṇanam. ........ ... 179 1
5.279.d: 159 तत आप्तवर्गान्समाहूय तेन कृत्रिमेण पुष्परूपमणिभद्रेण भोजनवस्त्रादिदानवर्णनम्, पुष्पविभववर्णनम्. ........ ... 179 1
5.279.m: 159. Description of calling the circle of kinsmen and giving food, clothes, and other gifts by that counterfeit Maṇibhadra whose real form was Puṣpa; description of Puṣpa's opulence. 179.1

5.279.s: 160 māhikāprārthanayā pūrvavatpuṣpaśarīraṃ dhṛtvā tena puṣpabrāhmaṇena māhikāyāḥ saukhyakara-ṇam , tatastena puṣpeṇa svaputrebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā kṛtasya pāpasya kṣālanārthaṃ hāṭakeśvara-kṣetre gamanam, puraścaraṇādīnkartuṃ brāhmaṇanimaṃtraṇakaraṇam, puṣpādityasya maṃdira-nirmāṇakaraṇam ... ....... . 179 1
5.279.d: 160 माहिकाप्रार्थनया पूर्ववत्पुष्पशरीरं धृत्वा तेन पुष्पब्राह्मणेन माहिकायाः सौख्यकर-णम् , ततस्तेन पुष्पेण स्वपुत्रेभ्यो धनं दत्त्वा कृतस्य पापस्य क्षालनार्थं हाटकेश्वर-क्षेत्रे गमनम्, पुरश्चरणादीन्कर्तुं ब्राह्मणनिमंत्रणकरणम्, पुष्पादित्यस्य मंदिर-निर्माणकरणम् ... ....... . 179 1
5.279.m: 160. At the request of Māhikā, assuming the body of Puṣpa as before, the granting of happiness to Māhikā by that brahmin Puṣpa; then, after giving wealth to his sons, going to the Hāṭakeśvara-kṣetra by that Puṣpa to wash away the sin committed; inviting brahmins to perform puraścaraṇa and other rites; constructing a temple to Puṣpāditya. 179.1

5.279.s: 161 puṣpādityamāhikādurgotpattimāhātmyavarṇanam......... 180 1
5.279.d: 161 पुष्पादित्यमाहिकादुर्गोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्......... 180 1
5.279.m: 161. Description of the origin and māhātmya of Puṣpāditya and Māhikā-durgā. 180.1

5.279.s: 162 puraścaraṇasaptamīvratakathane mārkaṇḍeyarohitāśvasaṃvāde nyāsapūrvakaṃ ṣoḍaśopacārapūjana-vidhivarṇanam, pratimāsapūjāviśeṣabhedavarṇanam, kenaciccaṃḍaśarmaṇā brāhmaṇena puṣpaṃ prati puraścaraṇasaptamīvratavidhivarṇanam . 180 2
5.279.d: 162 पुरश्चरणसप्तमीव्रतकथने मार्कण्डेयरोहिताश्वसंवादे न्यासपूर्वकं षोडशोपचारपूजन-विधिवर्णनम्, प्रतिमासपूजाविशेषभेदवर्णनम्, केनचिच्चंडशर्मणा ब्राह्मणेन पुष्पं प्रति पुरश्चरणसप्तमीव्रतविधिवर्णनम् . 180 2
5.279.m: 162. In the narration of the Puraścaraṇasaptamī-vrata, description of the procedure of sixteen-fold worship preceded by ritual placement (nyāsa) in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Rohitāśva; description of the special distinctions of worship month by month; description of the procedure of the Puraścaraṇasaptamī-vrata given by a certain brahmin named Caṇḍaśarman to Puṣpa. 180.2

5.279.s: 163 caṃḍaśarmaṇā śāstrāṇyāloḍya kathitena prāyaścittavidhinā puṣpasya pāpaśuddhau jātāyāṃ lokaiścaṇḍaśarmaṇastiraskaraṇam, tatastena caṇḍaśarmaṇā brāhmaṇena tapaḥkaraṇam, caṃḍa-śarmaṇā puṣpādityaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya svamāṃsenāgnau home kriyamāṇe pratyakṣeśvarasūrya-nārāyaṇena nijadarśanadānam, sūryadarśanena puṣpacaṇḍaśarmaṇoḥ pāpanivṛttipūrvakasurū-paprāptivarṇanam, brahmanāgarotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam... 182 1
5.279.d: 163 चंडशर्मणा शास्त्राण्यालोड्य कथितेन प्रायश्चित्तविधिना पुष्पस्य पापशुद्धौ जातायां लोकैश्चण्डशर्मणस्तिरस्करणम्, ततस्तेन चण्डशर्मणा ब्राह्मणेन तपःकरणम्, चंड-शर्मणा पुष्पादित्यं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य स्वमांसेनाग्नौ होमे क्रियमाणे प्रत्यक्षेश्वरसूर्य-नारायणेन निजदर्शनदानम्, सूर्यदर्शनेन पुष्पचण्डशर्मणोः पापनिवृत्तिपूर्वकसुरू-पप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, ब्रह्मनागरोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्... 182 1
5.279.m: 163. When Puṣpa's purification from sin occurred by the expiatory rite stated by Caṇḍaśarman after examining the scriptures, the censure of Caṇḍaśarman by the people; then the performance of austerity by that brahmin Caṇḍaśarman; while Caṇḍaśarman, having circumambulated Puṣpāditya, was offering oblations of his own flesh into the fire, the direct granting of his darśana by the visible Lord Sūryanārāyaṇa; description of the removal of sin and the attainment of handsome form by Puṣpa and Caṇḍaśarman through the darśana of Sūrya; description of the account of the origin of the Brāhmaṇa-nāgaras. 182.1

5.279.s: 164 tataḥ punaḥ puṣpacaṃḍaśarmaṇoḥ sarasvatītīre gamanam, tatra kardamena liṃgakaraṇapūrvakaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtavatā caṇḍaśarmaṇā nāgareśvareti nāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, caṇḍaśarmapatnyā śākaṃ-bharyā'pi śākambharīdurgāsthāpanam,caṇḍaśarmaṇā sarasvatītīre āgarādityasthāpanam, āgareśvaranāgarādityaśākaṃbharyutpattimāhātmyavarṇanam.... 183 1
5.279.d: 164 ततः पुनः पुष्पचंडशर्मणोः सरस्वतीतीरे गमनम्, तत्र कर्दमेन लिंगकरणपूर्वकं पूजनं कृतवता चण्डशर्मणा नागरेश्वरेति नाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, चण्डशर्मपत्न्या शाकं-भर्याऽपि शाकम्भरीदुर्गास्थापनम्,चण्डशर्मणा सरस्वतीतीरे आगरादित्यस्थापनम्, आगरेश्वरनागरादित्यशाकंभर्युत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... 183 1
5.279.m: 164. Then the return of Puṣpa and Caṇḍaśarman to the banks of the Sarasvatī; the installation of a liṅga under the name Nāgareśvara by Caṇḍaśarman who performed worship having made a liṅga of mud there; the installation of Śākambharī-durgā by Caṇḍaśarman's wife, Śākambharī; the installation of Āgarāditya on the bank of the Sarasvatī by Caṇḍaśarman; description of the origin and māhātmya of Āgareśvara, Nāgarāditya, and Śākambharī. 183.1

5.279.s: 165 viśvāmitrotpattikathana ṛcīkasya gādhikanyā yācanārthaṃ gādhigṛhe gamanam, tato yācanottaraṃ sahasraśyāmakarṇapradānena kanyāṃ dāsyāmīti rājapratijñāṃ śrutvā tacchyā-makarṇalabdhaye sarasvatītīre ṛcīkena tapaḥkaraṇam, tato mantrasāmarthyena śyāma-karṇām̐llabdhvā gādhisamīpe ṛcīkasya gamanam, aśvatīrthotpattivarṇanam... 184 1
5.279.d: 165 विश्वामित्रोत्पत्तिकथन ऋचीकस्य गाधिकन्या याचनार्थं गाधिगृहे गमनम्, ततो याचनोत्तरं सहस्रश्यामकर्णप्रदानेन कन्यां दास्यामीति राजप्रतिज्ञां श्रुत्वा तच्छ्या-मकर्णलब्धये सरस्वतीतीरे ऋचीकेन तपःकरणम्, ततो मन्त्रसामर्थ्येन श्याम-कर्णाम्̐ल्लब्ध्वा गाधिसमीपे ऋचीकस्य गमनम्, अश्वतीर्थोत्पत्तिवर्णनम्... 184 1
5.279.m: 165. In the narration of Viśvāmitra's birth, Ṛcīka's going to Gādhi's house to solicit Gādhi's daughter; then, after the request, hearing the king's condition, "I shall give my daughter upon the giving of a thousand black-eared horses," the performance of austerity by Ṛcīka on the bank of the Sarasvatī to obtain those black-eared horses; then, having obtained the black-eared horses through the power of mantras, Ṛcīka's going to Gādhi's presence; description of the origin of Aśvatīrtha. 184.1

5.279.s: 166 varapradānotsukasyarcīkasya vacaḥ śrutvā māturājñayā ṛcīkapatnyā māturātmanaśca putraprāptyarthamṛcīkaṃ prati prārthanākaraṇam, ṛcīkena patnīvākyaṃ śrutvā kṣātratejaḥ-prapūrakapuroḍāśaṃ gādhipatnyarthaṃ brāhmatejaḥsaṃyuktapuroḍāśaṃ svapatnyarthamiti puroḍāśa- dvayaṃ nirmāya ṛcīkena bhinnatvena dvābhyāṃ tatpuroḍāśadvayasya saṃpradānakaraṇam , tattadgṛhītvā tābhyāṃ rājapatnīdvijapatnībhyāṃ viparyāsakaraṇādṛcīkena garbhadohada-lakṣaṇaparīkṣayā puroḍāśavyatyayaṃ viditvā svapatnyai śāpapradānam , tatastatprārthanayā tasyai 'tava pautraḥ kṣātratejoyukto bhavet ityādyucchāpapradānam , paraśurāmotpatti-varṇanam. .......... 184 2
5.279.d: 166 वरप्रदानोत्सुकस्यर्चीकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मातुराज्ञया ऋचीकपत्न्या मातुरात्मनश्च पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थमृचीकं प्रति प्रार्थनाकरणम्, ऋचीकेन पत्नीवाक्यं श्रुत्वा क्षात्रतेजः-प्रपूरकपुरोडाशं गाधिपत्न्यर्थं ब्राह्मतेजःसंयुक्तपुरोडाशं स्वपत्न्यर्थमिति पुरोडाश- द्वयं निर्माय ऋचीकेन भिन्नत्वेन द्वाभ्यां तत्पुरोडाशद्वयस्य संप्रदानकरणम् , तत्तद्गृहीत्वा ताभ्यां राजपत्नीद्विजपत्नीभ्यां विपर्यासकरणादृचीकेन गर्भदोहद-लक्षणपरीक्षया पुरोडाशव्यत्ययं विदित्वा स्वपत्न्यै शापप्रदानम् , ततस्तत्प्रार्थनया तस्यै ऽतव पौत्रः क्षात्रतेजोयुक्तो भवेत् इत्याद्युच्छापप्रदानम् , परशुरामोत्पत्ति-वर्णनम्. .......... 184 2
5.279.m: 166. Hearing the words of Ṛcīka who was eager to grant a boon, Ṛcīka's wife, by order of her mother, making a request to Ṛcīka for the sake of obtaining a son for her mother and herself; Ṛcīka, having heard his wife's words, preparing two sacrificial cakes—a sacrificial cake filled with kṣatriya power for Gādhi's wife and a sacrificial cake endowed with brahminical power for his own wife—and bestowing the two sacrificial cakes separately to the two; because an exchange was made by the two—the king's wife and the brahmin's wife—after receiving them, Ṛcīka, having known the exchange of the sacrificial cakes by examining the signs of pregnancy cravings, granting a curse to his own wife; then, at her pleading, the granting of a counter-curse (relief) to her saying, "May your grandson be endowed with kṣatriya power"; description of the birth of Paraśurāma. 184.2

5.279.s: 167 viśvāmitrotpattivarṇanam, viśvāmitrasya sasainyasya vasiṣṭhāśrame gamanam, vasiṣṭhakāma-dhenuprabhāvaṃ jñāpvā tatprāptyarthaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ prati yācanākaraṇam , vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitra-yoryuddhavarṇanam, tatra vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitrasya doḥstaṃbhanakaraṇam, brāhmaṃ tejaḥ kṣātra-tejopekṣayā variṣṭhamiti matvā brāhmatejaḥsaṃpādanārtha rājyaṃ tyaktvā viśvāmi-trasya vane prayāṇam.............. ... 185 2
5.279.d: 167 विश्वामित्रोत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, विश्वामित्रस्य ससैन्यस्य वसिष्ठाश्रमे गमनम्, वसिष्ठकाम-धेनुप्रभावं ज्ञाप्वा तत्प्राप्त्यर्थं वसिष्ठं प्रति याचनाकरणम् , वसिष्ठविश्वामित्र-योर्युद्धवर्णनम्, तत्र वसिष्ठेन विश्वामित्रस्य दोःस्तंभनकरणम्, ब्राह्मं तेजः क्षात्र-तेजोपेक्षया वरिष्ठमिति मत्वा ब्राह्मतेजःसंपादनार्थ राज्यं त्यक्त्वा विश्वामि-त्रस्य वने प्रयाणम्.............. ... 185 2
5.279.m: 167. Description of the birth of Viśvāmitra; Viśvāmitra's going to Vasiṣṭha's hermitage along with his army; having recognized the power of Vasiṣṭha's wishing-cow (kāmadhenu), making a request to Vasiṣṭha to obtain it; description of the battle between Vasiṣṭha and Viśvāmitra; there, the paralyzing of Viśvāmitra's arms by Vasiṣṭha; considering that brahminical power is superior to kṣatriya power, Viśvāmitra's journey to the forest having abandoned his kingdom in order to acquire brahminical power. 185.2

5.279.s: 168 viśvāmitrakṛtā ghoratapaścaryā vilokyendrabrahmaṇorvarapradānārthaṃ viśvāmitrāgre gamanam, brāhmaṃ tejo durlabhamiti matvāpi ṛcīkavacanātkevalaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ vinā sarvairayaṃ brahmarṣiriti bhāṣitakaraṇam , vasiṣṭhavināśārthaṃ viśvāmitreṇātharvaṇikamaṃtrairagnau homa ārabdhe sati tasmādagneḥ kṛtyāyā udbhavaḥ, viśvāmitreṇa tasyāḥ kṛtyāyā vasiṣṭhaṃ prati preṣaṇam, tasyā vasiṣṭhahṛdayaṃspṛṣṭvā tatraiva patanam, dhāreti tasyā nāmakaraṇam, dhārotpattimāhātmyavarṇanam.............. 187 2
5.279.d: 168 विश्वामित्रकृता घोरतपश्चर्या विलोक्येन्द्रब्रह्मणोर्वरप्रदानार्थं विश्वामित्राग्रे गमनम्, ब्राह्मं तेजो दुर्लभमिति मत्वापि ऋचीकवचनात्केवलं वसिष्ठं विना सर्वैरयं ब्रह्मर्षिरिति भाषितकरणम् , वसिष्ठविनाशार्थं विश्वामित्रेणाथर्वणिकमंत्रैरग्नौ होम आरब्धे सति तस्मादग्नेः कृत्याया उद्भवः, विश्वामित्रेण तस्याः कृत्याया वसिष्ठं प्रति प्रेषणम्, तस्या वसिष्ठहृदयंस्पृष्ट्वा तत्रैव पतनम्, धारेति तस्या नामकरणम्, धारोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.............. 187 2
5.279.m: 168. Beholding the severe practice of austerities performed by Viśvāmitra, the arrival of Indra and Brahmā before Viśvāmitra to grant a boon; although brahminical power is difficult to attain, because of Ṛcīka's word, all proclaiming him to be a brahmin seer (brahmarṣi) except Vasiṣṭha alone; when an oblation in the fire with Atharvan mantras was commenced by Viśvāmitra for the destruction of Vasiṣṭha, the rising of a malevolent spirit (kṛtyā) from that fire; the dispatching of that kṛtyā towards Vasiṣṭha by Viśvāmitra; her falling right there upon touching Vasiṣṭha's heart; giving her the name Dhārā; description of the origin and māhātmya of Dhārā. 187.2

5.279.s: 169 vasiṣṭhapatnyā'rundhatyā dhārātīrtha āgatya tattīrthasya devyāśca stavakaraṇam, dhārānā-motpattivṛttāntadhārādevīmāhātmyavarṇanam....... .... 188 2
5.279.d: 169 वसिष्ठपत्न्याऽरुन्धत्या धारातीर्थ आगत्य तत्तीर्थस्य देव्याश्च स्तवकरणम्, धाराना-मोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तधारादेवीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्....... .... 188 2
5.279.m: 169. Vasiṣṭha's wife Arundhatī coming to Dhārātīrtha and offering praise to that sacred ford and the goddess; description of the account of the origin of the name Dhārā and the māhātmya of goddess Dhārā. 188.2

5.279.s: 170 dhārātīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanam....... ...... 189 2
5.279.m: 170. Description of the origin and māhātmya of Dhārātīrtha. 189.2

5.279.s: 171 viśvāmitreṇa vasiṣṭhopari preṣitāyāḥ svaśaktyā niṣphalatvaṃ vīkṣya brāhmāstrādyastrairyuddha-karaṇam, vasiṣṭhapreritatatpratidvandvayastrairbhūtale pralayamiva dṛṣṭvā tatra brahmaṇo gamanam, vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitrayoḥ sāmakaraṇam, viśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoryuddhe divyāstranivartanava-rṇanam................... 189 2
5.279.d: 171 विश्वामित्रेण वसिष्ठोपरि प्रेषितायाः स्वशक्त्या निष्फलत्वं वीक्ष्य ब्राह्मास्त्राद्यस्त्रैर्युद्ध-करणम्, वसिष्ठप्रेरिततत्प्रतिद्वन्द्वयस्त्रैर्भूतले प्रलयमिव दृष्ट्वा तत्र ब्रह्मणो गमनम्, वसिष्ठविश्वामित्रयोः सामकरणम्, विश्वामित्रवसिष्ठयोर्युद्धे दिव्यास्त्रनिवर्तनव-र्णनम्................... 189 2
5.279.m: 171. Seeing the futility of his own missile dispatched against Vasiṣṭha, Viśvāmitra engaging in battle with the Brahmā weapon and other weapons; seeing what seemed like universal dissolution on the earth due to the counter-weapons released by Vasiṣṭha, Brahmā's going there; Brahmā's effecting conciliation between Vasiṣṭha and Viśvāmitra; description of the withdrawal of divine weapons in the battle between Viśvāmitra and Vasiṣṭha. 189.2

172 vasiṣṭhadrohakaraṇārthaṃ sarasvatyā viśvāmitreṇājñākaraṇam, tayā sarasvatyā kṛtaṃ svājñā-bhaṃgaṃ vijñāya viśvāmitreṇa sarasvatyai śāpapradānam......... 190 1
173 sarasvatīśāpamocanapūrvakasābhramapyutpattivṛttāntavarṇanam........ 190 2
5.279.d:
172 वसिष्ठद्रोहकरणार्थं सरस्वत्या विश्वामित्रेणाज्ञाकरणम्, तया सरस्वत्या कृतं स्वाज्ञा-भंगं विज्ञाय विश्वामित्रेण सरस्वत्यै शापप्रदानम्......... 190 1
173 सरस्वतीशापमोचनपूर्वकसाभ्रमप्युत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्........ 190 2
5.279.m: 172. Viśvāmitra giving an order to Sarasvatī to commit treason against Vasiṣṭha; upon learning that his order was broken by Sarasvatī, Viśvāmitra's giving of a curse to Sarasvatī... 190 1 / 173. Description of the account of the origin of Sābhramatī preceded by the release from Sarasvatī's curse... 190 2

5.279.s: 174 atha pippalādotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam , tatra janmakāle'tikaṣṭatarāṃ daśāmāpannaṃ pippa-lādaṃ prati samāgatena nāradena pippalādakṛtaṃ nijadurdaśākāraṇajijñāsayā praśnaṃ śrutvā śanaiścarasya janmarāśisthatvādidaṃ te garhitaṃ janmeti pippalādaṃ prati kathite sati pippalādena svadṛṣṭipātena śanaiścarasya svasthānātpāte kṛte sati nāradena śanaiścarasya gagane staṃbhanam, tataḥ pippalādena nāradopadeśātpīḍāparihārārthaṃ śanai-ścarastutikaraṇam, śanaiścareṇa tasmai varapradānam, pippalādasya - yājñavalkayāya samarpaṇakaraṇam... ........... 191 1
5.279.d: 174 अथ पिप्पलादोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् , तत्र जन्मकालेऽतिकष्टतरां दशामापन्नं पिप्प-लादं प्रति समागतेन नारदेन पिप्पलादकृतं निजदुर्दशाकारणजिज्ञासया प्रश्नं श्रुत्वा शनैश्चरस्य जन्मराशिस्थत्वादिदं ते गर्हितं जन्मेति पिप्पलादं प्रति कथिते सति पिप्पलादेन स्वदृष्टिपातेन शनैश्चरस्य स्वस्थानात्पाते कृते सति नारदेन शनैश्चरस्य गगने स्तंभनम्, ततः पिप्पलादेन नारदोपदेशात्पीडापरिहारार्थं शनै-श्चरस्तुतिकरणम्, शनैश्चरेण तस्मै वरप्रदानम्, पिप्पलादस्य - याज्ञवल्कयाय समर्पणकरणम्... ........... 191 1
5.279.m: 174. Now, the description of the account of Pippalāda's origin; there, Nārada approaching Pippalāda who had reached an extremely wretched condition at the time of birth, and hearing the question posed by Pippalāda desiring to know the cause of his own misfortune; when it was stated to Pippalāda, 'Because Śanaiścara stands in your natal sign, this birth of yours is despicable,' Pippalāda making Śanaiścara fall from his position by casting his glance; Nārada stopping Śanaiścara in the sky; then Pippalāda, following Nārada's instruction, composing a praise of Śanaiścara to avert affliction; Śanaiścara granting him a boon; entrustment of Pippalāda to Yājñavalkya... 191 1

5.279.s: 175 yājñavalkyena svakṛtājñānajanyapātakadoṣanibarhaṇārthaṃ brahmājñayā hāṭakeśvare gamanaṃ liṃga-sthāpanaṃ ca, yājñavalkyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam ....... 193 1
5.279.d: 175 याज्ञवल्क्येन स्वकृताज्ञानजन्यपातकदोषनिबर्हणार्थं ब्रह्माज्ञया हाटकेश्वरे गमनं लिंग-स्थापनं च, याज्ञवल्क्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ....... 193 1
5.279.m: 175. Yājñavalkya's departure to Hāṭakeśvara and establishment of a liṅga by Brahmā's command in order to eradicate the fault of sin born of his own ignorance; description of the māhātmya of Yājñavalkyeśvara... 193 1

5.279.s: 176 kaṃsāreśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanam.... ......... 193 2
5.279.m: 176. Description of the origin and māhātmya of Kaṃsāreśvara... 193 2

5.279.s: 177 kāśirājapatnyā padmāvatyā saubhāgyavardhanārthaṃ vālukayā pañcaliṃgānnirmāya tatpūjanam, tatprabhāveṇa tasyā rājyādisaubhāgyaprāptivarṇanam, pañcapiṃḍikotpattimāhātmya-varṇanam ....... .............. .. 194 1
5.279.d: 177 काशिराजपत्न्या पद्मावत्या सौभाग्यवर्धनार्थं वालुकया पञ्चलिंगान्निर्माय तत्पूजनम्, तत्प्रभावेण तस्या राज्यादिसौभाग्यप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, पञ्चपिंडिकोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्य-वर्णनम् ....... .............. .. 194 1
5.279.m: 177. Padmāvatī, wife of the king of Kāśī, fashioning five liṅgas out of sand and worshipping them to increase good fortune; description of her obtaining good fortune such as a kingdom through its power; description of the origin and māhātmya of Pañcapiṇḍikā... 194 1

5.279.s: 178 pañcapiṃḍikāgaurīmāhātmyavarṇane lakṣmīviṣṇusaṃvāde viṣṇupṛcchayā lakṣmyā viṣṇu prāptyarthaṃ durvāsaso vacanātpaṃcagaurīpūjanam, atha lakṣmyā tadvisarjanasamaye gaurīvacanātpaṃcapiṃḍāgaurītināmnā hāṭakeśvare sthāpanam, pañcapiṃḍāgaurīmāhā-tmyavarṇanam ........ .. 195 2
5.279.d: 178 पञ्चपिंडिकागौरीमाहात्म्यवर्णने लक्ष्मीविष्णुसंवादे विष्णुपृच्छया लक्ष्म्या विष्णु प्राप्त्यर्थं दुर्वाससो वचनात्पंचगौरीपूजनम्, अथ लक्ष्म्या तद्विसर्जनसमये गौरीवचनात्पंचपिंडागौरीतिनाम्ना हाटकेश्वरे स्थापनम्, पञ्चपिंडागौरीमाहा-त्म्यवर्णनम् ........ .. 195 2
5.279.m: 178. In the description of the māhātmya of Pañcapiṇḍikāgaurī: in the conversation between Lakṣmī and Viṣṇu, at Viṣṇu's inquiry, Lakṣmī's worship of the Five Gaurīs following Durvāsas's word in order to obtain Viṣṇu; then, at the time of their dismissal, Lakṣmī's establishment [of them] in Hāṭakeśvara under the name Pañcapiṇḍāgaurī according to Gaurī's word; description of the māhātmya of Pañcapiṇḍāgaurī... 195 2

5.279.s: 179 puṣkaratrayavarṇane brahmanāradasaṃvāde nāradamukhādanekaduḥkhāvṛtāñjanānavekṣya brahmaṇā lokarakṣārthaṃ bhūtale kamalaprakṣepaṇam, tatra hāṭakeśvare tatkamalapatanena gartātraya-nirmāṇakaraṇam, tatastatra brahmādibhiryajñasamāraṃbhārthamupakaraṇānayanabrāhmaṇāmantraṇā-diprakārakathanam... .... .... 197 2
5.279.d: 179 पुष्करत्रयवर्णने ब्रह्मनारदसंवादे नारदमुखादनेकदुःखावृताञ्जनानवेक्ष्य ब्रह्मणा लोकरक्षार्थं भूतले कमलप्रक्षेपणम्, तत्र हाटकेश्वरे तत्कमलपतनेन गर्तात्रय-निर्माणकरणम्, ततस्तत्र ब्रह्मादिभिर्यज्ञसमारंभार्थमुपकरणानयनब्राह्मणामन्त्रणा-दिप्रकारकथनम्... .... .... 197 2
5.279.m: 179. In the description of the three Puṣkaras: in the conversation between Brahmā and Nārada, Brahmā, observing people afflicted by many sorrows from Nārada's mouth, casting a lotus onto the surface of the earth to protect the world; there, in Hāṭakeśvara, the formation of three pits by the fall of that lotus; then, the narration of the manner of fetching utensils, inviting brahmins, and the like by Brahmā and others for the purpose of undertaking the sacrifice there... 197 2

5.279.s: 180 yajñamaṇḍapaprāptabrāhmaṇasatkārapūrvaka liṃgādisthānayojanāpūrvakādhvarakarmāraṃbhavarṇanam.... 198 2
5.279.d: 180 यज्ञमण्डपप्राप्तब्राह्मणसत्कारपूर्वक लिंगादिस्थानयोजनापूर्वकाध्वरकर्मारंभवर्णनम्.... 198 2
5.279.m: 180. Description of the commencement of the rite of sacrifice preceded by honouring the brahmins who arrived at the sacrificial hall and arranging the places of the liṅgas and the like... 198 2

5.279.s: 181 nāgarairbāhyaṃ śrāddhaṃ yajño vā vṛtheti nāgarabrāhmaṇānbrahmaṇā varapradānam, brahmaṇo vacanāpsāvitrīmānetuṃ nāradasya brahmaloke gamanam, 'nāhamekākinyāgamiṣyāmi iti tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇā punaḥ pulastyasya saṃpreṣaṇam, sāvitryā durāgrahaṃ samālokya kāmapyanyākanyāmānayeti śakraṃ prati brahmaṇāsaṃpreṣaṇam , śakreṇa kāṃci-dgopakanyāṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhītvā ca gorvaktreṇa praveśya guhyena niṣkāsya tasyāḥ pavitrīkara-ṇam, tāṃ pūtāṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇurudrādidevavacanādbrahmaṇā tasyā gopakanyāyāḥ pāṇigrahaṇakaraṇam, gāyatrīvivāhottaraṃ gāyatrītīrthasthāpanam, gāyatrītīrthamāhātmya-varṇanam. . .. ...... .. 199 2
5.279.d: 181 नागरैर्बाह्यं श्राद्धं यज्ञो वा वृथेति नागरब्राह्मणान्ब्रह्मणा वरप्रदानम्, ब्रह्मणो वचनाप्सावित्रीमानेतुं नारदस्य ब्रह्मलोके गमनम्, ऽनाहमेकाकिन्यागमिष्यामि इति तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणा पुनः पुलस्त्यस्य संप्रेषणम्, सावित्र्या दुराग्रहं समालोक्य कामप्यन्याकन्यामानयेति शक्रं प्रति ब्रह्मणासंप्रेषणम् , शक्रेण कांचि-द्गोपकन्यां दृष्ट्वा गृहीत्वा च गोर्वक्त्रेण प्रवेश्य गुह्येन निष्कास्य तस्याः पवित्रीकर-णम्, तां पूतां दृष्ट्वा विष्णुरुद्रादिदेववचनाद्ब्रह्मणा तस्या गोपकन्यायाः पाणिग्रहणकरणम्, गायत्रीविवाहोत्तरं गायत्रीतीर्थस्थापनम्, गायत्रीतीर्थमाहात्म्य-वर्णनम्. . .. ...... .. 199 2
5.279.m: 181. Brahmā granting a boon to the Nāgara brahmins that an external ancestral rite or sacrifice [performed] by Nāgaras is futile; Nārada's going to Brahmaloka to bring Sāvitrī at the word of Brahmā; hearing her word, 'I shall not go alone,' Brahmā sending Pulastya again; seeing Sāvitrī's obstinacy, Brahmā sending Śakra: 'Bring any other maiden'; Śakra seeing a cowherd maiden, taking her, purifying her by making her enter through a cow's mouth and exit through its secret parts; seeing her purified, Brahmā taking the hand of that cowherd maiden in marriage according to the word of the gods led by Viṣṇu and Rudra; establishment of Gāyatrītīrtha after the marriage of Gāyatrī; description of the māhātmya of Gāyatrītīrtha... 199 2

5.279.s:
182 tato gāyatryā nakhanikṛṃtanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ keśanirvapaṇaṃ ca kārayitvā daṇḍādikaṃ haste dattvā carmādibhiḥ sahobhayoryajñaśālāgamanam, tatastatra kasyacijjālmasyāgama-nam , paitāmaho'yaṃ yajño'nindya iti teṣāmṛtvijāṃ vacanamākarṇya yajñe jālmena kapālaprakṣepaṇam, ṛṣibhiḥ padā''hatya tasminkapāle bahirnikṣipte tatsthale punarana-ntakapālotpattiṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā haraprārthanākaraṇam, harakṛpayā'riṣṭanirasanam,rūpatī-
rthotpattivarṇanapūrvakaṃ tasya yakṣasya prathamadivasavṛttāntavarṇanam .... 201 1
5.279.d:
182 ततो गायत्र्या नखनिकृंतनं ब्रह्मणः केशनिर्वपणं च कारयित्वा दण्डादिकं हस्ते दत्त्वा चर्मादिभिः सहोभयोर्यज्ञशालागमनम्, ततस्तत्र कस्यचिज्जाल्मस्यागम-नम् , पैतामहोऽयं यज्ञोऽनिन्द्य इति तेषामृत्विजां वचनमाकर्ण्य यज्ञे जाल्मेन कपालप्रक्षेपणम्, ऋषिभिः पदा'ऽहत्य तस्मिन्कपाले बहिर्निक्षिप्ते तत्स्थले पुनरन-न्तकपालोत्पत्तिं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणा हरप्रार्थनाकरणम्, हरकृपयाऽरिष्टनिरसनम्,रूपती-
र्थोत्पत्तिवर्णनपूर्वकं तस्य यक्षस्य प्रथमदिवसवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् .... 201 1
5.279.m: 182. Then, having caused Gāyatrī's nails to be trimmed and Brahmā's hair to be shaved, giving a staff and the like into their hands, the two going to the sacrificial pavilion along with the deer-skin and the like; then, the arrival of a villain there; hearing the words of those priests, 'This sacrifice belonging to the Grandfather is blameless,' the villain throwing a skull into the sacrifice; when that skull was struck with a foot by the seers and thrown outside, seeing the arising of countless skulls again in that place, Brahmā praying to Hara; the removal of the calamity through Hara's grace; description of the first day's account of that yakṣa preceded by the description of the origin of Rūpatīrtha... 201 1

5.279.s: 183 yajñasya dvitīyadivase yajñamadhye kenāpi baṭunā sarpanikṣepaṇam, tena sarpeṇa hotuḥ śarīraṃ veṣṭitamiti maitrāvaruṇakarmaṇi sthitena hotuḥ putreṇa dṛṣṭvā sarpanikṣepakāriṇaṃ baṭuṃ prati śāpadānam, tatastatprārthanayocchāpasyāpi pradānam, tatraiva nāgatīrtha-sthāpanam, nāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam . 202 2
5.279.d: 183 यज्ञस्य द्वितीयदिवसे यज्ञमध्ये केनापि बटुना सर्पनिक्षेपणम्, तेन सर्पेण होतुः शरीरं वेष्टितमिति मैत्रावरुणकर्मणि स्थितेन होतुः पुत्रेण दृष्ट्वा सर्पनिक्षेपकारिणं बटुं प्रति शापदानम्, ततस्तत्प्रार्थनयोच्छापस्यापि प्रदानम्, तत्रैव नागतीर्थ-स्थापनम्, नागतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् . 202 2
5.279.m: 183. On the second day of the sacrifice, a certain boy throwing a snake into the midst of the sacrifice; seeing that the body of the hotṛ priest was coiled by that snake, the hotṛ's son, standing in the duty of the maitrāvaruṇa priest, cursing the boy who had thrown the snake; then, at his entreaty, the granting of release from the curse as well; establishment of Nāgatīrtha right there; description of the māhātmya of Nāgatīrtha... 202 2

5.279.s: 184 tṛtīye divase tatra yajñe bhojanādisamāraṃbhe kasyacidatitherāgamanam, tena saha saṃvāda ṛtvigbhistasya puṣṭatvakāraṇe pṛṣṭe tenātithinā 'piṃgalādiṣaḍagurubhyo mayā jñānaṃ labdham iti kathanam, tacchutvā kathaṃ jñānaṃ labdham ityṛtvigbhiḥ praśne kṛte'tithinā tānprati piṃgalākhyānakathanam, tatra prathamataḥ svasya gotrakulajanmādivṛttānta-kathanam, tasyātitherbālye vayasi pitaryuparate satyānartādhipatergṛhe sevākaraṇārtha gamanam, tatra ānartādhipateḥ piṃgalāyā veśyāyāḥ suratasukhopabhoge gatatṛṣṇatvena sukhena svapanam, tathā'nyāsāṃ strīṇāṃ kāmapīḍitatvena śāntisamādhānasukhābhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā piṃgalāto vigatatṛṣṇatvarūpaguṇagrahaṇavarṇanam, piṃgalopākhyānavarṇanam .. 204 1
5.279.d: 184 तृतीये दिवसे तत्र यज्ञे भोजनादिसमारंभे कस्यचिदतिथेरागमनम्, तेन सह संवाद ऋत्विग्भिस्तस्य पुष्टत्वकारणे पृष्टे तेनातिथिना ऽपिंगलादिषडगुरुभ्यो मया ज्ञानं लब्धम् इति कथनम्, तच्छुत्वा कथं ज्ञानं लब्धम् इत्यृत्विग्भिः प्रश्ने कृतेऽतिथिना तान्प्रति पिंगलाख्यानकथनम्, तत्र प्रथमतः स्वस्य गोत्रकुलजन्मादिवृत्तान्त-कथनम्, तस्यातिथेर्बाल्ये वयसि पितर्युपरते सत्यानर्ताधिपतेर्गृहे सेवाकरणार्थ गमनम्, तत्र आनर्ताधिपतेः पिंगलाया वेश्यायाः सुरतसुखोपभोगे गततृष्णत्वेन सुखेन स्वपनम्, तथाऽन्यासां स्त्रीणां कामपीडितत्वेन शान्तिसमाधानसुखाभावं दृष्ट्वा पिंगलातो विगततृष्णत्वरूपगुणग्रहणवर्णनम्, पिंगलोपाख्यानवर्णनम् .. 204 1
5.279.m: 184. On the third day, at the undertaking of dining and the like in that sacrifice, the arrival of a certain guest; a dialogue with him; when the reason for his plumpness was asked by the priests, that guest saying, 'Knowledge was acquired by me from six teachers beginning with Piṅgalā'; hearing that, when asked by the priests, 'How was knowledge acquired?', the guest narrating the story of Piṅgalā to them; there, first, the narration of his own lineage, family, birth, and the like; when his father died in that guest's childhood, his going to the house of the king of Ānarta to perform service; there, the description of [his] receiving the quality in the form of absence of thirst from Piṅgalā, having seen that the courtesan Piṅgalā slept happily because thirst had gone in enjoying the pleasure of sexual union with the king of Ānarta, and that other women lacked the happiness of peace and composure because they were afflicted by desire; narration of the story of Piṅgalā... 204 1

5.279.s: 185 kurarato guṇagrahaṇādivarṇane yathā kuraro nirāmiṣaḥ sukhī babhūva tathā manuṣyairbhāvyami-tyādi manasi vicārya sarvaṃ vittaṃ dāyādahaste dattvātitheḥ sukhībhavanam, sarpā-dgurutvabuddhyā guṇagrahaṇavarṇane paragṛhavāsināṃ sarpāṇāṃ svabhāvavarṇanapūrvakayati-dharmanirūpaṇam, evaṃ bhramarādibhyo'pi guṇagrahaṇavarṇanam, evamatithisaṃbhāṣaṇe pravṛtte sati tatra viṣṇvindrādīnāṃ devānāmāgamanam, paitāmahayajñaśobhāvarṇanam, atithitīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanam 204 2
5.279.d: 185 कुररतो गुणग्रहणादिवर्णने यथा कुररो निरामिषः सुखी बभूव तथा मनुष्यैर्भाव्यमि-त्यादि मनसि विचार्य सर्वं वित्तं दायादहस्ते दत्त्वातिथेः सुखीभवनम्, सर्पा-द्गुरुत्वबुद्ध्या गुणग्रहणवर्णने परगृहवासिनां सर्पाणां स्वभाववर्णनपूर्वकयति-धर्मनिरूपणम्, एवं भ्रमरादिभ्योऽपि गुणग्रहणवर्णनम्, एवमतिथिसंभाषणे प्रवृत्ते सति तत्र विष्ण्विन्द्रादीनां देवानामागमनम्, पैतामहयज्ञशोभावर्णनम्, अतिथितीर्थोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 204 2
5.279.m: 185. In the description of taking lessons from the osprey and others: reflecting in mind, 'Just as the osprey became happy when meatless, so should men be,' and the like, the guest becoming happy having placed all wealth into the hands of heirs; in the description of drawing a lesson from the serpent with the thought of teacherhood, the determination of the duty of an ascetic preceded by the description of the nature of serpents living in others' dwellings; likewise, the description of receiving qualities even from the bee and others; while the guest's conversation was thus underway, the arrival of the gods led by Viṣṇu and Indra there; description of the splendour of the sacrifice of the Grandfather; description of the origin and māhātmya of Atithitīrtha... 204 2

5.279.s: 186 gṛhāgatasyātitheḥ satkārapūjanādimāhātmyavarṇanam... .... 207 1
5.279.d: 186 गृहागतस्यातिथेः सत्कारपूजनादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... .... 207 1
5.279.m: 186. Description of the greatness of showing hospitality and worshipping a guest who has arrived at one's home... 207 1

5.279.s: 187 caturthe'hani kasyacidviśvāvasunāmnaḥ pulastyaputrasya jihvālaulyādyajñiyapaśugudamāṃsa-bhakṣaṇena brāhmaṇaistasya rākṣasatvaprāpakaśāpapradānam, tena śāpena tasya viśvāvasu-nāmnaḥ pulastyaputrasya sadyo rākṣasatvaprāptivarṇanam, tato brahmaṇā tasya svapautrasya tṛptyarthaṃ vyavasthākaraṇaprasaṅgena rākṣasaprāpyaśrāddhavarṇanam. .. ... 207 2
5.279.d: 187 चतुर्थेऽहनि कस्यचिद्विश्वावसुनाम्नः पुलस्त्यपुत्रस्य जिह्वालौल्याद्यज्ञियपशुगुदमांस-भक्षणेन ब्राह्मणैस्तस्य राक्षसत्वप्रापकशापप्रदानम्, तेन शापेन तस्य विश्वावसु-नाम्नः पुलस्त्यपुत्रस्य सद्यो राक्षसत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, ततो ब्रह्मणा तस्य स्वपौत्रस्य तृप्त्यर्थं व्यवस्थाकरणप्रसङ्गेन राक्षसप्राप्यश्राद्धवर्णनम्. .. ... 207 2
5.279.m: 187. Description of how, on the fourth day, because of greed of the tongue, a certain son of Pulastya named Viśvāvasu ate the meat of the rectum of a sacrificial animal, and the brahmins pronounced a curse on him causing him to become a rākṣasa; description of that son of Pulastya named Viśvāvasu instantly becoming a rākṣasa through that curse; then, in the course of Brahmā arranging for the satisfaction of his grandson, description of the śrāddha to be received by rākṣasas... 207 2

5.279.s: 188 pañcame'hani udgātṛnirmite gīte gītaśravaṇārthamauduṃbaryā āgamanam, auduṃbaryudgātroḥ saṃvādavarṇanam, tatrauduṃbaryā svajanmavṛttāntakathanam, auduṃbarīṃ pratyudgātrā vara-pradānam, śaṃkupracārapūjanamāhātmyavarṇanam, auduṃbarīśāpanivṛttivarṇanam, tatre-śvareṇa saha sarvadevatānāmāgamanam, mātṛgaṇasya svasvasthānaṃ prati gantuṃ tasyāḥ sakāśato gamane sati sāvitryā mātṛgaṇāya śāpadānavṛttāntavarṇanam ... 209 1
5.279.d: 188 पञ्चमेऽहनि उद्गातृनिर्मिते गीते गीतश्रवणार्थमौदुंबर्या आगमनम्, औदुंबर्युद्गात्रोः संवादवर्णनम्, तत्रौदुंबर्या स्वजन्मवृत्तान्तकथनम्, औदुंबरीं प्रत्युद्गात्रा वर-प्रदानम्, शंकुप्रचारपूजनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, औदुंबरीशापनिवृत्तिवर्णनम्, तत्रे-श्वरेण सह सर्वदेवतानामागमनम्, मातृगणस्य स्वस्वस्थानं प्रति गन्तुं तस्याः सकाशतो गमने सति सावित्र्या मातृगणाय शापदानवृत्तान्तवर्णनम् ... 209 1
5.279.m: 188. Description of how, on the fifth day, the audumbarī arrived to hear the chant when a chant was performed by the udgātṛ; description of the dialogue between the audumbarī and the udgātṛ; therein, the narration of her previous life's story by the audumbarī; the granting of a boon to the audumbarī by the udgātṛ; description of the greatness of the worship and movement of the peg; description of the audumbarī's release from the curse; the arrival of all the deities together with Īśvara there; when the group of Mothers set out from her presence to return each to her own abode, description of the account of Sāvitrī giving a curse to the group of Mothers... 209 1

5.279.s: 189 auduṃbaryutpattipūrvakatatprāgjanmavṛttāntavarṇanam... ...... 211 1
5.279.d: 189 औदुंबर्युत्पत्तिपूर्वकतत्प्राग्जन्मवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्... ...... 211 1
5.279.m: 189. Description of the account of the previous birth preceded by the origin of the audumbarī... 211 1

5.279.s: 190 brahmaṇā yajñānte sarvānnāgarānāhūya tebhyaḥ sarve yajñagatavṛttāntaṃ tīrthotpattyādikaṃ ca kathayitvā avabhṛthasnānārthaṃ sartvijo brahmaṇo jyeṣṭhapuṣkare gamanam, brahmaṇe-ndrādibhyo varapradānam, brahmaṇā tasminsamaye tatrāgatāya yakṣmaṇe varapradānam, yakṣmatīrthotpattivarṇanam ... . 211 2
5.279.d: 190 ब्रह्मणा यज्ञान्ते सर्वान्नागरानाहूय तेभ्यः सर्वे यज्ञगतवृत्तान्तं तीर्थोत्पत्त्यादिकं च कथयित्वा अवभृथस्नानार्थं सर्त्विजो ब्रह्मणो ज्येष्ठपुष्करे गमनम्, ब्रह्मणे-न्द्रादिभ्यो वरप्रदानम्, ब्रह्मणा तस्मिन्समये तत्रागताय यक्ष्मणे वरप्रदानम्, यक्ष्मतीर्थोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् ... . 211 2
5.279.m: 190. How Brahmā, at the conclusion of the sacrifice, summoned all the Nāgaras, recounted to them all the events that occurred at the sacrifice as well as the origins of the sacred fords, and went together with the priests to Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara for the avabhṛtha bath; the granting of boons by Brahmā to Indra and the others; the granting of a boon by Brahmā to Yakṣman who had arrived there at that time; description of the origin of the Yakṣmatīrtha... 211 2

5.279.s: 191 sāvitryā yajñamaṇḍapaṃ pratyāgamanakāle saṃjāyamānotpātādyapaśakunodbhavavarṇanam, ghṛtācyādyapsarasāṃ tatrāgamanam , tatkṛtagāyanavādanahāsyādīnāṃ varṇanam . 203 2
5.279.d: 191 सावित्र्या यज्ञमण्डपं प्रत्यागमनकाले संजायमानोत्पाताद्यपशकुनोद्भववर्णनम्, घृताच्याद्यप्सरसां तत्रागमनम् , तत्कृतगायनवादनहास्यादीनां वर्णनम् . 203 2
5.279.m: 191. Description of the occurrence of portents and bad omens arising at the time of Sāvitrī's arrival at the sacrificial pavilion; the arrival of apsarases such as Ghṛtācī there, and the description of the singing, instrumental playing, joking, and the like performed by them... 203 2

197 तस्मिन्नवसरे वेश्यागृहं गतस्य कस्यचिद्विश्वावसुपुत्रस्य परावसुनाम्नो विप्रविद्या-र्थिनो रात्रौ निद्रावशेन तृष्णया पीडिततयाऽज्ञानेन मद्यप्राशनम्, ततः पश्चात्ता-पेन तेन प्रातः शंखतीर्थे गत्वा वपनादिकं कृत्वाऽन्त्यजवद्गुरुगृहे दूरतोऽवस्थाने तत्सतीर्थ्यैस्तं प्रति प्रश्नकरणम्, तत्सतीर्थ्यैस्तस्मै परिहासोक्त्या ऽरत्नावती-स्तनग्रहणाधरास्वादनतस्ते पापनिर्मुक्तिः स्यात् इति प्रायश्चित्तकथनम्, ततो विश्वावसुना गुरोराज्ञया सर्ववृत्तान्तकथनम् , अथ धर्मशास्त्रज्ञब्राह्मणोक्ताग्नितुल्य- घृतप्राशनरूपप्रायश्चित्तं ग्रहीतुमुद्युक्तं विश्वावसुं दृष्ट्वा तन्मातापित्रोराक्रोशकरणम्, ततो भर्तृयज्ञेन रत्नावतीस्तनग्रहणाधरास्वादनेन मद्यपानशुद्धिः स्यादिति प्रथ-मतो विप्रविद्यार्थिभिः प्रोक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं श्रुत्वा तैः सर्वैर्ब्राह्मणैः सह राजानं प्रत्या-

5.279.m: 197. On that occasion, a certain student of the priestly lore named Parāvasu, son of Viśvāvasu, who had gone to the house of a courtesan, unknowingly drank liquor at night due to being overpowered by sleep and tormented by thirst; then, full of remorse, in the morning he went to Śaṅkhatīrtha, shaved his head, and stood at a distance from the guru's house like an outcaste; his fellow students questioned him; as a joke, his fellow students stated his expiation: 'By seizing Ratnāvatī's breast and tasting her lower lip, you will be freed from sin'; then, by the guru's command, Viśvāvasu told the entire account; then, seeing Viśvāvasu prepare to undertake the expiation consisting of drinking ghee hot as fire as prescribed by brahmins versed in dharmaśāstra, his parents cried out in lamentation; then, Bhartṛyajña heard that expiation originally spoken in jest by the students of priestly lore—that purification from drinking wine would occur by seizing Ratnāvatī's breast and tasting her lower lip; together with all those brahmins, he approached the king with an entreaty to grant the brahmin his life; when the king told his daughter, 'Let this favor be shown for the brahmin's expiation,' she, looking upon him as a son, gave permission for him to touch her breast and taste her lower lip for the brahmin's expiation; when that brahmin did so with the attitude of a mother, milk flowed from the brahmin's mouth and from Ratnāvatī's breasts; description of the account of Parāvasu's expiation... 219 1
